cards.title: 性别
cards.body:
- 创建角色时可选择男性或女性，之后也能在属性菜单通过重抽更改。每种性别有各自的发型和面部ID。
- 性别也影响平均身高。
- 更换性别会失去面部、发型与性别专属饰品。性别专属制服会保留，但无法穿着；女性可以穿男性制服，属于例外。
cards.original:
- You may choose to be **Male** or **Female** during character creation. You may also change your gender later on in the stats menu via rolling.
  Each Gender has their own specific Hair/Face ID’s.
- Gender also affects height averages.
- Swapping gender will cause you to lose face, hairstyle, and gender-based accessories. Gender exclusive uniforms will remain but will be unwearable (with the exception of male uniforms being allowed to be worn by females.

cards.title: 身高战斗修正
cards.body:
角色身高决定命中判定大小、攻击速度与伤害。

**更高：伤害更高、生命更多、判定更大、攻击更慢。**

**更矮：伤害更低、生命更少、判定更小、攻击更快。**

---

### 最矮身高
- 轻击攻击距离：5.10
- 重击攻击距离：4.25
- 伤害：0.85倍
- 攻击速度：1.15倍
- 轻击判定宽度：3.40
- 最大生命值：85
- 重击冷却：基础冷却 / 1.15

### 最高身高
- 轻击攻击距离：6.90
- 重击攻击距离：5.75
- 伤害：1.15倍
- 攻击速度：0.95倍
- 轻击判定宽度：4.60
- 最大生命值：115
- 重击冷却：基础冷却 / 0.85

身高的主要优势是判定盒截面扩大：横向和纵向的命中判定明显增加，同时攻击距离也略有增长。

---

### 攻击速度
更高＝挥击更慢；更矮＝挥击更快。
- 也包括连段重置时间，因此矮个角色的攻击冷却更短。

### 伤害
更高＝伤害更多；更矮＝伤害更少。
- 与风格伤害叠加。

### 命中判定大小
更高＝攻击判定更大；更矮＝攻击判定更小。
- 高个更容易命中，可以采用保持距离的打法。

### 生命值
更高＝生命更多；更矮＝生命更少。
- 除非极高或极矮，否则生命值差别不会特别大；基础生命值为100。
cards.original:
##### Your characters height determines your hitbox size, attack speed and damage.

##### _Taller = **more** damage, **more** health, **larger** hitbox, **slower** attacks._

##### Shorter = **less** damage, **less** health, **smaller** hitbox, **faster** attacks.

---

## Technical buffs/debuffs

## Short vs. Tall Height Comparison

**📏 Minimum Height**

- **M1 Reach:** 5.10
- **M2 Reach:** 4.25
- **Damage:** 0.85x
- **Atk Speed:** 1.15x
- **M1 Width:** 3.40
- **Max HP:** 85
- **Heavy CD:**  CD / 1.15

**📐 Maximum Height**

- **M1 Reach:** 6.90
- **M2 Reach:** 5.75
- **Damage:** 1.15x
- **Atk Speed:** 0.95x
- **M1 Width:** 4.60
- **Max HP:** 115
- **Heavy CD:** CD / .85

The main advantage of **Height** is the box face growing — you get **much more lateral and vertical hitbox** than with Reach, plus a slight reach increase on top.

---

### Attack Speed

_Taller = **slower** swings, Shorter = **faster** swings_

- this includes combo reset timers, meaning shorter players attacking cooldowns are shorter.

### Damage

Taller = **more** damage, Shorter = **less** damage

- stacks with style damage.

### Hitbox Size

Taller = **larger** attack hitboxes, Shorter = **smaller** attack hitboxes

- easier to land hits when taller, can play ranged/distance playstyle

### Health

Taller = **more** health, Shorter = **less** health

- Not a _major difference or change in health unless extremely_ tall or _extremely_ short (base health = 100HP)

cards.title: 轻击（M1）
cards.body:
最多可打出4段连击，轻按或按住轻击键均可，原卡推荐按住。

- 短时间不攻击会重置连段。
- 第4段即最后一段轻击为连段收尾，击退更强。

轻击也影响抓取与拼招，详见[抓取与拼招](https://trello.com/c/TYI9U56F)。

伤害与命中判定受身高影响，详见[身高战斗修正](https://trello.com/c/KxGUwMZF)。
cards.original:
Up to **4** hit combo - Can be done by **tapping** or **holding (recommended)** the M1 key.

- Combo resets after short time with no attacks
- The 4th/Last M1 is a combo finisher - more knockback

M1’s also effect grappling/clashing, further detail in ([Grappling](https://trello.com/c/TYI9U56F "‌")).

Damage & Hitbox based off height: ([Height Based Combat Modifiers](https://trello.com/c/KxGUwMZF "‌"))

![m1combo.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a50c79e0b357bab33ab451e/attachments/6a518c312cccd905213a6e19/previews/6a518c382cccd905213a7fb7/download/m1combo.gif)

cards.title: 重击（M2）
cards.body:
独立攻击，采用通用冷却；目前适用于所有身高。

**伤害为单次轻击的1.7倍，即提高70%。**

- 普通格挡无法挡住，需要招架、闪避，或用轻击提前打断，详见[破防](https://trello.com/c/99CYuUTb)。
- 部分风格提供霸体，轻击无法将其打断，必须招架，详见[霸体与无敌帧](https://trello.com/c/iFRGfy3b)。
- 部分风格的重击命中后会让目标短暂布娃娃倒地。
cards.original:
A standalone attack on universal cooldown (applies for **ALL** heights currently)

**+1.7x more damage than a singular M1 (+70%)**

- Cannot be blocked, must be parried, dodged or canceled with an M1: ([Blockbreaks/Guardbreaks](https://trello.com/c/99CYuUTb "‌"))
- Certain styles provide **hyper-armor** which can not be **canceled** by an M1 and must be parried ([HyperArmor/Iframes](https://trello.com/c/iFRGfy3b "‌"))
- Some styles have **Ragdoll M2s** which ragdolls the victim on hit for a short amount of time.

![crit.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a50c9933a1a6e726f0994a2/attachments/6a518c0549f39157b8833fc7/previews/6a518c0949f39157b883400b/download/crit.gif)

cards.title: 闪避
cards.body:
闪避冷却很短，提供短暂的无敌帧，即无法被命中的窗口，可用于避开来袭攻击或调整位置。

- 目前闪避不消耗耐力或架势，未来可能调整。
- 对抗超过1名对手时，会额外获得一次带无敌帧的闪避。
cards.original:
**Dodging** has a very short cooldown, grants a small iframe _(unhittable)_ window which can be used to dodge incoming attacks or reposition.

- **Dodging currently does NOT take any stamina/posture** _(may change in the future)_
- When fighting more than 1 opponent the user is granted an additional iframe **dodge**.

![dodge.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a50d3a8cf5c57de1ff2a9ac/attachments/6a518bd1f04d6b13c505bfe2/previews/6a518bd7f04d6b13c505c018/download/dodge.gif)

cards.title: 多人围攻脱离闪避
cards.body:
这项脱离闪避专门用于防止多人围攻时被持续硬直锁住。受到两个人攻击后，按 Q 会进入无敌帧，并向想要的方向闪避。

被两个人命中后，最多可以等待约1—2秒再执行这次闪避。

---
cards.original:
This evasive is specifically meant to **prevent stun locking** while fighting **more than one person**. After getting hit by two people **when you press Q** you will **enter I-frames and dodge towards your desired direction**. Furthermore, **you can wait up to ~1-2 seconds** after getting hit by two people **to perform the dodge.**

---

cards.title: 架势与耐力
cards.body:
**架势＝耐力。**移动时用于冲刺，决定能跑多久；战斗时用于格挡，决定破防前能挡住多少攻击。冲刺和格挡命中都会消耗架势。

- **架势：**用于避免一味被动防守。格挡攻击会消耗架势而非生命值，格挡削血除外。架势条不显示在界面上，耗尽后无法挡住下一次攻击。架势耗尽时继续受击会触发破防，使防守者眩晕，给对方攻击机会。
- **耐力：**用于防止无限奔跑，同样是不显示的计量。耗尽后无法继续冲刺。
- **完美格挡，即招架，不需要架势。**

---

## 影响架势的战斗风格天赋
- **压制力 I：**每次命中的架势伤害提高10%。[踢拳](https://trello.com/c/wTEq8I8q/218-kickboxing)
- **快速恢复：**架势恢复速度提高15%。[基础](https://trello.com/c/JGzGNMSq)
- **镇定心神：**招架后3秒内，架势恢复速度提高25%。[空手道](https://trello.com/c/vvwaQffG)
- **平衡打击：**重击命中返还最大架势的25%。[空手道](https://trello.com/c/vvwaQffG)

## 攻击增益
- **扰乱：**重击让受害者的架势恢复暂停3秒。[泰拳](https://trello.com/c/9KpdQtMi)
cards.original:
**Posture = Stamina** | Movement uses it for sprinting (how long you can run) , combat uses it for blocking (how many attacks can be blocked before you are guardbroken), in addition Sprinting & Blocking hits both drain posture.

- **Posture:**
  Prevents passive play, **blocking** an attack will take your **posture** instead of your HP (not including chip damage). A non displayed meter, if **depleted** will not allow the user to block the next attack. Getting hit with depleted posture will trigger a “**Guard break**” which stuns the defender giving the opponent an opening to attack.
- **Stamina:**
  To prevent infinite running just like posture it is an non displayed meter, when **depleted** will not allow the user to sprint.
  **Posture is NOT needed to perfect block (parry)**

---

**Combat style perks that affect posture:**

`Crushing Force I` : +10% posture damage on every hit. ([Kickboxing](https://trello.com/c/wTEq8I8q/218-kickboxing "‌"))

‌

- Swift Recovery: +15% posture regen. ([Basic](https://trello.com/c/JGzGNMSq "‌"))

‌

- Steady Nerves: +25% posture regen for 3s after a parry ([Karate](https://trello.com/c/vvwaQffG "‌"))

‌

- Balanced Strike: Landing an M2 refunds 25% of your max posture. ([Karate](https://trello.com/c/vvwaQffG "‌"))

**Attack Buffs:**

- Disorientating: M2s halt victims posture regen for 3s. ([Muay Thai](https://trello.com/c/9KpdQtMi "‌"))

cards.title: 格挡削血
cards.body:
每种战斗风格都通过“防御穿透”天赋拥有格挡削血百分比。

- 该数值决定攻击被对方格挡后，仍会造成多少伤害。
- 如果攻击被招架，则完全不造成伤害。

例如，防御穿透 I 提供10%格挡削血，一次原本造成5点伤害的攻击，被格挡后只造成0.5点。如果是提供25%格挡削血的防御穿透 IV，则会造成1.25点。
cards.original:
Every combat style has a ‘Block Chip Percentage’ via the `Guard Pierce` perk.

- This controls how much damage your attack does on somebody that blocked the attack.
- There is **NO DAMAGE** done if the attack is parried.

For example, if my style has `Guard Pierce I: 10% block chip damage`, a blocked attack that normally does `5 DMG` will only do `0.5 DMG`. However, If I had a style with `Guard Pierce IV: 25% block chip damage`, then it would do `1.25 DMG` instead.

cards.title: 招架与完美格挡
cards.body:
招架是在攻击即将命中时进行的精准格挡。面向攻击者，且按键时机落在招架窗口内，就会触发完美格挡，而不是普通格挡。

- 招架不会承受伤害、格挡削血或架势损失。
- 成功招架会让攻击者短暂眩晕0.45秒，为自己提供反击机会。

## 奖励招架的战斗风格天赋
- **反击：**招架后下次攻击伤害提高5%。[基础](https://trello.com/c/JGzGNMSq)、[阿里](https://trello.com/c/Roh6sIpv/168-ali)、[极真空手道](https://trello.com/c/Furm0NSZ)
- **完美反射：**如果重击正在冷却，招架会使剩余冷却减少1秒。[拳击](https://trello.com/c/9zucAqBC)
cards.original:
_Parrying_ is a timed block right as an attack is about to land. If your timing is inside the **parry window** while facing the attacker, you **perfect block** instead of taking a normal block.

- A parry is **not** a normal block: **no damage, no block chip, no posture loss.**
- **Parrying** _stuns_ your attacker temporarily for **0.45 seconds**, presenting the opportunity to counter and attack them.

**Combat Style Perks** that reward parrying:

- Counterstrike: +5% damage on your next attack after a parry. ([Basic](https://trello.com/c/JGzGNMSq "‌"), [Ali](https://trello.com/c/Roh6sIpv/168-ali "‌"), [Kyokushin Karate](https://trello.com/c/Furm0NSZ "‌"))
- Perfect Reflex: If M2 on cooldown, parrying reduces remaining cooldown by 1s. ([Boxing](https://trello.com/c/9zucAqBC "‌"))

![parry.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a50ef53d2057e4ccd28bf75/attachments/6a518b9d7630ab22fed647df/previews/6a518ba37630ab22fed66164/download/parry.gif)

cards.title: 破防
cards.body:
破防指格挡被打破。你会受到完整的破防伤害，并眩晕约2秒。

- 破防时不再另受格挡削血伤害。
- 重击总能打破普通格挡，因此必须招架、闪避，或在对方命中前先出手。
- 架势不足时，轻击也能破防，卡片给出的条件为架势低于10。

“重手”战斗风格天赋会改变破防伤害：
- 重手 I：破防伤害提高5%，当前无对应风格。
- 重手 II：破防伤害提高10%，当前无对应风格。
- 重手 III：破防伤害提高15%，见[摔跤](https://trello.com/c/Fq0e4oUr)。
cards.original:
This is when your block is broken. You take full guard break damage, and get stunned for ~2 seconds.

- **You do not take block chip damage on guardbreaks**
- `M2s` **always** break your block, so you must either parry, dodge, or hit them before theirs lands.
- `M1s` can break your block if you run out of enough posture to do so (`<10`)

There’s a perk for combat styles that affect the guard break damage, `HeavyHitter`:

- Heavy Hitter I: +5% guardbreak damage (N/A)
- Heavy Hitter II: +10% guardbreak damage (N/A)
- Heavy Hitter III: +15% guardbreak damage ([Wrestling](https://trello.com/c/Fq0e4oUr "‌"))

cards.title: 觉醒
cards.body:
- **15种可觉醒风格：**Jin、拳击、空手道、体术、缅甸拳、Hakari、摔跤、合气道、Kure、踢拳、CQC、重拳手、极真和突击者。
- **3个阶段：**完成阶段3即可精通该风格，并自动启用V2。
- **V2开关：**通过觉醒面板开启或关闭V2，战斗中或倒地时不能切换。
- **按风格计进度：**仅当前装备的战斗风格可以推进自身进度。
- **保存进度：**各风格分别存档，切换风格不会清除已经保存的进度。
- **查看进度：**只有阶段1显示进度条。阶段2、3没有计数器，需要留意角色心声中的提示。
- **阶段3试炼：**属于一次性试炼。离开、切换风格、失败或不再满足条件，均会使试炼进度重置为0。例外：空手道阶段3会保存进度。

---

### 生成
- 全服每8至15分钟生成一次Taiman，按玩家进入服务器的顺序轮流触发。
- Taiman约在你身后10 studs处生成，并跟随你。
- 除安全区外，Taiman可以在角色附近的任何位置生成。

### 开战
- Taiman走到你身边后会把双手向后靠，并说“taiman, one on one”（单挑，一对一）。
- 出拳击打Taiman即可开战。
- 击倒后，尽可能对其执行终结，以确保胜利计入。

### 重要细节
- 任务仅计算专门为你生成的Taiman。抢别人的Taiman不会计入。
- 私人服务器不生成Taiman。
- 建议选择人数较少或空的公共服务器，以缩短等待时间。

---

### 有效目标
- 玩家必须先打你，或向你还击。
- NPC必须是街头帮派成员，或正主动与你交战的NPC。
- 随意攻击不还手的玩家或NPC，不算公平交战。

### 每小时对同一玩家的计数上限
- 命中150次。
- 完美防御40次。
- 破防25次。
- 重击（M2）命中25次。
- 碰撞抓取获胜20次。
- 击倒3次。

上述限制不适用于NPC或沙袋。

- **击倒归属：**对手倒下前10秒内，你必须曾命中过最后一击。
- **沙袋：**每秒最多约计算4至5次命中。
- **夜间：**游戏内19:00至次日06:00。

---

### Jin
**阶段1：**击倒150名NPC。

**阶段2：**招架后2秒内命中同一人。

**阶段3：冥想。**夜间在屋顶或园艺区连续坐满5分钟。可以坐在座位上，也可以使用坐下动作。移动超过2 studs、受到伤害或进入战斗均会使试炼失败。

### 拳击
**阶段1：**对道场沙袋或玩家命中1500次轻击（M1）。

**阶段2：**招架250次。

**阶段3：空击练习。**夜间在道场房间内，连续打沙袋3分钟。房间内不能有其他玩家；停手超过2.5秒即重置试炼。

### 空手道
**阶段1：**在道场沙袋上完成400套完整连击。

**阶段2：**击败5个Taiman。该随机NPC事件每8至15分钟触发一次。

**阶段3：雨中型。**在下雨或下雪时，于室外完成60套完整轻击连段。头顶60 studs内不能有屋顶或其他物体。

### 体术
**阶段1：**在道场沙袋上命中2000次。

**阶段2：奔跑。**徒步冲刺60000 studs。必须靠双脚完成，坐下、乘滑板或在空中时的冲刺不计入。

**阶段3：**在道场沙袋上连续命中600次。一天中的任何时段都可完成；停手超过5秒即重置试炼。

### 缅甸拳
**阶段1：**破防300次。玩家或NPC必须先打你才计入。

**阶段2：低血量胜利。**赢得15场低血量战斗；击倒对手时，自身生命值必须不高于25%。

**阶段3：血誓。**击败一名街头帮派首领，整场战斗中不能进行任何格挡。

### Hakari
**阶段1：气势奔涌（Momentum Rush）。**触发200次。需要连续4次干净的轻击（M1），且最近3秒内必须打出一次符合公平交战规则的有效命中。

**阶段2：重击。**命中200次重击（M2）。

**阶段3：不败。**连续击倒5次。自己被击倒或被重击命中，都会使连胜重置。

### 摔跤
**阶段1：对NPC重击。**对NPC命中150次重击（M2）。

**阶段2：碰撞抓取。**赢得100次碰撞抓取对抗。

**阶段3：擂台。**连续赢下3场Taiman。输掉Taiman即重置连胜。

### 泰拳
**阶段1：完整轻击连段。**对符合公平交战规则的对手或沙袋完成300套完整轻击（M1）连段。

**阶段2：碰撞抓取。**赢得100次碰撞抓取对抗。

**阶段3：拜师礼（Wai Kru）。**按下列步骤赢得Taiman：
1. 与对手开始一场Taiman。
2. 站在对手正面25 studs以内，面向对手使用鞠躬（Bow）动作。
3. 鞠躬后20秒内打出第一击。
4. 赢下Taiman。

注意：鞠躬前击打对手，会使本次尝试失败。

### Kure
**阶段1：**对NPC或玩家命中120次重击。玩家必须先打你；NPC则必须还击。

**阶段2：**自身生命值不高于25%时，击倒15名玩家或NPC。

**阶段3：**先击倒3名街头帮派成员，再击倒他们的首领。必须来自同一个街头帮派，换到另一个帮派即重置。

### 重拳手
**阶段1：**击败120名会还击的NPC。可以反复击败同一个NPC。

**阶段2：**用重击击倒目标40次，重击（M2）必须是最后一击。

**阶段3：**夜间90秒内击败5名街头事件NPC，例如学校袭击、地盘帮派、群架、暴走族等。

### 踢拳
**阶段1：**在沙袋上命中轻击连段的第3、4段。

**阶段2：**对NPC或玩家完成120套连击。必须完整打出4段轻击，沙袋不计入。

**阶段3：**完成3轮沙袋踢击，每轮25次，轮间休息8至20秒；每轮必须少于45秒。原文下一条另写“至少等待8至25秒”，此处保留该不同表述。

### 突击者
**阶段1：**对NPC或玩家命中150次重击。

**阶段2：**通过冲刺穿过120次攻击。任何NPC或玩家都可以，在私人服务器也能进行。

**阶段3：**不受到任何攻击，击倒3名街头NPC。可选帮派成员、帮派斗殴者／霸凌者或Taiman，也可以对玩家完成。

### 合气道
**阶段1：**完美防御300次。

**阶段2：**通过冲刺躲过或穿过150次攻击。

**阶段3：**在道场连续坐4分钟，不得移动。任何时间都可以，可使用任意坐下动作，不得被击中。

### 极真
**阶段1：**承受NPC或玩家500次攻击。需要先被打才计入，不要自己先出手。

**阶段2：**在使用重击期间被击中100次。必须在蓄力时受击，每次重击最多计算3次命中。

**阶段3：**连续击败任意对手10次；相邻两次击倒间隔最多60秒。自己被击倒即重置。

### CQC
**阶段1：**对NPC或玩家造成1000点重击伤害。必须先被对方打。

**阶段2：**最近20秒内有至少3个目标打过自己时，击倒25名NPC。

**阶段3：**击倒同一街头帮派的3名成员，再击倒其首领。

---

## 完成觉醒
完成所选战斗风格的全部3个阶段，即可精通其觉醒，并自动启用V2。

阶段2、3不显示进度计数，请记得查看角色心声中的提示。
cards.original:
## GENERAL RULES

‌

- **15 Awakenable Styles:** Jin, Boxing, Karate, Taijutsu, Lethwei, Hakari, Wrestling, Aikido, Kure, Kickboxing, Cqc, Slugger, kyokushin and Striker.
- **3 Stages:** Complete Stage 3 to master the style and automatically activate it’s V2.
- **V2 Toggle:** Switch V2 on or off through the Awakening Panel. This cannot be done while in combat or downed.
- **Style-Specific Progress:** Only progress for your currently equipped fighting style counts.
- **Saved Progress:** Progress is saved separately for each style. Switching styles does not erase saved progress.
- **Progress Tracking:** Only Stage 1 displays a progress bar. Stages 2 and 3 have no counter; use your character's inner thoughts for hints.
- **Stage 3 Trials:** These are one-time trials. Leaving, switching styles, failing, or no longer meeting the required conditions resets the trial to 0.
  - **Exception:** Karate Stage 3 progress is saved.

---

## TAIMANS & CALLOUTS

#### **Spawning**

- Taimans spawn every 8–15 minutes server-wide, following the order players joined the server.
- A Taiman spawns approximately 10 studs behind you and follows you.
- Taimans can spawn anywhere near your character, except in safezones.

#### **Fight**

- Once the Taiman reaches you, it will lean its hands back and say "taiman, one on one".
- Punch the Taiman to start the fight.
- After knocking them out, grip them if possible to ensure the win counts.

#### **Important Details**

- **Quest Requirement:** Only Taimans that spawn for you count. Stealing another player's Taiman will not count.
- **Private Servers:** Taimans do not spawn in private servers.

> **Tip:** Use a small or empty public server to reduce waiting time.

---

## FAIR FIGHT RULES & LIMITS

#### **Valid Targets**

- **Players:** Must hit you first or hit you back.
- **NPCs:** Street Crew members or NPCs actively fighting you.
- Randomly attacking players or NPCs who aren't fighting back does not count as a fair fight.

#### **Hourly Limits Against the Same Player**

- 150 Hits
- 40 Perfect Blocks
- 25 Guardbreaks
- 25 Critical Hits (M2)
- 20 Clash Wins
- 3 Knockouts

> These limits do not apply to NPCs or punching bags.

‌

- **Knockout Credit:** You must have landed the last hit within 10 seconds before the opponent goes down.
- **Punching Bags:** A maximum of approximately 4-5 hits per second are counted.
- **Nighttime:** In-game time between 07:00 PM and 06:00 AM.

---

# AWAKENING QUESTS

## JIN

**Stage 1 — Knock 150 npcs**

**Stage 2 — parry and hit the same person within 2 seconds**

**Stage 3 — Meditation**

- Sit for 5 minutes straight on the Rooftop or in the Gardening area during nighttime.

> → You may sit on a seat or use the Sit emote.
> \-> Moving more than 2 studs, taking damage, or entering combat fails the trial.

> ‌

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_204745.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6aeccf5984925fa15a458e18/previews/6aeccf5a84925fa15a458fde/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_204745.webp)

> ‌

---

## BOXING

**Stage 1 — 1,500 m1s on dojo bags/players**

**Stage 2 — parry 250 times**

**Stage 3 — Shadowbox**

- Hit a punching bag in the Dojo Room nonstop for **3** minutes during nighttime.

> → No other players may be inside the Dojo Room.
> \-> Stopping for more than 2.5 seconds resets the trial.

> ‌

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_204451.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6aecceaedc5a8a74d04ea070/previews/6aecceaedc5a8a74d04ea21e/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_204451.webp)

> ‌

---

## KARATE

**Stage 1 — 400 full combos in dojo bags**

**Stage 2 — Defeat 5 taiman**

- Random npc event each 8-15 minutes

**Stage 3 —Rain kata**

- Complete 60 full M1 combos outdoors while it is raining or snowing.
  → No roof or other object may be above you within 60 studs.

> ‌

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_204536.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6aecced8f92599532301dd5f/previews/6aecced9f92599532301e0b7/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_204536.webp)

> ‌

## TAIJUTSU

**Stage 1 — 2k hits in dojo bags**

**Stage 2 — Sprinting**

- Sprint 60,000 studs on foot.

> → Must be completed on foot.
> \-> Sprinting while seated, riding a skateboard, or airborne does not count.

**Stage 3 — 600 non-stop hits in dojo bag**

> → Can be completed at any time of day.
> \-> Stopping for more than 5 seconds resets the trial.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_204102.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6aeccdcb0e9024729b0ba6cc/previews/6aeccdcc0e9024729b0ba84a/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_204102.webp)

> ‌

## LETHWEI

**Stage 1 — guardbreak 300 times**

- player/NPC must hit you first to count

**Stage 2 — Low-HP Victories**

- Win 15 fights while at low HP.

> → You must knock out your opponent while your HP is at 25% or lower.

**Stage 3 — Blood Oath**

- Defeat a Street Crew leader without blocking at any point during the fight.
  ![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_204304.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6aecce40065f421f44b9971f/previews/6aecce40065f421f44b99949/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_204304.webp)

---

## HAKARI

**Stage 1 — Momentum Rush**

- Trigger Momentum Rush 200 times.

> → Momentum Rush requires 4 clean M1s in a row.
> \-> You must have landed a fair hit within the last 3 seconds.

**Stage 2 — Critical Hits**

- Land 200 critical hits (M2).

**Stage 3 — Undefeated**

- Get 5 knockouts in a row.

> → The streak resets if you are knocked down or hit by a critical hit.

> ‌

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_204400.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6aecce7cb0b01fa513905cb9/previews/6aecce7db0b01fa513905f0c/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_204400.webp)

> ‌

---

## WRESTLING

**Stage 1 — NPC Critical Hits**

- Land your critical hit (M2) on NPCs 150 times.

**Stage 2 — Clashes**

- Win 100 clashes.

**Stage 3 — Ring**

- Win 3 taimans in a row.

> → Losing a taiman resets the streak.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_204014.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6aeccda2483897a8c1442647/previews/6aeccda2483897a8c14427d3/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_204014.webp)

> ‌

---

## MUAY THAI

**Stage 1 — Full M1 Combos**

- Complete 300 full M1 combos against fair opponents or punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Clashes**

- Win 100 clashes.

**Stage 3 — Wai Kru**
Complete the following steps to win a taiman:

1. Start a taiman against an opponent.
2. Face your opponent and use the Bow emote while within 25 studs and in front of them.
3. Land your first hit within 20 seconds of bowing.
4. Win the taiman.

**Important:** Hitting your opponent before bowing fails the attempt.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_204143.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6aeccdf529a7fe499465bf32/previews/6aeccdf629a7fe499465c0bc/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_204143.webp)

---

## Kure

S**tage 1 - land 120 heavy on NPC/players**

- player must hit you first, for NPC they have to fight back

**Stage 2- knock 15 players/NPCS while 25%- hp**

**Stage 3-Knock 3 street crew, THEN their leader**

**Stage 1- kill 120 npcs that fight back**

- can be repeated on the same npc

**Stage 1- land 3rd and 4th m1 combos in punching bag**

**stage 2- do 120 combos on npcs/players**

- full 4 m1s, bag doesn’t count.

**stage 3- 3 rounds of 25 bag kicks, rest for 8-20s between each**

**Stage-2- dash through 120 hits**

- can be any npc/player, works on private

- gang members, gang fights/bullies or taiman

cards.title: 手机
cards.body:
按Alt或手柄方向键↓打开手机，首先会出现欢迎界面。

按“确定”按钮进入应用菜单。进入菜单后，可以用手机上的方向键切换，也可以直接点击应用。


“我的手机”会显示以下个人信息：

- 手机号码
- 日元余额
- 联系人总数
- 已发送消息数
- 已接收消息总数
- 手机型号
- 通话次数
- 通话时长
- 运营商
- 天气


可以输入其他玩家的手机号码拨打电话。拨号后也可以将对方存为联系人。


显示所有过去的通话，也可以在通话结束后将对方存为联系人。


列出所有已保存的联系人。


打开游戏选择菜单，游玩各种手机小游戏。


两名玩家可以直接交换手机号码，省去手动拨号。双方需要靠近并同时打开Social Link；找到想添加的人后，点击“确定”并保存联系人。


Mixi是游戏内跨服务器的社交媒体应用，可以发帖，也可以给其他人的帖子点赞、评论。要发布帖子，点击方向键左侧的按键。


可以使用游戏内的手机拍照。

使用方法：

1. 打开手机。
2. 选择“相机”。
3. 在3种自定义滤镜之间切换，选择想要的效果。
4. 切换前置或后置摄像头。
5. 拍照。

- 后置摄像头：拍摄场景、环境和其他玩家。
- 前置摄像头：为自己的角色自拍。

可以在世界中的任何地方即时拍照。

**保存照片至Roblox拍摄记录**

拍照后可以将照片保存至Roblox：

1. 打开照片预览。
2. 选择“保存至拍摄记录”。

图片会存入Roblox拍摄记录，离开游戏后也能通过Roblox账号查看。


内置音乐库，方便玩家浏览、收听音乐。在同一界面中可以查看喜欢的歌曲、探索歌单、收听喜爱歌手的作品，以及搜索最近加入的歌曲，方便发现和整理音乐，丰富游戏体验。


**收款标签：**标签相当于你在该应用中的用户名。其他玩家向你转账时，需要输入这个标签。选好标签后，即可进入账户界面。

点击“活动记录”可以查看全部交易。点击黑色输入栏并输入其他玩家的名称，可以搜索他们的收款标签。


在不同工作地点申请班次，通过工作赚取日元。


显示当前服务器天气的简易应用。
cards.original:
# Phones

## Opening Your Phone:

To open your phone, press Alt/D-Pad Down, which will greet you with this UI:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a66a9defaa4c76b07d0b643/previews/6a66a9dffaa4c76b07d0bfb7/download/image.webp)

To progress past this screen, press the “OK” button, which will open a menu that features all of the apps:

Once you are here, you can use the arrow keys on the phone to navigate or alternatively click on the apps.

# Apps:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a7cb8346aef5eaf64d7e1b7/previews/6a7cb8356aef5eaf64d7e3a7/download/image.webp)

## **My Phone:**

the My Phone app displays the following information about you:

- Phone Number
- Yen
- Total Contacts
- Messages Sent
- Total Messages Received
- Phone Model
- Calls
- Call Time
- And Carrier
- Weather
  ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726c20472399ec1003a0c9/previews/6a726c21472399ec1003a1f1/download/image.webp)

## **Dial:**

Dial allows you to dial players phone numbers. Furthermore, by dialing peoples phone numbers you can save them as a contact.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726c77335a2c5faa1bf4ce/previews/6a726c77335a2c5faa1bf6ce/download/image.webp)

## **Calls:**

Calls shows all past calls (which also allows you to save contacts after a call)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a7cb881275df5c4e7493ff3/previews/6a7cb883275df5c4e749417b/download/image.webp)

## **Contacts:**

Contacts shows a list of all saved contacts

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726ca69a246e8612cd6197/previews/6a726ca69a246e8612cd62e3/download/image.webp)

## **Games:**

The Games app opens a menu that lets you select various phone games to play.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726cb7d05cb4df2f129d3d/previews/6a726cb8d05cb4df2f129e95/download/image.webp)

## **Social Link:**

Social link allows two players to connect phone numbers without the trouble of dialing them. To use it, both players must open social link in proximity to each other. After locating the person you want, click “OK” and save their contact.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e790b1c7ad14f7d4c4e6f/previews/6a6e790b1c7ad14f7d4c4f62/download/image.webp)

## **Mixi:**

Mixi is an in game global social media app, that allows you to create posts, and like/comment other people’s posts. To create a post, click the left pad next to the arrow keys.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e7959262cc8c5b54cdd10/previews/6a6e795b262cc8c5b54cde11/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e7ac7f1f6a3cfa75cf90e/previews/6a6e7ac8f1f6a3cfa75cfb47/download/image.webp)

## **Camera:**

The Camera app allows players to take photos using their in game phone.

To use it:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Camera**.
3. Switch between 3 different custom filters for different vibes.
4. Switch between **front** and **back** camera.
5. Take a photo.

- **Back Camera** – Captures the world, environments, and other players.
- **Front Camera** – Takes selfies of your character.
  ![Screenshot\_2026-07-11\_131704.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a52da71070234ae653b984e/previews/6a52da71070234ae653b9912/download/Screenshot_2026-07-11_131704.webp)

Photos can be taken instantly anywhere in the world.

**Saving Photos (Roblox Captures)**

After taking a photo, players can save it to Roblox:

1. Open the photo preview.
2. Select **Save to Captures**.

The image is stored in your **Roblox Captures** and can be accessed outside the game through your Roblox account.

## **Japanify:**

is your built in music collection, allowing players to browse and listen to music with ease. You can view your **liked songs**, explore **playlists**, listen to music from your favorite **artists**, and search for **recently added songs**, all from one convenient interface. It's designed to make discovering and organizing music simple while enhancing your in game experience.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726cd641f9ad89c1bb1af2/previews/6a726cd741f9ad89c1bb1c56/download/image.webp)

## **YenApp:**

**Tags:** Choosing a tag is essentially your username on the app, it is what players type in when they want to send you money. After choosing a tag you will be greeted with this screen:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e77a6534d0dbd2ce096a8/previews/6a6e77a6534d0dbd2ce09792/download/image.webp)

The Activity button will show all transactions. You can search other players tags by clicking the black bar and typing in their name.

## **Indeed App**:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a701ba6b8ca6b95cde9b3c7/previews/6a701ba7b8ca6b95cde9b59e/download/image.webp)

Is a simple application that allows players to apply for shifts at different Job locations for Yen!

## **Weather App**:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a7cb8564f30af29efe497c3/previews/6a7cb8564f30af29efe4993f/download/image.webp)

A simple application that displays the current weather in the server.

**缺点：**重击（M2）打空会使自己进入布娃娃倒地状态。

完美模仿非常适合6英尺以上的角色，能够获得更大的攻击范围，并让重击带来更高回报。矮个角色并不理想，因为重击打空时会对自己造成伤害。

cards.title: 社团
cards.body:
可选择的社团共有5个：生物社、书法社、天文社、园艺社和轻音社。到对应社团活动室的公告板处即可加入。

在一个社团达到1,000积分后，随时可以通过该社团的公告板使用社团制服。

**生物社**

位于一楼，入口左侧、储物柜区域旁。加入后，通过显微镜寻找标本来赚取积分。完成任务获得积分、提升社团等级后，会解锁更多可寻找的标本。

生物社制服

**书法社**

位于一楼，正对生物教室、左侧楼梯旁。加入后，通过书写随机指定的书法内容赚取积分。完成任务获得积分、提升社团等级后，会解锁更多可书写的汉字。

书法社制服

**园艺社**

位于学校建筑右翼的屋顶。加入后，通过照料植物赚取积分：按需浇水、确保日照充足，并在出现害虫时除虫。

每块花圃最多同时照料3株植物，升级后会解锁更多可种植的种子。建议在白天进行这项社团活动，这样不用担心日照条件，更容易完成。点击右上角按钮放弃花圃，即可停止照料其中的植物。

园艺社制服

**天文社**

位于学校三楼。加入后，与任意空闲望远镜互动，左下角会出现一张星图，需要把图中的点（星星）连起来。完成后即可获得社团积分，也会解锁能在天空中看到的行星。

天文社制服

**轻音社**

位于学校三楼。到社团演奏歌曲即可获得积分。积分取决于曲目难度，难度范围从简单到极限，其中极限难度积分最高。

轻音社制服

There are 5 clubs you can choose from, join one at its board in the club room. The 5 clubs include Biology Club, Calligraphy Club, Astronomy Club, Gardening Club, and Light Music Club.

Club uniforms can be accessed at any time from their respective club boards after reaching 1,000 points in that club.

‌

**Biology Club**

The Biology club is found on the first floor to the left of the entrance and beside the locker area. Upon joining the biology club, your task for getting points is finding specimen via the microscope. You unlock more specimens to find as you level your rank up by doing tasks for points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac18155422926300b517a94/previews/6ac18156422926300b517ae0/download/image.webp)

**Calligraphy Club**

The Calligraphy club is found on the first floor right infront of the biology room and beside the stairs on the left. Upon joining the calligraphy club, your task for getting points is writing calligraphy. The calligraphy that you have to write is random. You unlock more kanji to write as you level your rank up by doing tasks for points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac1892468629eac5381ba97/previews/6ac1892568629eac5381bb6f/download/image.webp)

**Gardening Club**

The Gardening club is found on the right wing of the Gakuran building on the roof. Upon joining the gardening club, your task for getting points is taking care of them by giving the water they need, making sure they get enough sunlight, and removing bugs if there are any.

The maximum amount plants that you can take care of in one bed is three plants and you unlock more seeds to plant as you level up. It is recommended to do this club activity when the sun is up so you won't have to worry about the sunlight part of the activity, making it easier for you to complete it. You can abandon the responsibility of taking care of the plants by giving up your bed using the button on the upper right corner.

cards.title: NPC事件
cards.body:
> Nishikata高中外的道路上，有NPC驾驶不同颜色和型号的车辆，包括小型双门车、四门车、小货车、小型厢式车、半挂卡车和出租车。

撞上行驶速度较快的车辆会受到伤害、被击退，并进入数秒的布娃娃倒地状态。

骑滑板时靠近车辆尾部，角色会自动抓住车尾的一个角，挂在车后搭便车；半挂卡车除外。轻按S（后退键）可随时松手。

可以用拳头攻击车辆。车辆不会被破坏，但车内的NPC会通过对话抱怨你的行为。有时持续攻击会让NPC下车并攻击你。对NPC造成足够伤害后，对方会重新上车并逃离现场。

校门外会有1名教师和3名学生会成员等候，向你问好，或催促你赶快去上课。

车辆撞击演示
cards.original:
## NPC Events

> Automobiles (of various colors and models) can be found driven by NPCs on the roads outside of Nishikata High—this includes: smaller two-door cars, four-door cars, small trucks, small vans, semi-trucks, and taxis.

Running into vehicles moving at a substantial speed will cause you to take damage, knockback, and you'll be ragdolled for a couple of seconds.

Whilst riding a skateboard, moving in close proximity to the rear end of a vehicle (with the exception of semi-trucks) will force your character to grab onto one of the rear corners of the vehicle, allowing you to hitch a ride by hanging on. You can stop this action at any time by simply tapping "s" (backward movement key).

You are able to attack vehicles with your fists—they aren't destructible, but the NPC inside the vehicle will show dialogue in complaint to your actions.
In some cases, continuing to attack the vehicle will result in the NPC exiting the vehicle and aggroing you.
If enough damage to the NPC is dealt, they will re-enter the vehicle and flee the scene.

Student council waits outside of the gate with 1 teacher, 3 student councils and greet you / tell you to hurry to class

Runover

cards.title: 阿里
cards.body:
## 推荐配装
Ali推荐使用较矮的角色，约4英尺11英寸至5英尺3英寸，以便持续压制对手，同时闪避反击。矮个带来的较短冷却与较快移动，可以尽量发挥进攻能力，并通过重击和闪避维持较强防守。

Ali擅长持续施压，成功招架后可利用“反击（Counterstrike）”，让下一次攻击获得5%伤害加成。“蝶舞（Float Like a Butterfly）”提供的无敌帧可帮助你迅速接近并命中重击；“蜂刺（Sting Like a Bee）”则可通过闪避躲开对手攻击，为自身反击创造机会。“格挡穿透 III（Guard Pierce III）”另提供20%格挡穿透伤害；“韧性 II（Resilience II）”使双方攻击相撞时有25%概率进入抓取对抗。

矮个最适合持续压制与快速行动，高个也可以利用更长的攻击距离维持压力。Ali不推荐中等身高。

## 左手重击
左手重击：R；基础冷却7秒。

## 右手重击
右手重击：D或S＋R；造成布娃娃倒地，基础冷却7秒。

## 反击
反击：Q；必须成功躲过一次攻击。
cards.original:
## Perks:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a6e72672732d29a1e21f077/attachments/6aa30f3d3195020d64c930ad/previews/6aa30f3d3195020d64c9321f/download/image.webp)

## Recommended Build:

For the **Ali**, a **short** build _(around 4'11-5'3)_ is recommended to maintain constant pressure on your opponent while simultaneously evading counter attacks. The shorter cooldowns and faster movement from a shorter height allows the user to maximize their offensive capabilities while still keeping a high defense up with their heavy and evasive.

Ali excels when keeping constant pressure on their opponent, making usage of the **+5% damage buff** from **Counterstrike** on their next attack after a successful parry. Ali is able to move in quickly and land their critical attack with their I-Frames from **Float Like a Butterfly** and make use of **Sting Like a Bee** to dodge an opponents attack with their evasive to allow their own attack. **Guard Pierce III** also grants **20% block chip damage** and **Resilience II** grants a **25% chance to clash into a grapple when attacks meet.**

Short builds are ideal for maintaining constant pressure and swiftness, but **tall** builds could still be a viable option with their extended reach and ability to keep pressure. **Medium** builds are not recommended for **Ali.**

## M1 Combo:

![export.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a6e72672732d29a1e21f077/attachments/6aa30ee71d7209f92a9fe10f/download/export.gif)

‌

cards.title: 黑板
cards.body:
每间教室都有粉笔盒和板擦盒。

走近粉笔盒并按互动键（E／手柄X键／□键／触屏点击），即可打开选择界面。

选择想使用的颜色后，会获得对应颜色的粉笔。点击或轻触黑板即可开始绘画。可以同时拿两种不同颜色的粉笔，也可以同时拿粉笔和板擦。使用“丢弃物品”绑定键，可在双手之间交换物品或将其丢下。

需要擦除时，与板擦盒互动（E／手柄X键／□键／触屏点击）即可拿到板擦。与绘画类似，在黑板的笔迹上点击或轻触即可擦除。

Within every classroom there is a chalk and erasers box:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5167f2b597170adb76bb46/attachments/6a725e3d0658174a8e3b87b9/previews/6a725e3e0658174a8e3b880f/download/image.webp)

To grab a piece of chalk, walk up to the box and use the interact button (E/X Button/Square/Tap). After interacting with the box, you will be greeted with this UI:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5167f2b597170adb76bb46/attachments/6a725e4bf6d6212ac8a0afdb/previews/6a725e4cf6d6212ac8a0b03d/download/image.webp)

You can then select the color you would like to use, and you will be given a piece of chalk corresponding to the color you chose. You can begin drawing by clicking / tapping the board. You can hold two different chalk colors at the same time, as well as chalk and an eraser at the same time. Use the DROP ITEM key bind to swap items between hands or drop items.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5167f2b597170adb76bb46/attachments/6a725e88f736a3a2e0da523f/previews/6a725e89f736a3a2e0da52b0/download/image.webp)

To erase, just interact (E/X Button/Square/Tap) with the eraser box and you will be given an eraser. Similarly to drawing, you can erase by clicking/tapping the board over the lines to erase them.

cards.title: 乐器
cards.body:
游戏提供多种可演奏乐器，使用类似常见音乐游戏的节奏玩法。学校三楼有两间音乐教室。玩家不能只启动乐器就完成演奏，而是需要准确把握时机，击中迎面而来的音符。

音符沿指定轨道向目标圆圈移动。音符到达目标时，按下对应按键；输入的准确程度决定本次音符判定。

[查看各乐器可演奏的完整曲目列表](https://trello.com/c/wQkJJHPV)

**音符判定**

- 完美：时机与准确度极佳。
- 良好：略有偏差，但仍然准确。
- 尚可：时机可以接受，但偏差明显。
- 较差：时机不佳或接近漏打，会播放对应的失误音效。
- 漏打：完全错过音符，会播放对应的失误音效。

准确率百分比的计算方式为：完美、良好和尚可判定的音符总数，除以整首歌的音符总数。

**100连击特效**

---

**校准**

- 可以校准判定时机，使其符合自己的操作感觉。

---

**可用乐器**

**电吉他**

- 使用两条音符轨道。
- 通过F和J键演奏，可在设置中重新绑定。
- 玩法较简明，但节奏较快。

**贝斯**

- 使用四条音符轨道。
- 用分配的按键击中四条独立轨道上的音符。

**架子鼓**

- 使用四条音符轨道。
- 准确击中四条轨道上的鼓点，保持节奏。

**电子键盘**

- 使用四条音符轨道。
- 在多条轨道上把握时机和准确度，模拟键盘演奏。

**钢琴**

- 使用Roblox虚拟钢琴的字母键音符。
- 这是唯一不采用节奏音游玩法的乐器。
- 按空格键打开曲谱列表。

每种乐器的手感各有特点，核心规则一致。演奏成败取决于时机、节奏和准确度，与角色属性无关。

---

**多人合奏**

乐器完整支持同步合奏。一名玩家开始歌曲后，其他人可以随时加入，并自动同步到歌曲正在播放的位置。

- 多名玩家可以同时演奏。
- 中途加入的玩家会自动同步到当前乐段。
- 所有人同时演奏同一首歌。
- 所有参与演奏者的进度保持同步。

例如，一名玩家弹电吉他，其他人使用贝斯、架子鼓或钢琴加入，各自都同步到同一歌曲进度，营造现场乐队合奏的感觉。

---

**自定义**

可以在设置中自定义乐器节奏玩法的各项属性，包括：

- 颜色
- 形状
- 按键绑定
- 手感
- 音符轨道属性

---

乐队抬头显示界面

实时成绩

cards.original:
The game features a variety of playable instruments that use a rhythm-based gameplay system similar to popular music games. There are two **music rooms** located on the third floor of the school. Instead of simply activating an instrument, players must hit incoming notes with proper timing to perform songs successfully.

Notes travel down designated lanes toward target circles. As each note reaches its target, players press the corresponding key at the correct moment — the accuracy of the input determines the quality of the hit.

**Click** [**here**](https://trello.com/c/wQkJJHPV "‌") **to view a list of all playable songs by instrument**

**Note Ratings**

- **Perfect** — exceptional timing and accuracy.
- **Good** — slightly off but still accurate.
- **Okay** — acceptable timing with noticeable error.
- **Bad** — poor timing or a near miss, leads to the respective missed note sound being played.
- **Miss** - complete miss of the note, leads to the respective missed note sound being played.

Percentage accuracy is based on the amount of Perfect, Good, and Okay notes, divided by the total amount of notes in the song.

![instrument.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a7292e7687caa386a4f9817/download/instrument.gif)

**100 Note Combo Vfx**:

![out.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6aa5d33c54fef7fd472bac8d/previews/6aa5d35254fef7fd472bc9e2/download/out.gif)

---

**Calibration**

- You can calibrate your timing to what feels right for you.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a77aa67b72bec1ec92bdda9/previews/6a77aa68b72bec1ec92bde58/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a77aa6e849e167d7f038048/previews/6a77aa6f849e167d7f038103/download/image.webp)

---

**Available Instruments**

**Electric Guitar**

- Uses two note lanes.
- Played with the `F` and `J` keys. (Keys are rebind-able in settings)
- Designed for a simpler but fast-paced rhythm experience.

**Bass Guitar**

- Uses four note lanes.
- Hit notes across four separate paths using the assigned keys.

**Drums**

- Uses four note lanes.
- Accurately match incoming drum notes across all four lanes to maintain rhythm.

**Keyboard**

- Uses four note lanes.
- Focuses on timing and accuracy across multiple paths to simulate playing a song on a keyboard.

**Piano**

- Uses Roblox Virtual Piano letter-based keyboard notes.
- Only instrument not based on a **rhythm-based gameplay system**
- Press SPACE to bring up the sheet music list.

‌

Each instrument has its own feel while following the same core mechanics. Success depends on **timing, rhythm, and accuracy**  not character stats.

---

**Multiplayer Performance**
Instruments fully support synchronized group performances. When a player starts a song, others can join at any time and are automatically placed at the exact same point in the song.

- Multiple players can perform together simultaneously.
- Players who join late are auto-synced to the current section of the song.
- Everyone plays the same song at the same time.
- Performances stay synchronized for all participating musicians.

For example, one player can perform on electric guitar while others join on bass, drums, or piano each synced to the same song progression, creating the feeling of playing together as a **live band**.

---

**Customization**

Within settings you are able to customize various properties of the rhythm portion of the instruments.

Such as Color:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a726b1abba91dbbf761e295/previews/6a726b1abba91dbbf761e2c2/download/image.webp)

cards.title: 咏春
cards.body:
## 推荐配装
咏春推荐6英尺至6英尺11英寸的高个角色，以尽量发挥攻击距离、基础伤害与间距控制。更长的攻击范围能帮助使用者在双方尚未展开连段时有效拉近距离、控制交战节奏，并在较安全的距离快速反击。高个角色更高的生命值，也能提高高强度近身换血中的存活能力。实战中，咏春依靠自身基础特性与数值，把防守转化为高压进攻。

高个能够提供较好的距离与伤害输出；偏好更快移动、更小受击范围和更短冷却，以持续压制对手的玩家，也可以选择4英尺11英寸至5英尺3英寸的矮个。中等身高不推荐使用咏春，因为均衡数值无法充分发挥最大攻击距离或最高机动性中的任何一端。

## 重击（反击）
基础冷却7.5秒。

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a77a7ca9dcdcebc2a9c198a/attachments/6a9c92ec4fead9b14a71c0f2/previews/6a9c92ec4fead9b14a71c159/download/image.webp)

## Recommended Build:

‌

For **WingChun**, a **tall build** **(6’0”–6’11”)** is recommended to **maximize overall reach, base damage, and spacing control.** The extended reach allows WingChun users to **effectively bridge distance in neutral, control the pace of combat, and execute rapid counter-strikes from a safer range.** In addition, **the larger health pool of a taller build boosts overall survivability** during high-intensity close-range trades. In combat, **WingChun** relies on its specific base traits and stats to **convert defensive play into high-pressure offensive momentum**.

While **tall builds** deliver **optimal range and damage output**, **short builds (4’11”–5’3”)** serve as a viable alternative for players who prefer **faster movement speed, smaller hitboxes, and shorter cooldowns** to maintain relentless pressure. Conversely, **medium builds are not recommended for WingChun**, as their balanced stats fail to capitalize on either **maximum reach or maximum agility**.

perks.title: 黐手
perks.body: 重击改为进入招架姿态。抵消接下来命中自己的那次攻击，再以一套反击连段回应。

perks.title: 快手
perks.body: 轻击攻击速度提高6%，代价是每次命中的伤害减少0.2。

perks.title: 终结一击
perks.body: 连段中的最后一段轻击造成1.5倍伤害。

perks.title: 防御穿透 III
perks.body: 攻击被普通格挡后，仍会造成原伤害20%的削血伤害。

perks.title: 稳固 I
perks.body: 架势抗性提高10%，格挡时损失的架势更少。

perks.title: 韧性 I
perks.body: 双方轻击相撞时，有15%概率进入抓取缠斗。

notes: v13更新后，成功触发反击时，反击连段全程具有无敌帧。
快手天赋的基础截图写6%，战斗天赋卡正文写8%，两处数值不同。

cards.title: 关于学乱
cards.body: Gakuran 是一款以2000年代日本为背景的校园日常游戏，围绕写实的角色定制、社交互动和校园角色扮演展开。
cards.original: Gakuran is a 2000’s Japanese slice of life game centered around realistic character customization, social interaction, and school roleplay.

cards.title: 风格增益
cards.body: 每种风格都有一组特性，同一风格的这组特性始终相同。
cards.original: Every style comes with an array of traits that are always the same with that style.

cards.title: 自动售货机
cards.body:
走到自动售货机前，按互动键（E／手柄X键／□键／触屏点击），即可打开购买界面。

购买饮料需要日元，可以通过YenApp转账或在Indeed应用中找工作获得。

点击写有“押す”（按下）的灰色按钮即可购买饮料。

每罐饮料可以使用10次，之后就会变空。
cards.original:
To use vending machines, you must first walk up to it and press the interact button (E/X Button/Square/Tap) which will greet you with UI similar to if not this:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516762aa1c009607cec9db/attachments/6a725f1ce4161d2b9e9d8b22/previews/6a725f1ee4161d2b9e9d918c/download/image.webp)

It's important to note that in order to purchase drinks yen is required, which can be obtained through a YenApp transfer or working a job on the Indeed app.

To purchase a drink just click the gray button containing the characters “押す”

Drinks have exactly 10 usages before becoming empty.

cards.title: 小更新
cards.body:
### 战斗
1. 击倒对手后的生命恢复：40%提高至70%。
2. 修复Jason的重击（M2）在PvP关闭时仍会把人甩飞的问题。

### 音乐
1. 每首歌结束后，会弹出投票，询问这首歌对你所用乐器的难度。投票后可以查看其他人的选择；歌曲列表也会显示社区票选难度。

### 私人服务器
- 服主可以在服务器设置中粘贴Roblox群组链接或ID，为服务器关联任意群组。
- 可限制加入资格为某个群组职位及以上，例如“Students”及以上。低于该职位或不属于群组的人，即使持有邀请码也无法进入。
- 可将群组职位关联到自定义角色，拥有对应群组等级的玩家会自动分配角色。手动授予的角色仍会保留。
- 可以重新生成或更改私人服务器邀请码。旧码立即失效，角色、封禁和全部设置保持不变。
- 上述功能大部分位于菜单的“私人服务器（Private Servers）”栏目。

### 体育
1. 排球：从前排起跳时，减少空中的滑行距离。
2. 排球：队友在空中相互撞到时，会进入布娃娃倒地状态。

### 通用
1. 修复近距离在板上绘画时粉笔不可见的问题。
2. 增加额外追踪记录，以排查其他导致帧率下降、服务器卡顿或停顿的原因。

cards.title: v13.00（#30）万圣节第二阶段
cards.english: 学乱  Gakuran  Update  v13.00(#30) 🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE P2!!
cards.body:
@everyone

## 万圣节第二阶段（持续至11月8日）
- 糖果店新增幽灵扭蛋机，可转出万圣节物品。
- 先消耗剩余糖果，糖果用完后改为消耗重抽次数。
- 可单抽或十连，每次抽取都给御札（ofuda），可用御札兑换指定奖品。
- 奖品图鉴中的内容在抽中前均显示为“???”。
- 抽得足够多后保证获得大奖。
- 新增限时战斗风格Jason与Scarecrow。
- 新增11套万圣节服装，包括vamp、skeleton、jester、scarecrow、shadow、autumn等。
- 新增10种万圣节脸部，包括josuke、jotaro、vamp、2hollis等。
- 抽中的风格、服装和脸部永久属于你；商店本身会在活动结束后离开。
- 已无法继续获得糖果，讨糖与七大不可思议均已结束。

## 战斗
- 增强高个角色的伤害、生命值与攻击距离。
- 为Kure、合气道、踢拳、极真、突击者、重拳手和CQC增加觉醒／V2。
- Kure V2：抓住对手，举起后砸向地面。
- 合气道V2：反击架势将对手翻过头顶，再用上勾拳打飞。
- CQC V2：反击架势抓住打入架势的目标，并将其摔下。
- 所有已有V2获得全新的重击特效与音效。
- 倒地后可以放弃并在学校重生：长按X；手柄长按Y；手机长按对应按钮。
- Ali：闪避重击拥有独立冷却，不能再与普通重击连锁。
- 摔跤：震荡效果持续时间缩短30%。
- 基础拳击重击冷却从7秒提高至9秒；打空对手会使自己眩晕。
- 拳击重击无敌帧增加短暂前摇，不再即时生效。
- 拳击V2重击每拳的格挡削减伤害由75%降至25%。
- 拳击V2重击连打不再造成穿透格挡的伤害。
- 完美模仿的重击现在只有踢击部分可以被招架。
- 咏春成功触发反击后，整个连段期间都具有无敌帧。
- 抓取一结束即可招架。
- 自己轻击后立刻格挡可以正常生效；格挡也能拦住来自上方或下方的攻击。
- NPC可以在连段中招架。
- PvP关闭时不能终结倒地玩家。
- 眩晕时不能再跳跃。

## 世界
- 城镇的“まんが堂”新增漫画商店：在门口取篮子，从任意书架挑漫画，再向店员付款，即可带回家阅读。
- 音乐室新增12首歌曲：A Fool Moon Night、ALL MY FELLAS、An Italian Magician Be Like、Connect、Crescent:Letter、Flyburg and Endroll、Friends、Intersect Thunderbolt、Snow halation、Solitary Industrial Revolution、Worldwide Wander、ametsuchi。

## 菜单与档案
- 新增重抽锁：每个可重抽属性旁有挂锁，锁定后不能被意外抽走。
- 手机DECO商店扭蛋机新增手机挂件；翻盖手机最多可挂3个挂件，并可调整位置。
- 属性（Stats）页新增滑板贴纸，可像手机DECO一样装饰滑板。
- 滑板或手机DECO商店新增第二套开发者Q版贴纸包（2nd Developers Chibi Pack）。
- 每日奖励的游玩时间现在可以跨服务器累计。

## 体育
- 美式橄榄球新增射门得分，包括定点射门、附加分等。
- 私人服务器为所有体育项目新增裁判面板，用于联赛。
- 美式橄榄球飞扑冷却提高，并有多项改进与修复。
- 篮球持球时新增队友传球指示。
- 削弱篮球封盖。
- 篮球动作现在会消耗体力。
- 所有篮球投篮条在屏幕上移动的距离相同。
- 篮球计分板支持三位数分数。

## 性能
- 大幅加强优化，这次应该能明显感受到。
- 手机端加载负担显著降低，应该能减少加载界面崩溃。

## 修复
- 修复在服务器待一段时间后，角色卡在某个姿势的问题。
- 修复关闭VFX后，治疗、Kure背水一战与Hakari黑闪特效仍显示的问题。
- 修复每日奖励计时器卡在4分钟、必须重新加入的问题。
- 修复在滑板上携带倒地玩家的问题。
- 修复烟花、雪球将自己与携带的倒地玩家弹飞的问题。
- 修复第一人称时属性页把头发显示为白色的问题。
- 修复牵手对象不走路或奔跑的问题。
- 修复开始动作时跳跃导致卡在空中的问题。
- 修复教师与职员年龄每次重生翻倍，变成128岁、256岁或无限岁的问题。
- 修复玩家在战斗中途隐形的问题。
- 修复关闭植被后仍显示树叶的问题。
- 修复死亡后Shift锁仍保持开启的问题。
- 修复在战斗中躲进出租车的问题。
- 修复觉醒任务对部分NPC的命中不计数的问题。
- 修复主机与经典UI中的觉醒按钮。
- 修复二楼桌椅没有碰撞的问题。
- 修复打开漫画后看起来像两块硬板、其中一页穿模的问题，现在有真正的书页。

cards.title: v11.00（#29）万圣节之夜
cards.english: 学乱  Gakuran  Update  v11.00(#29) 🎃 HALLOWEEN NIGHTS!!(until Oct 31, 22:00 CET)
cards.body:
活动持续至10月31日22:00（CET）。

## 西片高中七大不可思议
- 午夜过后，学校开始苏醒：钢琴自行弹奏，第13级台阶出现，Hanako从第三间隔间敲门，人体模型开始行走，雕像数数，镜子在3:33打开，旧班级合影里多出一个人。
- 每个怪谈都会给予糖果与纪念品，找齐七个可获得大量额外奖励。
- 此后还有第八个：找齐全部七个后，3-C教室里有什么在等着你。
- 糖果店提供传闻、剧情与线索：八重是谁，1969年发生了什么？
- 启动一个怪谈时，附近所有人都会收到加入邀请。

## 不给糖就捣蛋
- 敲响城镇住家的门，真实住户会开门给糖；但并非每户都友善。
- 也可以用卫生纸捣乱；住户可能冲出来夺回你的糖，或与你打架。
- 穿戴万圣节物品可获得装扮加成，讨糖所得最多提高75%。
- 糖果店出售面具、服装、角、翅膀、尾巴、耳朵等，也包括怪谈纪念品。
- 万圣节物品会在万圣节当晚离店，随后商店转入提供永久奖励的第二阶段。糖果可以保留到下一阶段，记得存一些。
- 新增Kuchisake-onna，击败她可得10次重抽；另有校门僵尸袭击、试胆与灵魂游行。
- 新增万圣节装饰：南瓜、坩埚、蛛网，以及学校上空的血月。

## 战斗与私人服务器
- 新增可破坏物：打架会打碎窗户，撞倒椅子、长凳、垃圾桶、路锥与屋顶花盆；它们会自行复原。
- 私人服务器面板的模式（MODES）页新增帮派战争、地盘争夺、袭击、最后帮派生存、Taiman与Hatatori模式。
- 完美模仿：拳击速度再次加快，抓取前摇不再会被打断。
- 三岛：拳击速度再次加快。
- 觉醒体术：重击出手加快。
- 空手道：重击伤害略降，攻击距离恢复正常，霸体仅保留在觉醒V2。
- Hakari：矮个角色的重击不再接近瞬发。
- 合气道与Hikaken：高个角色出拳略慢。
- 觉醒拳击重击冷却从7秒提高至10秒。
- Taiman出现频率降低，约每8至15分钟一次。

## 世界与表现
- 新增脚底贴地（实验性功能）。
- 汽车不再无限等待站在路上的人。
- 重做第一人称眼罩视觉表现。
- 手机端减少远处交通车辆的绘制，提高帧率。

## 体育
- 手机新增体育排队（Sports Queue）应用，可全球匹配篮球、足球与排球。
- 自动比赛开场采用电视转播式呈现，包括介绍、球员卡与精彩片段回放。
- 重做足球物理并新增足球音效。
- 足球场面积增加15%。
- 降低NPC守门员难度。
- 弧线球现在只会弯曲，不再飞得更远。
- 奔跑时踢球、铲球与守门员扑救的前向距离略增。

## 音乐与菜单
- 新增19首节奏歌曲：A Turtle's Heart、Ash Again、Asphyxia、Bury The Light、Cubibibibism、Drank-Dazed、Esok、Extradimensional Cosmic Phenomenon、Far Away Light、Figure09、I Want You Back、Last Night on Earth、love.、Nevermind、out of bed、Some Things Never Change、Sometimes、The Whole Blue World、Wish to Drown。
- 歌曲轮盘可按A-Z、最新、难度与时长排序。
- 音乐播放器新增14首歌。
- 菜单新增自由镜头按钮。
- 每日奖励采用新外观。
- 服务器列表显示各服务器所在地。
- 更改性别或把猫耳重抽掉之前，需要二次确认；此项提前上线。

## 修复
- 修复门、烤架、冰箱等自定义交互提示不显示、失效，或手机上点击失效的问题。
- 修复站在马桶上时玩家相互不可见的问题。
- 修复警察追逐永不结束的问题。
- 修复玩家移动时跳位、滑行或卡顿的问题。
- 修复足球守门员扑救在延迟下回弹的问题。
- 修复抓取落败后被向前推，而非向后推的问题。
- 修复两份头发共用一种颜色的问题。
- 修复私人服务器安全区更改必须走到其他区域才生效的问题。
- 修复手机端无法放下花朵的问题。

cards.title: 体验优化更新 #4
cards.body:
## 外观与音乐
- 2个发型槽位，可分别重抽颜色、切换可见性，或让两份头发共用同一颜色。
- 每类饰品增加到2个槽位，可分别切换可见性；手臂饰品可以换到另一只手臂。
- 新增97款发型。女性：欧洲裔23、日本裔9、非洲裔7、印度裔7、中东裔5、拉丁裔3。男性：欧洲裔20、拉丁裔12、非洲裔10、日本裔8、印度裔3、中东裔3。
- 新增27件饰品：头部10、脸部4、颈部4、手臂5、腰部2、背部2。
- 新增5首节奏歌曲：Perfect Pair（beabadoobee）、A Like Supreme（SAMURAI）、Hana ni Natte（Binou SZ）、Raise Up Your Bat!（Tricky Tobias）、Whispers in the Garth（Sadder Days）。
- 不同角色槽位可以使用不同名字与姓氏。

## 战斗与平衡
- Hikaken、合气道、完美模仿的轻击减速，矮个角色不再接近瞬发。
- 踢拳轻击现在在动画实际接触时命中，不再提前判定。
- Kure重击伤害降低，命中后只提供较短的无法招架窗口，大约可接2次轻击，而不再免费接一整套连段。
- 空手道重击伤害提高、距离加长，前摇不能被打断。
- 龙的重击打空不再使自己倒地，只会短暂减速；原地重击伤害略增。
- Kure或龙重击打空后，现在会按预期短暂减速。
- Jin出拳更快，重击伤害更高、冷却更短。
- Jin新增特效：每击红色拖尾、命中红色闪电、完整的电影式重击演出，最后一击带红色冲击帧。
- Jin的天赋electric wind、zanshin、pressure触发时会闪光。
- 合气道反击新增短暂启动时间，不再能在第一帧反击。
- 合气道反击架势更易辨认：生效时有蓝色闪光、发光与架势音效。
- 咏春反击命中后，目标眩晕足够久，可以再接2击。
- 觉醒拳击重击恢复前摇与前两击的无敌帧。
- 空手道觉醒需要的Taiman胜场由10场降至5场。

## 修复
- 修复觉醒风格未格挡时仍会被一击破防的问题。
- 更新Kure震荡天赋描述，现在显示0.9秒；更新三岛震荡描述，现在明确重击第二击会造成布娃娃倒地，以准确反映效果。
- 较新的风格Jin、体术、合气道、Hikaken、Giovanna现在正确遵循战斗音量滑块。
- 觉醒风格的声音现在正确遵循战斗音量滑块。
- 雪球声音现在受主音量与音效音量设置影响。
- 修复园艺经验漏洞。

## 雪
- 战斗中雪球不再把你撞倒。
- 不能在室内或安全区投掷、携带雪球；进入这些区域时雪球会融化。

## 体育
- 新增体育特质：一个主要特质与一个副特质，可用日元重抽；副特质仅发挥75%的强度。
- 每次篮球出手后，屏幕顶部显示投篮反馈。
- 重做投篮干扰与抢断。
- 重画篮球场线，为底角留出更多空间。
- 排球爆头：强力扣球或发球击中接球者面部时，球可能从头上弹开，较为罕见。

## 其他
- 实验性改进：附近玩家移动显示的延迟降低，主要为战斗服务，也可能难以察觉。
cards.original:
- 2 hair slots (can roll separate color for each, and can toggle visibility or link both hairs to same color)
- 2 slots for each accessory type (+ can toggle visibility of either)
  - able to swap which arm an arm accessory goes on
- 97 new hairs
  - females: 23 European, 9 Japanese, 7 African, 7 Indian, 5 Middle Eastern, 3 Latina
  - males: 20 European, 12 Latino, 10 African, 8 Japanese, 3 Indian, 3 Middle Eastern
- 27 new accessories
  - 10 head, 4 face, 4 neck, 5 arm, 2 waist, 2 back
- 5 new rhythm songs:
  - Perfect Pair (beabadoobee), A Like Supreme (SAMURAI), Hana ni Natte (Binou SZ), Raise Up Your Bat! (Tricky Tobias), Whispers in the Garth (Sadder Days)

# slots able to have different first & last names

# Combat / balance

- hikaken, aikido and perfect copy m1s are slower, they're no longer near-instant at short heights
- kickboxing m1s now hit when the animation actually connects instead of before it
- kure crit does less damage and only gives a short no-parry window after landing it (about 2 m1s instead of a free full combo)
- karate crit hits harder, reaches further and can't be interrupted during the windup
- dragon missing its crit no longer knocks you down, you're just slowed for a moment, and the standing crit hits a bit harder
- missing a kure or dragon crit now actually slows you down for a moment like it was meant to
- jin's punches come out faster, its crit hits harder and comes back sooner
- jin has new effects: red trails on every strike, red lightning on hits, and a full cinematic crit with a red impact frame on the final blow
- jin's perks now flash when they trigger (electric wind, zanshin, pressure)
- aikido's counter now has a short startup, so it can't counter on the very first frame
- aikido's counter stance is easy to spot now: a blue flash, a glow and a stance sound while it's live
- wing chun: landing your counter leaves them stunned long enough for 2 follow-up hits
- awakened boxing's crit has its i-frames back for the windup and the first two strikes
- karate awakening now needs 5 taiman wins instead of 10

# Fixes

- Fixed: awakened styles no longer get guard broken by a single hit when not blocking
- Updated: perk descriptions for Kure's concussive (now shows 0.9s) and Mishima's concussive (now states the second crit hit ragdolls) to accurately reflect their effects
- Fixed: newer styles (jin, taijutsu, aikido, hikaken, giovanna) now correctly follow the combat volume slider
- Fixed: awakened style sounds now respond to the combat volume slider
- Fixed: snowball sounds are now affected by your master and sound effects volume settings
- Fixed: gardening XP exploit

# Snow

- Snowballs no longer knock you over during combat
- Snowballs cannot be thrown or carried indoors or in safe zones; they now melt when entering these areas

# SPORTS

- Sport Traits: a Primary and a Sub trait for sports (rollable with yen) (subtraits only work at 75% strength)
- Basketball shot feedback at the top of the screen on every shot

# Contest & steals reworked

# basketball court lines remade for more space in the corners

- Volleyball headshots: a hard spike or serve at a receiver's face bounces off their head (rare)

# MISC

# (experimental) players near you move with less of a delay (intended for combat, u might not even notice it)

cards.title: v10.00（#28）圣杯更新
cards.body:
### 新战斗风格
- ???：完美模仿（Perfect Copy）。
- 史诗：合气道（Aikido）。
- 少见：体术（Taijutsu）。
- 少见：Hikaken。
- 少见：Giovanna。

### 风格觉醒
- 8种风格可觉醒：拳击、空手道、缅甸拳、体术、Jin、Hakari、摔跤、泰拳。
- 每种风格有3个觉醒阶段，只显示第一阶段，其余需要自己摸索。
- 留意角色的心声，它会告诉你方向是否正确。
- 可在属性页的“精通阶段（Mastery Stage）”与觉醒页面追踪。
- 更多风格将很快开放觉醒。
- “我还没有完全掌握它。”

### 社团
- 新增4个社团，可在社团房间的公告板加入。
- 生物社：在显微镜下寻找标本，祝你能找到水熊虫。
- 书法社：按笔画描摹真实汉字，最佳作品会挂在桌上。
- 天文社：通过望远镜连出真实夜空中的星座，仅限夜间且天空晴朗。
- 园艺社：认领屋顶花圃，以真实时间种植8种植物。
- 园艺需要浇水，否则植物会枯萎；可剪花束、携带盆栽、送花或把花戴在头发上。
- 部分植物会与你互动：向日葵跟随你，含羞草收缩，捕蝇草会咬人。
- 每个社团有4级职级、社团制服，以及每周前三排行榜，发放重抽次数与日元奖励。
- 社团房间属于安全区。

### 重抽
- 新增保底系统，涵盖???风格、???制服、???脸部与独特滑板板面。
- 选择目标后，到保底时先判定50/50；若未抽中，下次保底保证目标。
- 菜单新增每日奖励日历。
- 每天登录可领重抽次数与日元，第7、14、21天可抽福袋。
- 当月每天都领取可获得全勤月福袋，有机会抽到随机???物品。
- 新增稀有发色演出：粉彩粉、冰川蓝与白色。

### 战斗
- 新增可重抽的终结动作，可在属性页预览。
- 新增翻越与攀边。

### 世界与事件
- 新增季节，世界随游戏内日历经历冬、春、夏、秋。
- 包括降雪、季节树木与光照，冬季不下雨。
- 冬季可打雪仗。
- 新增街头NPC事件：帮派地盘、帮派群架、敌校袭击、暴走族集会与群袭（HORDE）。
- 新增Taiman，NPC会向你发起一对一约战。
- 新增车辆事件：活动车与摩托集会。
- 新增出租车：在街边招车、选择目的地，按计价器付款。
- 可以购买、投掷与燃放烟花。
- 学校窗户可开关。

### 体育
- 新体育场提供完整足球比赛，包含队伍、NPC球员、守门员模式与统计。
- 记录足球、篮球、排球统计，体育馆公告板显示生涯记录。
- 可在设置中选择HUD外观：17种篮球投篮条、新排球力量条与足球HUD样式。
- 新增体育HUD布局编辑器，可以自由摆放HUD。
- 新增排球网物理效果。

### 社交与动作
- 新增猜拳双人动作，NPC也会与你玩。
- 新增抛硬币与掷骰手势。
- 新增乐队模式，可与其他人合奏组建乐队。
- 提供乐队HUD、舞台镜头与实时成绩，房间里的人可以观看演奏。
- 手机新增46首歌曲。
- 更新手机游戏。
cards.original:

- Uncommon — Hikaken

cards.title: 体验优化更新 #3
cards.body:
## 画面、界面与设置
- 新增角色剔除，非常实验性，用于优化；可在图形设置调整距离。
- 约70%的游戏内发型加入头发物理，非常实验性，长发更明显。
- 为篮球网、排球网、排球标志杆与校旗增加物理效果。
- 重画用于切换UI模式的Q版角色图。
- 重做乐器UI。
- 菜单支持手柄：B关闭当前菜单，方向键或左摇杆控制滑块。
- VFX强度设置也会降低屏幕震动、命中模糊与闪屏。
- 关闭（Off）会完全移除这些效果；低（Low）仅在自己身上显示光环、残影等较重的特效。
- 名牌、NPC名牌、渲染距离与夜间主题设置会跨会话保存。
- 玩家列表文字加大。
- 修复属性页关闭按钮位置错误；重抽族裔后属性页现在会更新。

## 战斗
- 不再能穿过楼板打到人。
- 修复被摔击的玩家沉入地板的问题。
- 修复格挡有时只在自己屏幕显示、实际未生效的问题。
- 修复松开按键后，格挡或长按轻击有时仍卡住的问题。
- 长按M1时再轻点M1，不再打出两拳。
- 缩小龙奔跑重击的判定范围。
- Jin的Counter Force蓄力现在具有霸体。
- 铁之决意（Iron Resolve）仅在一次重击（M2）的第一击无视招架。

## 其他
- 学校与室内体育馆的门可以推开。
- 手机镜头锁定不再锁住倒地或死亡玩家，受击也不会抢走锁定目标。
- 战斗中隐藏手机小地图。
- 加载缓慢的节奏歌曲不再立刻失败。
- 带吉他或贝斯走得太远时，乐器会回到架上。
- Shift锁不再干扰回放镜头。

## 私人服务器
- 如果服主拥有高级权限，访客也能使用高级角色工具。
- 可以分配角色的人，现在可以查看角色列表。
- 玩家页的人员列表移到工具下方。

## 体育
- 篮球比赛新增犯规与罚球；仅4对4及以上有罚球，3对3改为界外发球。
- 重做篮球物理。
- 室内体育馆新增公告板，展示篮球与排球生涯累计数据及场均数据，仅靠近时可见。
- 修复手机端开启篮球模式后无法奔跑的问题。
- 附近有倒地玩家时，终结与搬运操作不再切换篮球／排球模式。
- 精彩即时回放仅向实际在场地的人显示。
- 球架颜色轮盘可以在更远距离打开，并支持手柄。
cards.original:
- Character culling (very experimental, for optimization; distance config in graphics settings)
- Hair physics on about 70% of hairs ingame (very experimental, more noticeable on longer hairs)
  - New physics for basketball nets, volleyball nets, volleyball antenna, and school flag

# Chibi sprites for switching UI mode redrawn

# UI for music instruments remade

- Controller support for menus (B closes whatever menu is open, sliders move with d-pad/left stick)
- VFX intensity setting now also lowers screen shake, hit blur & screen flashes

# Off removes them completely, Low only shows heavy effects like auras & afterimages on yourself

- Nametags, NPC nametags, render distance & night theme settings now save between sessions

# Player list text made bigger

# Fixed stats close button being in the wrong spot; ethnicity rerolls now update in stats

\\ COMBAT //

# Can no longer hit people through floors

# Fixed slammed players sinking through the floor

# Fixed block sometimes showing on your screen without actually going through

# Fixed block & held M1 sometimes getting stuck after letting go

# Tapping M1 while holding it no longer throws two punches

# Dragon sprint M2 hitbox made smaller

# Jin counter force charge now has hyper armor

# Iron Resolve only ignores parries on the first hit of an M2

\\ MISC //

# Made the school & indoor gymnasium doors pushable

# Mobile camera lock no longer locks onto knocked/dead players, and getting hit no longer steals your lock

# Phone minimap hides while in combat

# Slow loading rhythm songs no longer instantly fail

# Guitar/bass go back to the rack if you walk too far with them

# Shift lock no longer messes with the camera during replays

\\ PRIVATE SERVERS //

# Players tab roster moved below the tools

\\ SPORTS //

cards.title: v9.00（#27）更新
cards.body:
## 新增
- 1种新???风格：Jin。
- 1种新传说风格：龙（Dragon）。
- 女仆咖啡厅与女仆工作。
- 手机新增地图（Maps）应用。可查看地点；打开后缩小手机可保留小地图；可查看朋友的位置，并在设置中开关，另有其他功能。
- 新增2个双人动作：搬运（Carry）与Ma Embaro。
- 新增5套男女通用制服。
- 乐器新增7首歌曲：Silent Desert、Animal I Have Become、If You Can't Hang、Kakero、Young Girl A、Break Stuff、Insomniac。

## 战斗
- 三岛轻击速度降低16%，移除Unbothered天赋。
- 空手道轻击速度降低8%。
- 泰拳轻击速度降低6%。
- Kure轻击速度降低6%。
- Hakari轻击速度降低3%。
- Hakari的Momentum Rush触发时增加音效。

## 体育
- 体育馆有概率开启NPC体育表演赛，玩家可以加入并担任某个位置。
- 篮球与排球在得分或精彩表现后播放即时回放。
- 篮球／排球模式下尝试打开动作轮盘，会改为打开战术呼喊菜单。
- 自动追踪排球与篮球统计。
- 自动比赛结束后展示完整数据表。
- 篮球数据：得分、投篮命中、命中率、三分、篮板（含进攻篮板）、助攻、抢断、盖帽、失误、效率值。
- 排球数据：扣球得分、进攻失误、总进攻次数、扣球得分率、进攻效率、助攻、发球直接得分、发球失误、救球、拦死、拦网触球、处理球失误。
- 数据表底部解释每项统计的定义。

## 画面与声音
- 完全重做所有UI，加入时会询问是否启用，也可在设置切换。
- 新增5种男性脸部。
- 新增5种女性脸部。
- 聊天新增短促人声音效，可在设置调整音量。
- 新增冲刺待机动画，原地按住冲刺即可触发。

## 私人服务器
- 私人服务器页新增语音聊天栏目。
- 听觉范围（Hearing Range）滑块设置能听到玩家的最远距离，也可以保留默认值。
- 区域语音（Area Based Voice Chat）开关启用后，只能听到同一房间／区域的人。
- 两项设置随服务器保存；新增“管理语音聊天（Manage Voice Chat）”权限，允许角色更改。
- 玩家页新增服务器封禁列表，显示被封者、封禁执行者、剩余时间与原因，每项有解封按钮。
- 角色层级调整成为一项权限。任何有“管理角色（Manage Roles）”权限的人都能调整角色顺序，不再只限服主。
- 只能移动低于自身的角色，不能移动自己这一等级或更高等级。
- 可以在属性页制服槽位下方的额外卡片中，选择穿哪套角色制服。
- 选择会在该私人服务器中保存，角色变化后清除。
- 服主离线时创建或编辑的角色，不会在服主回来后还原。
- 服主离线时重命名或删除角色，也会保留更改，不再重新出现。
- 从玩家资料页授予的面板权限，现在离开再加入仍保留。
- 对某个玩家设置的自由镜头范围也会保留。

## 修复
- 修复摔跤摔击动画不同步。
- 修复刚登上滑板就举起拳头，能够在滑板上战斗的问题。
- 修复手臂饰品位置错误。
- 快速连发两条消息时，现在会排队播放，而不是同时发声。
- 连续约3次重抽后，旁白会自行静音。
- 在聊天框输入时，战术呼喊轮盘不再打开。
- 修复排球有时不可见的问题。
- 修复游戏拒绝的一次挥击仍占用本方三次触球的问题。
- 修复扑进球网后可以打到对面球的问题。
- 修复隐形后飞入墙内，或打开自由镜头／第一人称，导致自己的角色重新可见的问题。

cards.title: v8.200（#26）更新
cards.body:
## 学乱Gakuran更新（#26）
- 商店员工现在会准备DEMAE外送订单。
- 在岗员工准备外送订单可获得奖金，不能通过准备自己的订单赚取奖金。
- NPC现在也能通过DEMAE点餐，订单会定期出现，让外送员保持忙碌。
- 新增Dante's Yakiniku工作。
- 降低报社工作报酬。
- 室内体育馆扩大25%，篮球与排球场空间大幅增加。

## 战斗风格
- 重做摔跤。
- 第4段轻击的击退，不再把站在自己上方的人弹飞。
- 此前各种风格在楼梯、路缘或跳跃中挨到攻击时，都可能把人打飞。

## 新地点
- 新增隐蔽的地下俱乐部Club Akuma。
- 提供3种工作：酒吧员工、安保与乐手。

## 篮球
- 重做上篮、扣篮、防守、传球等篮球动画。
- 手柄现在可向队友高抛传球：按住L1加一个方向键。
- 对正在运球的人尝试抢断，可能被晃倒，高个更容易发生。
- 持球者移动速度现在由身高决定。
- 改进传球：球不再穿过身体、到了背后才回到手中；接球时会正确把你带到接球点；被传球前刚开始冲刺，会把动量带得更远。

## 排球
- 略微改进视觉特效。

### 咏春
- 反击落空后的破绽由0.6秒延长至1.2秒。
- 重击冷却由7.5秒提高至9秒。
- 被连击时不再能使用重击（M2）。

### 极真
- 减伤由15%降至10%。
- 重击冷却由7秒提高至10秒。
- 铁躯（Iron Body）与反击（Counterstrike）天赋替换为重击霸体。

### 拳击
- 新增变换架势（Switch Stance）天赋。

### CQC
- 近距离（Close Quarters）天赋替换为摧架之力 III（Crushing Force III）。

### 卡波耶拉
- 新增摧架之力 I（Crushing Force I），架势伤害提高10%。

### Kure
- 生命值低于25%时，背水一战特效重新可见。

## 战斗表现与界面
- 每种战斗风格都有独立挥击拖尾。
- 所有风格与部分天赋新增VFX，可在设置关闭。
- 重做战斗天赋页面。点击天赋可打开详情；分级天赋会列出全部等级，并标明当前等级。

## 自定义
- 储物柜可保存两套完整外观并切换；找到储物柜即可随时更换。
- 新增自动重抽，可以自动追求某个稀有度。
- 新增8套制服：3套通用、2套男性、3套女性。
- 重画Lonecat、Snowy Woodland、Galaxy Board板面。

## 动作
- 新增2个双人动作：碰拳、击掌。
- 新增2个双人移动动作：牵引、背人。
- 新增4个普通动作：打哈欠（手势）、2种伸展（运动）、摇摆（姿势）。
- 佩戴手表时可用看表手势。
- 拾取物品时播放伸手动作。

## 音乐
- 吉他与贝斯增加一些额外动画。
- Club Akuma观众只有在完整演奏一首歌后才会欢呼。

## 界面与设置
- 设置新增音量控制，主音量、音乐、环境、战斗、脚步、语音聊天等分别设滑块。

cards.title: 游戏称号
cards.body:
## 游戏创始人
这是最初提出游戏构想并将其实现的人，称号仅由本人持有。它与拥有者称号没有很大的区别，主要是用于区分身份的独有称号。

## 拥有者
游戏的拥有者，对添加、移除、削弱内容等决定有最终决定权。拥有全部权限，可以执行所有操作。

## 开发者
与拥有者共同制作游戏的人，各有分工，包括视觉特效、动画、战斗风格、人物介绍、地图等。开发者能赋予自己悟空等专属能力，也能开启僵尸感染或 Freddy 噩梦等特殊事件。

## 经理
负责管理 Discord 服务器，包括创建频道、确保各功能正常运行、决定晋升，以及制定总体允许和禁止事项。

## 高级工作人员
与经理一起处理相对次要的事务，管理帮助人员等团队，并与经理共同决定后续晋升。他们是服务器的观察者与高级管理人员，但不能像开发者那样召唤各种事件。他们负责照顾整个社区，也有使用死亡笔记的权限。

## 工作人员
负责让游戏免受外挂影响，处理游戏内各种违规情况，包括不当名字、外挂，以及可能威胁游戏或不允许进入游戏的人。他们也处理支持服务器的工单，并决定是否解除封禁；他们是少数获准使用死亡笔记的人。

## 见习工作人员
正在接受培训、证明自己值得信任的工作人员，主要处理 Discord 服务器内的基础管理，例如对违规者警告、封禁或禁言。他们在游戏内也有少量权限，如传送和隐身，以便发现外挂者后转交正式工作人员处理。

## 贡献者
对游戏及其开发作出重要贡献的人，例如制作滑板图案、游戏模式、机器人或海报等。游戏早期开发阶段较常授予这一身份，目前已较难获得。

## 测试员
更新前集中测试各种可能的情况，并在正式发布前向开发者报告问题。他们负责寻找重大漏洞、可滥用问题、小错误、延迟、质量问题，以及任何异常表现。问题很多，更新中未修复所有小错误不代表团队不知道，只是来不及修复，会留到其他更新处理。

## 测试负责人
负责管理测试员，确保不泄露内容、发放称号并挑选测试员。他们安排集合测试时间，也确保拥有者获知重大漏洞。该称号由2人持有，分别负责团队的不同事务。

## 美术经理
管理服务器中的美术创作者，举办专属创作活动与赠奖，并确保发布作品的人遵守美术规范。他们决定谁能取得美术创作者身份。作为工作回报，他们可以调整自己的角色设定，且只限自己，因此可能拥有独特、富有创意的角色。

## 活动主持
负责各类活动，包括在 Gakuran 主服务器举办有奖励的娱乐活动，在竞技服务器举办其他活动，寻找创意、讨论玩家想要什么，并相互沟通，让活动尽可能有趣且顺利进行，避免被人破坏。打算在服务器赠奖频道举办赠奖时，也应联系他们。

## 活动经理
决定活动安排，在活动开始前作最终选择。他们挑选活动主持、解释规则、列出黑名单人员，并管理整个活动团队。作为回报，他们也能调整自己的角色设定，让角色适合特定活动。

## 谱面经理
负责歌曲内容，决定哪些曲目加入音游，管理谱面服务器并挑选制谱团队成员。该称号仅由1人持有。

## 歌曲制谱师
制作音游曲目及其玩法，包括谱面、难度安排，以及让每个音符对应游戏内使用的按键。他们投入大量精力，让歌曲尽可能好玩、流畅。

## Japanify 音乐人称号
授予演唱者。他们用自己的声音演唱原创歌曲，随后加入游戏，与制谱师负责节奏玩法的工作有所区别。这个称号少见地拥有多种变体，名称取自音乐人原本的 Spotify 名称，方便玩家搜索并支持他们。也有少量类似知名歌手的称号，授予声音相似者或活动获胜者；其中2人没有亲自演唱，也没有原创 Spotify 账号，只是赢得这类称号后形成的小玩笑。

## Trello 团队
制作并撰写本看板的人。每次更新后维护新资料，确保玩家及时了解内容。约20人持有这个称号，他们熟悉大部分游戏内容，可以回答问题；遇到他们时也能提出看板建议。他们像帮助人员一样，致力于让玩家更容易理解游戏。

## Trello 经理
管理整个 Trello，看板公告、团队安排，以及资料是否重要到应加入看板等事项由其决定。称号仅由1人持有，也由其最终决定谁能加入团队、谁能编写看板。

## 大学教授
Gakuran University 服务器的工作人员，负责为内容创作者举办活动、服务器管理，以及回答内容创作者相关问题、维持秩序。称号用于表彰他们的工作。

## 内容创作者
在各类平台制作视频供玩家观看的人，各自有不同的方向，可以制作 PvP 视频、展示方法和技巧，或提供其他娱乐内容。

## 内容创作者经理
管理内容创作者，决定谁能取得该身份，发放内容创作者角色设定，制定规则、安排活动、为游戏制作娱乐内容，并管理 Gakuran University 主服务器。该称号仅由3人持有。

## 竞技监管者
管理 Gakuran 的竞技事务，决定竞技系统如何运作，检查作弊者，并关注服务器中的重大问题。竞技服务器及相关事务均由其负责。

## 世界观负责人
负责 Gakuran 世界观，并管理封闭社区，处理所有设定相关事务，同时管理和招募世界观团队。

## 世界观团队
共同制作 Gakuran 与封闭社区的背景设定，为玩家编写可供体验的故事与世界观。

---

## 鼓大师
授予所有歌曲均以100%完美成绩完成、没有漏掉任何音符的玩家。他们将全部曲目完全打满，是技艺高超的音游玩家；该称号仅授予1人。

## 吉他大师
授予所有歌曲均以100%完美成绩完成、没有漏掉任何音符的玩家。该称号仅由1人持有。

## 第一斗士
授予曾拥有 Gakuran 竞技服务器的人。他创造了大部分战斗技巧，并用出人意料的方法让每种风格发挥实力。称号用于表彰其技巧，以及在 PvP 问题上提供的帮助，仅由1人持有。

## 摇滚巨星
在 Gakuran 官方活动中授予。原文将活动描述为一场“规模为5”的活动，未进一步解释这个数字的具体含义。参赛者需要完成最难曲目，制作独特剪辑，并确保歌曲达到100%完美。获奖者从约2,000份参赛作品中胜出，取得此称号。

---
cards.original:
## Covers every single in-game title and what do each do

‌

# **General titles:**

## Game creator:

Self explained. This is the MAIN person of the game, the one that had the idea and made it happen, it is only owned by the man himself. Not a huge change between the owner title, mostly a unique title to tell them apart.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_010609.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebba8145ac314d8a498bbb/previews/6aebba8145ac314d8a498c90/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_010609.webp)

‌

## Owner:

self explained. This is the owner of the game, the one that has the final say as to what needs to be added, removed, nerfed and goes on. They got every single perm meaning they can do everything.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235209.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aeba956cb7c92afce6ef130/previews/6aeba956cb7c92afce6ef279/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235209.webp)

## Developer:

Developers are the ones that created the game with the owner, each got their own line such as vfx effects, animations, creating a style, writing the bios, making the map and anything else. Developers are able to give themselves exclusive powers such as goku and make special events like zombie infection or freddy nightmare.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235251.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aeba9a72b0a4fb41c3b3b72/previews/6aeba9a72b0a4fb41c3b3b94/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235251.webp)

## Manager:

Manager is the one that handles the discord server, they create the channels, make sure everything works well, decides a promotion or manages the general sets of what’s allowed and what is not.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235242.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebaa20fbc32748ff00f35b/previews/6aebaa21fbc32748ff00f388/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235242.webp)

## Senior staff:

Senior staff works with the manager to handle less important stuff, they handle teams such as the helper team, get to decide any future promotions with the manager, they’re the eyes of the server and a higher staff. The senior staff do not have access to summon any type of events like the developers. They’re simply the main staff that takes care of everyone and also got access to the death note.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235247.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebaae10c57c896600839d7/previews/6aebaae10c57c89660083a39/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235247.webp)

## Staff:

Staff are one of the main reasons that the game is safe from exploiters. They fully take care of anything in-game, that includes anything that might break the rules such as weird names, exploits or anyone that might be a threat to the game/not allowed to play. They also take care of the server support tickets and get to decide who gets unbanned. They’re also one of the few people allowed to have a death note.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_000431.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebac06b6c3c5a95336593c/previews/6aebac06b6c3c5a9533659c3/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_000431.webp)

## Trial staff:

Trial staffs are pretty much staff in training that are trying to prove that they can be trusted. They mainly handle small in-server moderation such as warnings, bans, mutes to the people that break the rules in the server, these staff also have small perms in-game such as teleporting or becoming invisible. This is so in case they find any exploiters, which they can later forward it to a staff.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_001446.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebae70d1862514245614ba/previews/6aebae71d18625142456155b/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_001446.webp)

## Contributor:

Contributor are people who have contributed something significant to the game and its development. This can include skateboard art, gamemodes, bots, posters, and more. While initially a more frequently obtainable role in gakuran's early development, it is less likely to be recieved presently.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235300.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebaf1b26437c7d7bb9c8cf/previews/6aebaf1b26437c7d7bb9ca5d/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235300.webp)

## Tester:

Testers are responsible in finding any type of bug before an update happens, they all gather and try everything possible and report it to the developers before the actual release. Their job is to find any major bugs, abuses,  minor bugs, lag issues, quality related bugs and anything that may have an issue or look off in-game. Although there’s too many bugs so not everything minor can be fixed on the update, this doesn’t mean that they do not know it. It simply means that it couldn’t be fixed in time and will be fixed in a different update.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_004717.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb6b54d78b07033e8a32c/previews/6aebb6b54d78b07033e8a757/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_004717.webp)

## QA Lead:

The lead testers, they responsible for making sure that testers do not leak, hand out the titles and get to pick the testers. They manage when everyone should gather and test and make sure that the owner knows any major bug. This is owned by 2 people which both have their own part in the team.

![imag1e.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbce3fbd4df3361d1eeee/previews/6aebbce3fbd4df3361d1f05e/download/imag1e.webp)

## Artist manager:

Artist managers handle the server's artists, they host unique artist events, giveaways, and make sure that each person who posts art follows the art guidelines. They are the ones that decide if you should have the artist role. As reward for their efforts they’re also  allowed to set themselves and only themselves so you may find that each of them have a unique and creative character.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235256.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb0162a6e66338fcfc62c/previews/6aebb0162a6e66338fcfc6d8/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235256.webp)

## Event host:

They’re responsible for any related events, this includes hosting fun events for rewards in the original gakuran server, hosting other events in competitive server, finding ideas, having conversations of what would people like, communicating with each other to make the event as fun as possible and the main part which is to make sure that everything goes smooth without anyone to ruin it. They also the ones that you need to talk to in case you planning to host a server giveaway in the channel.

![image1.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb87eb7d46caea1df2340/previews/6aebb87fb7d46caea1df23ff/download/image1.webp)

## Event manager:

Decides the events, gets to say the final choice before anything happens. The ones that decide who becomes an event host, explains the rules, lists the blacklisted people and manages the entire event team. As a reward for their effort, they also get the ability to set themselves so they can put a character that’d fit the specific event.

![2.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbc6878080be6364df57b/previews/6aebbc6978080be6364df665/download/2.webp)

## Charting manager:

Chart managers are the ones responsible of songs, they make sure what’s get added to rhythm games, manages the charting server and picks people for the chart team. This title is only for one person and only one.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235708.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb0a081f9b6ab6367273c/previews/6aebb0a181f9b6ab6367280f/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235708.webp)

## Song charter:

The song charters create the rhythm-game music and its gameplay, they chart songs, curate the difficulty, making sure every note is tied to the buttons you play in game. Song charters  are really hard working people that put all their effort into making the best possible songs playable and smooth.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235713.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb134f38579eefe881fd9/previews/6aebb135f38579eefe8820ee/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235713.webp)

## Japanify title:

This title is given to the ones that sing, similar to the song charter but instead of rhythm games they sing songs that they made themselves with their own voice which later gets added in-game. The title is one of the only ones that got different variants, the name is based on their original (spotify) name so you can easily search them up and find them for support. There’s also a small case where similar titles for popular singers was handed out that either sound similar or happen to win it. Those 2 are a little different because they did not sing or have an original spotify account, they just a small joke due to them winning a title like that.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235212.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb1a4a3366cf107525be6/previews/6aebb1a5a3366cf107525c65/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235212.webp)

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_011721.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbd08ba75427e2de32487/previews/6aebbd09ba75427e2de3276c/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_011721.webp)

## Trello team:

the ones that made all of this board, the one that’s writing this as you read. Trello team manages the new info right after an update and makes sure everyone is informed, they’re one of the people that know mostly everything, about 20 people own this title and they’re able to answer to all of your questions, feel free to suggest anything if you see them for the Trello. They’re here to make the game easier just for you, just like a helper

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_002143.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb2c488b4b4dfaf5f5cb8/previews/6aebb2c488b4b4dfaf5f5d41/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_002143.webp)

## Trello manager:

Trello manager is the one that handles the whole Trello, they make announcements, put the Trello team in order and they’re one of the ones that fully decide if something is really important for Trello or not. This title is owned by 1 person. They also the ones that get the final choice of who gets to be in the Trello and who gets to write the Trello.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_001451.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb37af87946c0a648bced/previews/6aebb37bf87946c0a648bd96/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_001451.webp)

## University Professor:

Professor title are the staff of the university server. They make sure to have events for content creators, handle server moderation and mainly putting things in order by answering cc related stuff. As a reward for their effort they got a title to show their hard work.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235306.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb4c091c6fccd11d6c2bd/previews/6aebb4c091c6fccd11d6c374/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235306.webp)

## Content creator (cc):

They the ones that make videos in any platform for players to watch, they all got their own different rule and do what they like best, making pvp videos, showing methods, tricks and mainly content for people to enjoy.

![imag2e.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb945b3e53dcb7c5afd37/previews/6aebb947b3e53dcb7c5b0068/download/imag2e.webp)

## Content creator manager:

The ones that take care of the content creators. They decide who gets to have the role, give the cc sets, makes the rules, decides the events, does fun stuff for the game and also manage the main university server. Only 3 people own it.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_010511.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbb58677d3676045d829a/previews/6aebbb58677d3676045d83ae/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_010511.webp)

## Competitive overseer:

comp overseer is the manager of the competitive side in gakuran. They handle how things should work, checking cheaters and mainly look around the server for any major problems. They’re in charge of anything that has to do with the comp server and anything related to it.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee40387b232c9e66646cbe/previews/6aee40387b232c9e66646deb/download/image.webp)

‌

## Head of lore:

responsible for handling the gakuran “lore” and the manager of the closed community, they take care of anything lore related and they manage/hire the lore team.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee644a9d395d6e1cdc886e/previews/6aee644b9d395d6e1cdc8a93/download/image.webp)

## Lore team:

Responsible for making the lore of gakuran and closed community. They work together to create a small and lovely lore for everyone to enjoy.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee6489ee0a9c07a9782baf/previews/6aee6489ee0a9c07a9782cfc/download/image.webp)

---

## Winner titles:

## Drum master:

Drum Master is rewarded to the person that completed ALL songs in perfect without a single miss, they fully maxed all songs with 100% perfect score. Truly skilled rhythm players which is why it’s only rewarded to 1 single person.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235702.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb44255b959654a07ebb5/previews/6aebb44355b959654a07ec62/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235702.webp)

## Guitar master:

Guitar master is rewarded to the person that completed ALL songs in perfect without a single miss, they maxed all songs with 100% perfect score. It is owned by only 1 single person.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_151732.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aec8b698c451001b2f40407/previews/6aec8b6a8c451001b2f4052a/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_151732.webp)

## Top 1 fighter:

Awarded to the person that used to own the competitive gakuran server, they created most of the techs and made every style look powerful with ways that no one would’ve thought of. The title was given due to his skill and the help the person offered on pvp related issues. Only one single person owns that title.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_181410.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aecab748fbd456f0ca0e67b/previews/6aecab748fbd456f0ca0e7ae/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_181410.webp)

## Rockstar:

rockstar was awarded in a official gakuran event, in a event of 5. All players in the event had to complete the hardest song, make a unique edit and had to be sure that the song was 100% perfect. Out of all the 2k entries, they ended up being the winner and earned the rockstar title.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-07\_001002.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee5cd32fa0e9b79458a88c/previews/6aee5cd32fa0e9b79458a9c5/download/Screenshot_2026-11-07_001002.webp)

‌

‌
