cards.title: v8.009（#24）更新
cards.body:
## 学乱Gakuran更新v8.009（#24）
最新更新已经上线，具体改动如下。

### 新增
- 史诗风格突击者（Striker）。
- 新稀有发色“冰川蓝（Glacier Blue）”。
- 卡拉OK酒吧与卡拉OK系统。
- 可在Dante's Yakiniku餐厅购买食物并进行吃播。
- 完全重做私人服务器，提供加入码与多个永久服务器，以及角色／玩家权限。
- 与NPC说话时，它们现在会回应，应该如此；若1000人同时对一个NPC说话，作者也不知道会发生什么。
- 新增10款滑板皮肤。旧独特滑板皮肤停止获取，已有者仍保留，但由更好的版本取代。
- 新增3套制服：1套通用、2套女性。
- 翻盖手机音乐播放器新增4首歌。
- 乐器新增4首歌：Kaikai Kitan、Welcome To The Jungle、Rolling Girl、Kyouran Hey Kids!!。

### 调整
- 可以在手机上屏蔽玩家。
- 每次新更新上线时提供免费重抽系统。
- 即使有人骑着滑板，现在也可让滑板消失。
- 可选择撤销或保留角色重抽结果。
- 支持手柄虚拟光标。
- 略微降低滑板声音。
- 重做翻盖手机的2048游戏。

### 修复
- 修复音乐室内听不到乐器的问题；若仍听不到，作者只能认为音频已下架。
- 修复Dante's Yakiniku餐厅光照。
- 修复自动3对3篮球的多项问题。
- 进行了不逐一列出的多项优化，预计帧率提高约25%至50%。
- 修复跳跃与动作组合导致角色卡在空中的问题。
cards.original:
# 学乱 Gakuran Update v8.009 (#24)

The latest update is live. Read below for the specific changes.

## ✦ Additions

- Striker Epic Style
- New rare 'Glacier Blue' haircolor
- Karaoke Bar + Karaoke System
- Able to purchase food at Dante's Yakiniku Restaurant and have a mukbang
- Private servers completely reworked (join codes, multiple permanent servers)
  - Role/player permissions
- NPCs will now respond to you when you talk to them (should — idk what's gonna happen if 1000 people try talking to an NPC at the same time)
- 10 new skateboard skins
  - Old unique skateboard skins discarded — if you had them you'll still keep them, but they're replaced with better versions
- 3 new uniforms (1 unisex, 2 female)
- 4 new songs on the flipphone music player
- 4 new songs on instruments (Kaikai Kitan, Welcome To The Jungle, Rolling Girl, Kyouran Hey Kids!!)

## ⇄ Changes

- You can now block players on the phone
- Free rolls system whenever a new update rolls out
- Skateboards are now despawnable even if someone's riding them
- You can now undo or keep your character spins
- Added gamepad virtual cursor support
- Slightly lowered volume of skateboard sounds
- Flipphone game 2048 redesigned

## ▲ Fixes

- Not hearing instrument audio in the music room (if you still can't hear it, I just gotta assume the audio is taken down)
- Dante's Yakiniku Restaurant lighting fixed
- Various auto 3v3 basketball fixes
- Various optimizations I ain't typing out (should see anywhere from 25–50% improvement in FPS)
- Jump + emote freezes you in the air

cards.title: 限时万圣节活动
cards.body:
## 永久糖果商店概览
万圣节活动第二阶段糖果商店中的物品均为永久物品。取得物品需要使用糖果或重抽次数抽取扭蛋。

可取得限时面部、制服与战斗风格；它们属于永久物品，无法通过普通重抽取得。还可获得御札，兑换限时面部、制服和风格。

- **装备与槽位：**抽到物品时可选择槽位，也可以向下滚动糖果商店，手动装备。
- **切换功能：**目前可用的面部、制服等物品，都能在糖果商店中与原有物品切换启用或关闭。
- **更新后的规则：**活动结束后，它们才会替换当前槽位。如果物品当时没有装备在身上，更新后将无法再装备，即使你在活动期间已经取得。

---

## 幽灵扭蛋概率与保底
在此消耗剩余糖果：单抽100糖果，10连抽1,000糖果。

已经无法获得新的糖果。

- **头奖（0.2%）：**限定风格，共2种：jason、scarecrow。
  - **保底：**最迟第350抽保证取得一次头奖。
- **大奖（1.5%）：**万圣节面部，共5种：red、blud、doll、bow、spider。
- **中奖（5.0%）：**万圣节服装，共6种变体。
- **未中奖（93.3%）：**基础抽取结果，额外御札为0。

### 通用扭蛋规则
- **不重复掉落：**不会掉落重复物品。已拥有某类别全部物品时，改为获得御札。
- **御札收入：**每次抽取给予1枚御札。
- **每日上限：**每天最多使用重抽次数进行200次抽取。
- **截止时间：**整个糖果商店与扭蛋活动将在**7天后**关闭。原文此句末尾尚有未写完的“and”。
- 商店关闭后，限定风格无法再通过重抽取得。

---

## 御札兑换商店
如果没有通过扭蛋解锁限定物品，可直接使用积攒的御札兑换：

- **限定风格：**1,200枚御札
- **万圣节面部：**250枚御札
- **万圣节制服：**80枚御札
cards.original:
## Permanent Candy Shop Overview

The candy shop in part 2 of the halloween event is all permanent items, to get these items you must either spend candies, or rerolls on capsules.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ae66b0e633240a0746ed2ae/previews/6ae66b0f633240a0746ed3d3/download/image.webp)

You are able to get limited time faces, uniforms, styles, which can not be rerolled for and are permanent items, you can also get Ofuda which can be traded in for the limited time faces, uniforms and styles.

‌

- **Equipping/Slots:** You can have an option to choose a slot when you roll something, or equip it manually if you scroll down at the candy shop.
- **Toggle Feature:** All current available items such as face/uniforms are able to be toggled on/off at the candy shop with your currently existing items.
- **Post-Update Rule:** It is only after the event they are replacing your current slot. If they're not on you, you won't be able to put them on post-update. Even if you got them during the update.

---

## Ghost Gacha Odds & Pity System

Spend remaining Candy here (100 per single spin / 1000 for 10 spins)

You cannot earn new candy anymore.

- **Jackpot (0.2%):** Limited Styles (2 available: `jason` & `scarecrow`).
  - _Guaranteed Pity:_ You are guaranteed a jackpot by turn 350 at the latest.
- **Big Win (1.5%):** Halloween Faces (5 available: `red`, `blud`, `doll`, `bow`, `spider`).
- **Win (5.0%):** Halloween Fits (6 variations available).
- **Miss (93.3%):** +0 Ofuda (Base roll).

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ae682e6f84521a7944f0252/previews/6ae682e7f84521a7944f03b0/download/image.webp)

### **General Gacha Rules:**

- **No Dupes:** There are no duplicate drops. If you already own everything in a category, you will receive Ofuda instead.
- **Ofuda Income:** Every turn gives 1 Ofuda.
- **Daily Limit:** Maximum of 200 reroll turns allowed per day.
- **Deadline:** The entire Candy Shop and Gacha event closes in **7 days and.**
  \* Limited styles cannot be rerolled for, after the shop closes.

![1x.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ae68277dc4fa4ed5e8e9b64/download/1x.gif)

---

## Ofuda Trade-In Shop

If you don't unlock the limited items via Gacha rolls, you can trade your accumulated Ofuda directly at the shop:

- **Limited Style:** 1200 Ofuda
- **Halloween Face:** 250 Ofuda
- **Halloween Uniform:** 80 Ofuda

cards.title: v2.679（#22）更新
cards.body:
## 学乱Gakuran更新v2.679（正文标为#1）
最新更新已经上线，具体改动如下。

### 新增
- 大幅优化乐器，并重做视觉表现；乐器新增箭头音符形状。
- 乐器新增15首歌：American Idiot、Ano band、Creep、DEVIL NOBODY、Hold On Till May、If I could Be a Constellation、Inferno、Join Me In Death、Nakaniwano、Oddloop、Rip & Tear、Seisyun Complex、Toxicity、Welcome to the Black Parade、Yoru ni Kakeru。
- 完全重做yenapp。
- 完全重做socialink。
- 新增8种脸部：男性2种、女性6种。
- 新增4套制服：通用2套、女性2套。
- 完全重做动作轮盘；坐在座位上使用时，会打开坐姿切换轮盘；第一人称可以看到轮盘；新增1个后空翻动作，可能失败。
- 新增跳跃与下落动画；携带他人从太高的地方跳下，会使自己布娃娃倒地。
- 翻盖手机新增4款游戏：tetris、connectfour、jumper、reactiontimer；重做游戏启动器。
- 可以像调整饰品一样调整头发。
- 新增196个发型ID，依旧逐个挑选与检查；作者表示快到字符上限。

### 调整
- 完全重做设置与私人服务器面板。
- 未保存就退出饰品调整时必须确认。

### 修复
- 修复无法使用音乐室鼓组的问题。
- 乐器音箱线不再与角色或吉他模型碰撞。
- 楼梯动画新增脚步声。
- 修复血液射线检测没有排除玩家的问题，并做小幅优化。

### 追加新增
- 新城镇。
- 2个战斗风格槽位。
- 新风格Ali，稀有度???；重做Hakari，现为传说。
- 搬运同意开关，可允许或拒绝被人携带。

### 追加调整
- 更常在有玩家的地点附近生成。
- 战斗中不能再重抽。
- 修复无限体力漏洞。

### 新增
- gakumart工作，可在indeed应用申请班次。
- 对支持双持的物品，可同时装备2件，一件主手、一件副手，例如翻盖手机加饮料、2支粉笔、粉笔加板擦等。

### 调整
- 修复Everlong主音吉他谱面；作者为耗时过长致歉。
- 修复NPC生成，改善寻路。
- 修复动作，应该已经正常。

### Ali平衡
- 无法击中地上布娃娃倒地的玩家。
- 左手出拳（left arm shuffle）不再造成倒地，只有右手出拳会。
- 闪避反击现在始终使用左手出拳。

### 修复
- 更新加载界面的镜头路径。
- 修复低画质下可以穿过学校的渲染错误。

以上内容均在上一次更新上线后才开始开发，可能仍有错误。

## 学乱Gakuran更新v7.500（#21）
最新更新已经上线，具体改动如下。

### 新增
- 48件新饰品，覆盖腰部以外的所有类别。
- 完全重做饰品调整，并支持缩放饰品。
- 楼梯正式生效，具有速度减益与动画。
- 1套女性新制服：水手服（sailor）。
- 10种新脸部：2种猫男孩（catboy），其余为???。
- 音乐播放器新增4首歌。
- 新增4个动作。
- 购买50次重抽包超过两次后，可购买批量重抽。
- 可从UGC创作者处购买原版饰品。
- 私人服务器的音乐（music）页可以播放自定义音乐／声音ID，并自定义该音轨。

### 调整
- 重做翻盖手机UI。

### 修复
- 修复后方推拉门滑动过头的问题。

### 移除
- 旧手机UI。

cards.title: 身高
cards.body:
角色身高会轻微影响玩法，根据性别与族裔随机生成。

## 较高角色
- 生命值与伤害更高
- 命中判定更大
- 移动与攻击更慢
- 闪避距离更短

## 较矮角色
- 生命值与伤害更低
- 命中判定更小
- 移动和攻击更快，冷却更短
- 闪避距离更长

cards.original:
Character height slightly affects game play and is randomly generated based on your character's gender and ethnicity.

**Taller characters**

- More health and damage
- Larger hit boxes
- Slower movement and attacks
- Shorter Dashes

**Shorter characters**

- Less health and damage
- Smaller hit boxes
- Faster movement, attacks, and cool downs
- Longer Dashes

Your height does effect your HP.  Shorter heights have less health while taller heights have more.

### Male Averages

- European — 178 cm (5'10")
- African — 175 cm (5'9")
- Middle Eastern — 173 cm (5'8")
- Japanese — 171 cm (5'7")
- Latino — 170 cm (5'7")
- Indian — 167 cm (5'6")

### Female Averages

- European — 165 cm (5'5")
- African — 162 cm (5'4")
- Middle Eastern — 160 cm (5'3")
- Japanese — 159 cm (5'3")
- Latina — 158 cm (5'2")
- Indian — 155 cm (5'1")

Heights closer to the average are more common, while very short and very tall characters are much rarer.

cards.body:
**园艺社**

位于学校建筑右翼的屋顶。加入后，通过照料植物赚取积分：按需浇水、确保日照充足，并在出现害虫时除虫。

每块花圃最多同时照料3株植物，升级后会解锁更多可种植的种子。建议在白天进行这项社团活动，这样不用担心日照条件，更容易完成。点击右上角按钮放弃花圃，即可停止照料其中的植物。


[查看花卉列表](https://trello.com/c/EQOzcNrW/6-flowers)
cards.original:
**Gardening Club**

The Gardening club is found on the right wing of the Gakuran building on the roof. Upon joining the gardening club, your task for getting points is taking care of them by giving the water they need, making sure they get enough sunlight, and removing bugs if there are any.

The maximum amount plants that you can take care of in one bed is three plants and you unlock more seeds to plant as you level up. It is recommended to do this club activity when the sun is up so you won't have to worry about the sunlight part of the activity, making it easier for you to complete it. You can abandon the responsibility of taking care of the plants by giving up your bed using the button on the upper right corner.

排球场位于学校左侧，靠近校门。体育馆也设有篮球场，并配有排球车和篮球车，可用来取出球。

**按键**

- V：进入／退出排球模式

- 鼠标右键：拦网
- Q：鱼跃救球
- F／R：向前／向后传球
- Z／X／C：力度档位（1／3／5）
- 1／2：降低／增加力度

- 鼠标右键：跳发球

力度改变时，身旁会出现力度条。可以选择它的显示样式。

- 全息（HOLO）、漫画（MANGA）、数字（NUMBER）、伸展（REACH）

**垫球**

**拦网演示2**

**向后传球**

在排球模式中按G，可以呼叫不同战术。共有5种呼叫选项：

- 主攻位
- 副攻位
- 接应位
- 后排中路进攻
- 二次进攻

- 高球
- 中球
- 快球
- 负节奏球

> 返回：回到上一级菜单。

---

**多人玩法**

场上共有12块红／蓝站位垫，每队6块，玩家站上去即可准备比赛。每队至少需要2名玩家才能开始。一方达到18分时比赛结束。

---


- NPC现在可以参加排球表演赛，玩家可以观看NPC之间的排球比赛。

- 游戏会自动追踪排球比赛中的玩家数据。

- 按空格键可以跳过回放。

---

cards.title: 消息
cards.body:
**消息系统**

无论身处世界中的何处，玩家都可以通过游戏内的消息系统交流。

发送消息前，必须先通过[Socialink交换联系方式](https://trello.com/c/0hQv7H95/98-socialink)添加对方。这项手机功能用于管理联系和联系人。双方通过Social Link建立联系后，就会出现在彼此的联系人列表中。

发送消息的方法：

1. 打开手机。
2. 进入“联系人”。
3. 选择想要发消息的人。
4. 按“消息”打开对话。
5. 输入文字并发送。

接收者会收到消息，并可打开手机、查看对话后回复。双方无需靠近，可以在游戏世界中的任何地方交流。

所有对话都会保存在消息历史中，随时可以通过手机重新查看。
cards.original:
**Messaging System**

Players can communicate with one another through the in game messaging system, regardless of their location in the world.

Before a player can send messages, they must first add the other character through [https://trello.com/c/0hQv7H95/98-socialink](https://trello.com/c/0hQv7H95/98-socialink "smartCard-inline") , the phone feature used to manage connections and contacts. Once two characters are connected through Social Link, they will appear in each other's contact lists.

To send a message:

1. Open your phone.
2. Navigate to **Contacts**.
3. Select the person you wish to message.
4. Press **Message** to open the conversation.
5. Type and send your text.

The recipient will receive the message and can respond by opening their phone and viewing the conversation. Characters do not need to be physically near each other to exchange messages, allowing communication from anywhere in the game world.

All conversations are stored in the message history and can be revisited at any time through the phone.

cards.title: 篮球
cards.body:
篮球是一项注重操作技巧的活动，关键在于时机、控球、站位和防守压力。篮球可以在篮筐附近的球架上找到。

**投篮**

- 按住E开始投篮动作，投篮条开始蓄满。
- 松开E出手。
- 松开的时机决定投篮质量。
- 在篮筐附近按Shift＋空格键扣篮。
- 按Shift并轻点E，进行欧洲步扣篮。
- 按G背身单打，G＋E可以背身后仰跳投。


篮球力度改变时，身旁会出现力度条。可以选择它的显示样式。可用样式：

- 篮球（BALL）、电池（BATTERY）、刀刃（BLADE）、经典（CLASSIC）
- 表盘（DIAL）、圆相（ENSO）、仪表（GAUGE）、烟花（HANABI）
- 全息（HOLO）、篮筐（HOOP）、气（KI）、灯组（LAMPS）
- 牛奶（MILK）、迷你（MINI）、准星（RETICLE）、节奏（RHYTHM）
- 关闭（OFF）

**投篮条判定区间**

**三分球计分**

庭院篮球场和室内篮球场的两端，篮筐外围都有一条大型半圆线：室内为黄色线，庭院中为其中一条白线。

这些半圆线就是三分线。

在三分线外侧，也就是更靠近中线的位置投篮命中，计3分；在更靠近篮筐的位置投篮命中，则计2分。

---

**防守压力**

投篮时机并非唯一因素。主动防守者的站位和压迫能够降低投篮命中率。

- 无人干扰的投篮更容易命中。
- 受到轻度干扰时，投篮更难。
- 受到重度干扰时，得分明显更难。
- 即使出手时机不错，强大的防守压力仍可能降低投篮效果。

投篮前创造空间，往往与把握出手时机同样重要。

**控球**

可以用多种运球动作拉开距离、摆脱防守。

- X：回拉运球
- Z＋X：背后运球
- C＋X：另一种背后运球
- Backspace：丢球
- 右手持球时，C＋C：向右转身
- 左手持球时，Z＋Z：向左转身
- Z或X：换手持球
- 队友会在你的客户端显示编号，按对应数字即可向该队友传球。

组合使用运球动作，有助于突破防守、制造空位投篮机会。

**防守**

防守对于阻止对手得分十分重要。

- 鼠标右键：防守姿态
- F：无球时掩护
- R：无球时抢断
- 空格键：无球时盖帽

按住鼠标右键使角色进入防守姿态，可以盯防持球者、干扰投篮、封堵突破路线并施加压力。防守距离越近、效果越好，对方投篮就越困难。

---


在篮球模式下按G，可以呼叫不同战术。

**持球时的呼叫**

- 拉开单打！

**无球时的呼叫**

- 传球！
- 空中接力！

---

**多人玩法**

有室内体育馆球场和室外篮球场两处。室外篮球场最多支持6人，即3对3；室内体育馆球场支持6人或10人，即3对3或5对5。

3对3时，玩家必须站在己方最靠近篮筐的3个站位点上。5对5时，可以站在任意可用站位点。

每次球权的进攻计时为24秒。出现篮板或球出界后，进攻计时暂停。每节5分钟，全场4节，共20分钟（4×5）。

**PS＋设置**

PS＋指令面板中有篮球栏目，提供多种自定义选项，例如：

- 队伍
- 队伍自定义
- 比赛时间
- 比分
- 进攻计时

---


设置中的“篮球”栏目可以更改投篮前出现的投篮条，下方还有按键绑定设置，可按个人习惯修改。

# **Basketball:**

is a skill-based activity focused on **timing, ball control, positioning, and defensive pressure**. Basketballs can be found on the racks near the hoop.

**Shooting:**

- Hold `E` to begin your shooting motion - a shot meter starts filling
- Release `E` to shoot
- The timing of your release determines the quality of the shot.
- Press Shift + Spacebar to perform a Dunk near the rim
- Shift + Tapping `E` to perform a Euro Step Dunk
- Press `G` to post up, `G+E` allows you to do a Post Fadeaway

## Power Meter Settings

Choose the style of the **Power Meter** that appears beside you whenever your basketball power changes. **Available Power Meters:**

- BALL • BATTERY • BLADE • CLASSIC
- DIAL • ENSO • GAUGE • HANABI
- HOLO • HOOP • KI • LAMPS
- MILK • MINI • RETICLE • RHYTHM
- OFF

**Shot Meter Zones**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6ac16b60b79679d36c1f2576/previews/6ac16b61b79679d36c1f2653/download/image.webp)

**Three-Point Scoring**
On both the Courtyard and Indoor Basketball courts, there are large semi-circles(the yellow line indoors and one of the white lines in the courtyard) that form a perimeter around the hoops on each side of the court.

These semi-circles are your **Three-Point Lines**.

They represent the perimeter by which any shot made past them(closer to the half-court line) will count for 3 points, however any shots made closer to the goal will instead only court for 2 points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a8a0b80e7a2545389211c34/previews/6a8a0b80e7a2545389211cde/download/image.webp)

---

**Defensive Pressure:**
Shot timing isn't the only factor. An active defender's positioning and pressure can reduce the shooter's chance of making the basket.

- Open shots are easier to make.
- Lightly contested shots are more difficult.
- Heavily contested shots are significantly harder to score.
- Strong pressure can lower shooting effectiveness even on otherwise decent releases.

Creating space before shooting is often just as important as timing the shot itself.

**Ball Handling:**
Several dribble moves let you create separation and outmaneuver defenders.

- `X` — Bounce-Back Dribble
- `Z + X` — Behind-the-Back Dribble
- `C + X` — Alternate Behind-the-Back Dribble
- `Backspace` — Drop the Ball
- Ball in right hand, `C+C`  — Right Spin Move
- Ball in left hand, `Z+Z`— Left Spin Move
- `Z or X` — Swap ball to other hand.
- Client Sided Numbers are assigned to teammates, pressing a corresponding number allows you to pass to the teammate

![basketballskill.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a8d31bb2586ae699c082482/previews/6a8d31cd2586ae699c082df3/download/basketballskill.gif)

Combining dribble moves helps break through defenses and create open shooting opportunities.

**Defense:**
Defense plays a major role in stopping opponents from scoring.

- `RMB` (Right Mouse Button) — Defensive Stance
- `F` — Screen (Off-Ball)
- `R`— Steal (Off-Ball)
- `Space` — Block (Off-Ball)

Holding `RMB` puts your character in a defensive stance, letting you guard the ball handler, contest shots, cut off driving lanes, and apply pressure. The closer and more effectively you defend, the harder their shot becomes.

---

# Basketball

## **Call Play Menu**

When pressing `G` while in **Basketball Mode**, you are able to call out different plays. **Call Outs When Holding the Basketball:**

- Iso!

**Call Outs When Not Holding the Basketball:**

- Pass!
- Alley-Oop!

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6aaefbae53fa2c44ac424a81/previews/6aaefbaf53fa2c44ac424b44/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6aaefbb2debf0f425bd6bd12/previews/6aaefbb3debf0f425bd6be26/download/image.webp)

---

**Multiplayer Gameplay:**
There are two basketball courts: the indoor Gymnasium Court and the Outside Basketball Court. The Outside Basketball Court supprts a maximum of 6 players (3vs3). The inside Gymnasium Court supports either 6 or 10 players (3v3 or 5v5).

For 3v3, the players must stand on the 3 spots closest to the hoop on their side. For 5v5, the players can stand on any of the available spots.

The shot clock lasts 24 seconds per possession. After a rebound or if the ball goes out the bounds, the shot clock pauses. Each quarter lasts 5 minutes for a total game time of 20 minutes (4x5).

‌

**PS+ Settings:**

Within the PS+ command panel there is a section for basketball featuring many customization options such as:

Team

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a788e052929f7e6b924fef2/previews/6a788e062929f7e6b92500a6/download/image.webp)

Team Customization

Game timing

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a788e3c2e928ca56e25f020/previews/6a788e3d2e928ca56e25f299/download/image.webp)

Score

And shot clock

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a788e58ef91e5918cd3caf7/previews/6a788e58ef91e5918cd3cb94/download/image.webp)

Basketball ui can be seen in settings, basketball section. It changes the "meter" for when you're about to shoot, bellow it there's a section to change the key binds to your liking.

cards.body:
## 进入游戏前
请确认你的 Roblox 账号：
- 已完成16岁及以上验证。
- 已加入[Roblox 社区](https://www.roblox.com/communities/416091513/Gakuran#!/about)。

满足上述条件后即可进入游戏。

#### 性别
进入后会出现角色创建界面，首先选择男性或女性。请注意：
- 性别影响身高，男性平均身高明显高于女性。
- 两种性别有不同的饰品池。
- 性别可在属性菜单中更改。

了解这些后即可选择性别。

#### 名字
选择性别后需要选择名字。姓氏随机生成，无法自行挑选，但可通过重抽更换。名字不得带侮辱性或违反 Roblox 服务条款。

如果收到以下错误：
> Server Rejected Data（服务器拒绝了数据）

意味着：
- 名字触发了 Roblox 过滤。
- 名字违反某项命名规则。

需要改用其他名字。

### 游戏中的角色
进入游戏后，族裔、身高、姓氏、饰品、头发、发色和面部都会随机生成。随后即可开始游玩。

## **Before Joining the Game:**

Before joining the game, ensure that your Roblox account:

- Is verified as 16+
- Is in the [Roblox Group](https://www.roblox.com/communities/416091513/Gakuran#!/about "‌")

After you meet the previously listed requirements, you can join the game.

## **Once You Are in the Game:**

### Character Customization:

#### Gender:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a50924c65a8578d5e50b189/attachments/6a50992c1500c26bd20a6183/previews/6a50992c1500c26bd20a61b0/download/image.webp)

Once you join, you will be greeted with a character creation screen. First, you must choose your gender: male or female. Please note that:

- **Gender affects height** (with males having a significantly higher average height then female)
- **Both genders have varying accessory pools**
- **Gender can be changed in the stat menu**

With that in mind, you can select a gender.

#### Name:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a50924c65a8578d5e50b189/attachments/6a5099665cc68c87034707a9/previews/6a5099675cc68c87034707e0/download/image.webp)

After you select a gender, you must choose a name. Note that: last names are randomized and you do not get to choose it; however, you can change it via rolling. Furthermore, ensure that your name is not derogatory or breaks Roblox ToS. **If you get the error:**

> “Server Rejected Data”

It means:

- Your name was tagged by Roblox
- It broke one of the name rules

And you need to choose a different name.

### In the Game:

Once you are in the game your ethnicity, height, last name, accessories, hair, hair color, face are all randomized. You can now enjoy the game!

cards.body:
## 推荐配装
摔跤推荐约6英尺／183厘米及以上的高个角色，以发挥“摔倒（Takedown）”“破防强击（Heavy Hitter）”和“格挡穿透（Guard Pierce）”天赋。高个的额外伤害与重击（M2）额外50%伤害相结合，能够造成大量伤害。

原卡强烈建议采用非常积极的进攻打法，发挥摔倒与高个的高伤害组合。“韧性（Resilience）”也能降低贸然进攻的风险。重击还具有霸体，使出招更安全。

## 重击
基础冷却12秒。

# Recommended Build:

For the wrestling style a Tall height [around 6’0 / 183cm or higher] is recommended to take advantage of the “Takedown” and “Heavy Hitter” Perks, along with “Guard Pierce” Perk as well. Being tall gives you extra damage, and combined with the 50% extra damage from M2s join together to deal massive damage.
An extremely aggressive playstyle should almost definitely be played to take advantage of the aforementioned Takedown + Tall combo for high damage, as well as the “Resilience” Perk making reckless attacking less risky. To add on to the safety “Resilience” brings, your M2 also gains hyperarmor allowing it to be used without much risk.

---

## 通用聊天指令
**/Me：**后接消息，在消息两端加上星号。直接在消息前后使用星号，也会让消息以粉色突出显示。

**/S：**后接消息，以喊话或强调形式显示。

**/ooc：**后接消息，以不带特效或发言线条的简洁形式显示，用于场外交流。

**/w：**后接消息，以浅灰色斜体显示。只有距离说话者3米内的玩家能读懂，其他人会看到“无法辨认”的提示。

**Mb / Mb all：**清除屏幕上方的“战斗中”状态，是否生效取决于以下条件。鞠躬表情也能执行这一操作。
- 只有你攻击了别人，对方没有还击：只需你说 Mb 或 Mb all。
- 别人误伤了你：由对方说 Mb 或 Mb all，才能提前脱离。
- 双方互相攻击后决定停手：双方都必须说出指令，才可提前结束或原谅战斗。

---

移动：左摇杆

转动镜头：右摇杆

装备战斗风格：左肩键（LB / L1）

终结倒地玩家：方向键下
丢下／放置物品：方向键上
跳跃：A键／叉键
切换视角锁定：按下左摇杆（L3）
打开表情轮盘：方向键左
切换视角：Y键／三角键

---

**Universal Chat commands:**

**/Me** : followed by a message, starts and ends your message with an asterisk (*_). Additionally_ **using an asterisk** before and after a message highlights the message in pink.

**/S** : followed by a message, makes a shouted/emphasized version of your message.

/**ooc** : followed by a message, makes the message appear cleanly with no effects or speaking lines.

**/w** : followed by a message, makes the message appear in italics and light gray text. The chat can only be read by people within 3m of the speaker, otherwise it appears as \*unintelligible\*.

**Mb / Mb all** : Clears _IN COMBAT_ status at the top of your screen. There are different conditions for this chat command to work. (Bow emote does this as well)

**If only you** attack someone and they didn’t hit back, only you have to say _Mb or Mb all_. **If another player** : attacks you by accident, they must say _Mb or Mb all_ to exit early **If both of you** : attack each other and then decide not to, both players must say it to leave /forgive combat early.

---

cards.title: 联系人
cards.body:
**联系人**

“联系人”应用类似普通智能手机的通讯录，可以保存和管理认识的人，并拨打电话。通话功能允许玩家通过语音聊天交谈。

通过Social Link添加角色后，对方信息会自动存入联系人列表。之后便可以方便地查看对方资料、发送消息，并使用手机支持的其他互动功能。

使用方法：

1. 打开手机。
2. 选择“联系人”。
3. 浏览已保存的联系人，或选择某个人。
4. 打开对方的联系人页面，查看可用操作。

这项应用便于记录在游戏中认识的朋友。通过Social Link添加的玩家会保留在联系人列表中。

列表按便于快速访问的方式组织，让你轻松找到并联系他人，不必每次重新寻找。
cards.original:
**Contacts**

The Contacts app functions similarly to a regular smartphone contact list, allowing players to call players and store and manage people they know. Calling allows players to talk through **Voice Chat** through the calling feature,

When a character is added through **Social Link**, their information is automatically saved to your Contacts list. From there, you can easily access their profile, send messages, and interact with them through supported phone features.

To use Contacts:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Contacts**.
3. Browse your saved contacts or choose a specific person.
4. Open their contact page to view available actions.

The Contacts app serves as a convenient way to keep track of friends you meet throughout the game. Any player added through Social Link will remain in your Contacts.

Contacts are organized for quick access, making it easy to find and communicate with people without needing to search for them each time.

cards.body: 每次打开手机都会出现这个界面，其中有菜单按钮、时间、日期，下方还有几朵花。按“确定”或对应绑定键即可进入应用界面，也可以按侧边按钮直接进入消息或电话应用。
cards.original:
# Greeting Screen

This screen will show up whenever you open your phone, showing a menu button, the time, date, and multiple flowers below. Pressing OK (or the respective key-bind) will direct you to the Apps Screen. You can also press the side buttons to immediately go to either the message or telephone app.

cards.title: v7.203（#18）更新
cards.body:
## 新增
- 手机通话支持语音聊天。
- 动作轮盘新增行走（Walk）栏目，提供不同走路姿态。
- 受重抽禁令影响的玩家，如果目前仍持有重抽次数，现在可以使用；额外次数仍必须通过兑换码取得。

### 私人服务器
- 新增/respawnall。
- 新增Fly、WalkSpeed、ESP等基础管理命令。
- 全服公告与附近公告显示玩家角色、用户名与头衔。
- 玩家列表新增搜索栏。
- 玩家角色分配可以持久保存。
- 安全区（Green Zone）配置可以持久保存。
- 角色层级可以拖拽调整。

### 战斗
- 被招架后会眩晕1秒。
- 重拳手的伤害加成从25%提高至30%。
- 重拳手的额外承伤从25%降至10%。

### 地图
- 走廊现在识别为独立区域。
- 走廊可以指定为安全区。

### 战斗
- 修复命中音效播放两次的问题。
- 修复重复生成战斗VFX的问题。
- 修复启用长按M1时，松开攻击按钮后轻击序列仍继续的问题。

### 界面
- 修复手机HUD布局未正确保存的问题。
- 重新加入头衔的角色颜色。
- 修复安全区列表刷新问题。

### 世界
- 修复校长室物体未锚定的问题。
- 修复板擦反复大量生成的问题。

本次更新主要扩展私人服务器功能、改善使用体验、调整战斗平衡，并修复游玩与UI问题。
cards.original:
# Additions

- Phone calls now support **Voice Chat**.
- Added a **Walk** section to the emote wheel (**Walk Variants**).
- Players affected by the **reroll ban** can now reroll if they currently have rerolls available. Additional rerolls must still be obtained through **codes**.

## Private Server Updates

- Added `/respawnall`.
- Added basic **admin commands** such as **Fly**, **WalkSpeed**, **ESP**, and more.
- Announcements and proximity announcements now display a player's **character**, **username**, and **title**.
- Added a **search bar** to the player list.
- Added **persistent player roles**.
- Added **persistent Green Zone configuration**.
- Added a **draggable role hierarchy**.

# Changes

**Combat**

- Being **parried** now stuns you for **1 second**.
- **Slugger** attack damage increased from **+25% → +30%**.
- **Slugger** damage taken reduced from **+25% → +10%**.

**Map**

- **Hallways** are now recognized as areas.
- **Hallways** can now be designated as **Green Zones**.

# Fixes

**Combat**

- Fixed combat **hit sounds** playing twice.
- Fixed duplicate combat **VFX** spawning.
- Fixed **M1 attack sequences** continuing after releasing the attack button while using **Hold M1**.

**UI**

- Fixed **mobile HUD layouts** not saving correctly.
- Re-added **title role colors**.
- Fixed **Green Zone list** refreshing issues.

**World**

- Fixed unanchored objects in the **Principal's Office**.
- Fixed **eraser spawn spam**.

---

This update focuses on expanding **private server functionality**, improving **quality of life**, adjusting **combat balance**, and fixing a variety of **gameplay and UI issues**.

cards.title: 举报指南
cards.body:
举报 Gakuran 违规玩家前，请先确认对方涉及以下行为之一：

- 露骨绘画
- 永久困住玩家
- 长时间搬运其他玩家
- 无限抱持
- 把他人扔进虚空
- 滥用漏洞
- 使用外挂
- 极端骚扰
- 与外挂者结伙

注意：前后移动挑衅（W+S）本身已不再构成封禁理由；若行为是故意表现性行为，而不只是挑衅，则另当别论。

举报需要三项内容。前两项体现在一段记录违规的短视频中：清楚拍到违规行为与对方名字，随后打开左侧玩家列表，展示该名字所对应的 Roblox 用户名。

第三项是上传视频并取得链接。举报要求提交证据链接，请确保已准备好。

随后进入[Gakuran 支持服务器](https://discord.com/channels/1439650635011330138/1505497147934773399/1525884738710143029)，填写举报嵌入消息要求的字段。“Username（用户名）”填写的是**被举报者**，不是你自己。

如果入口显示暂停收件、先处理现有举报，表示支持服务器当前已满。重新开放时不会另行公告；原卡称通常每天会重新开放，请持续留意。
cards.original:
To report people who broke the rules in Gakuran, first ensure that they broke one of the following rules:

> - Explicit Drawings
> - Permanent Trapping Players
> - Prolonged Carrying of Other Players
> - Infinite Holding
> - Throwing individuals into the void
> - Bug Abuse
> - Exploiting
> - Extreme Harassment
> - Exploiter Affiliation

Please note that: W+Sing is no longer bannable, unless it is an intentionally sexual act and not an act of toxicity.

When you report a player, you need three things. The first two, come in the form of a clip (short video recorded capturing the rule break). Within the clip, **ensure that it clearly captures the rule break occur with the person's name, and that you then open the left player list and show their name as it corresponds to their username.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a55591a629547648456a198/attachments/6a555bd0a34be7b841e385bd/previews/6a555bd1a34be7b841e385da/download/image.webp)

The third thing that is necessary for a proper report, is **that the clip is uploaded somewhere. When reporting, it requires you submit a link as evidence**; so, ensure that you have one.

After that, please make sure that you are in the [Gakuran Support Server](https://discord.com/channels/1439650635011330138/1505497147934773399/1525884738710143029 "‌") and fill out the required fields in the report embed. For the use “Username” field, make sure **it's the person BEING reported**, not YOU.

If it says they are no longer taking reports to focus on the ones they have: It means that the support server is full. There is not an announcement for when they re-open; however, it re-opened on a daily basis, just stay diligent.

cards.title: PS+ 私服管理指南
cards.body:
打开左侧菜单并选择“Commands（指令）”，即可进入 PS+ 管理面板。

### 服务器指令
面板首先展示一些服务器通用选项，包括天气和一天中的时间，可通过滑块与按钮控制。

通用选项后半部分有两种公告：附近公告与全服公告。全服公告发送给整个服务器，附近公告发送给自身周围指定半径内的玩家，距离单位为格。

最后还有若干可直接按界面说明使用的全局指令。

### 单个玩家指令
“PLAYERS（玩家）”标签页用于对单个玩家执行操作。第一项可封禁玩家并指定期限。

标签页顶部可搜索并滚动查看当前服务器的在线成员，也能解除已封禁玩家的封禁。

点击玩家后，可执行以下操作：

**动作**
- 拉到身边
- 前往目标
- 重生
- 治疗
- 踢出

**角色**
- 设置角色：从已创建的可用角色中选择。
- 面板访问权：授予管理员权限。

**状态**
- 无敌模式
- 冻结
- 隐身
- 飞行

**视觉**
- 透视
- 查看其他玩家血条
- 自由镜头范围：5—5,000格

**移动**
- 行走速度：4—60
- 重置行走速度

**封禁**
- 期限：永久，或1—365天

### NPC 指令
在“NPC”标签页可生成具有不同用途的 NPC，包括具备智能行为的 NPC。
1. 生成一名基础 NPC，坐到距离自己最近的座位。
2. 生成1—50名 NPC，分别坐到离自己最近的空座。
3. 在面前生成1—120名 NPC，组成一群人。
4. 生成演奏 NPC，与你一起表演。鼓手和键盘手需要空闲乐器，其他演奏者会自带乐器。
5. 生成友军小队，在身后跟随，也会一起战斗。可用“/s follow”命令跟随，用“/s attack”命令攻击，并可指定他们的服装。
6. 移除身边最近的 NPC，也可输入名字移除指定 NPC。

### 角色指令
可在私服创建多种角色，并通过前述玩家指令分配给其他人。

可自定义角色颜色、是否拥有管理员面板访问权，以及服装。

### 区域指令
此面板可切换不同区域的安全区状态，也显示玩家所在位置。

### 音乐指令
音乐部分第一项可粘贴歌曲ID播放；粘贴多个ID会建立播放队列。

混音与播放控制支持跳过、返回、暂停和播放，也可控制歌曲速度与音量。

### 篮球指令
PS+ 面板的篮球分类提供以下自定义选项：
- 队伍
- 队伍自定义
- 比赛计时
- 比分
- 进攻时钟

### 排球指令
PS+ 面板的排球分类提供以下自定义选项：
- 队伍
- 比赛
- 比分

### 游戏模式如何运作
私服新增“Modes（模式）”分类，进入后有6种选择。点击各模式按钮会显示简要规则说明。

#### 帮派战（Gang War）
两个帮派战斗，允许重生。击倒敌人获得1分，终结获得2分。先达到目标分数的帮派获胜；时间耗尽时，分数较高者获胜。队友可长按按钮扶起倒地玩家，否则倒地玩家20秒后失血死亡，在基地重生。

#### 地盘战（Turf War）
地图有3个区域：A靠近一方基地，B位于中央，C靠近另一方基地。区域内没有敌人时，站在其中即可占领，队友能加快速度。已占领区域每秒提供1分；占领区域、击倒或终结敌人各获得5分。占领一个区域会使领先方损失20分。达到目标分数后，落后方进入崩溃阶段，倒地玩家将无法重生。

#### 突袭（Raid）
一方进攻学校，一方防守。进攻方必须护送卡车到正门，只有附近有进攻者且没有防守者时，卡车才会移动。卡车承受60次命中后被摧毁。校门被突破后，进攻方进入庭院，击败包括番长在内的剩余防守者。番长拥有额外生命，且最终阶段无法重生。进攻方共用有限的复活次数；卡车被毁、复活次数耗尽或时间结束，均由防守方获胜。

#### 最后帮派（Last Gang Standing）
无重生的团队模式。队友可长按按钮扶起倒地玩家；被终结或倒地20秒失血死亡后，本轮淘汰。最后仍有成员站立的一方赢得本轮；时间耗尽时，存活人数更多的一方获胜。赢得最多轮数的一方赢得整场比赛。

#### 单挑（Taiman）
1对1或2对2，在玩家当前位置开始，附近有观众围观。无法重生，最后仍站立的一方赢得本轮。赢得最多轮数的一方获胜，双方人数必须相同才能开始。

#### 夺旗（Hatatori）
地图上放置3面旗。长按按钮拿起旗帜，带回己方神社保存。敌方可以夺走已保存的旗帜；被击倒会掉落携带的旗帜，掉落旗帜30秒后返回初始位置。同时持有3面旗并保持规定时间即可获胜；时间结束时，保存旗帜最多的一方获胜。
cards.original:
To open the PS+ Command panel, open the left menu and select “Commands.”

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaef9ee93ad8c3a9b6c0ef9/previews/6aaef9ef93ad8c3a9b6c1165/download/image.webp)

### Server Commands:

Once the command panel is open, you are greeted by a few miscellaneous server options. First, are the weather and time of day, which can be controlled via slider and buttons.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa07558cd9e95e69fa44/previews/6aaefa07558cd9e95e69fcc1/download/image.webp)

On the second half of the miscellaneous server options, you are able to do two types of announcements: Proximity and Server. Server announcements send messages to the entire server, while proximity announcements send messages to those around (via a controlled radius). More specifically, it will send messages to people that are within a given distance around you. The unit of measurement used is studs.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa164a88cccc625e44a3/previews/6aaefa164a88cccc625e4731/download/image.webp)

Lastly, there are a few global commands that are self-explanatory:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa22f88851f07a273dd4/previews/6aaefa22f88851f07a2740a3/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa294f874e6f20f0b4e6/previews/6aaefa2a4f874e6f20f0b809/download/image.webp)

### Individual player commands:

Next, is the “PLAYERS” tab, which allows for commands that can be used on singular persons.

The first tab is self-explanatory; it allows you to ban players for a determined duration:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa34458fd28255321602/previews/6aaefa35458fd282553219cf/download/image.webp)

At the top of the "PLAYERS" tab, you can search and scroll through any active members within your server.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa3b8f99d82e05287e54/previews/6aaefa3b8f99d82e0528813f/download/image.webp)

You can also unban any banned players:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa41460a2a99d1c2f53e/previews/6aaefa42460a2a99d1c2fb02/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa4d6720f8fbbde702f7/previews/6aaefa4e6720f8fbbde705e0/download/image.webp)

By clicking on a player, you can run a multitude of commands on them, including:

**Actions:**

- Bring
- Go To
- Respawn
- Heal
- Kick
  **Role:**
- Set Role (Choose between all available roles created)
- Panel Access (Grants Admin)
  **State**:
- Godmode
- Freeze
- Invisible
- Fly
  **Sight:**
- ESP
- See other health bars
- Freecam range (5-5000)
  **Movement:**
- Walk speed (4-60)
- Reset Walk Speed
  **Ban:**
- Duration (Forever, 1-365 days)

### NPC Commands:

The fourth command will allow you to spawn NPCs on instruments; they will perform with you. For drummer and keyboard NPC’s they need a free instrument, the other type of performers will spawn with their instrument.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefbf429277bdafaebfcc9/previews/6aaefbf629277bdafaec0307/download/image.webp)

The fifth command will spawn an Ally Squad of NPCs that will follow behind you. They can will also fight alongside you. You can command them with: “/s follow” and “/s attack”. You can also give them specific clothing.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefbfa6c10d88e85403b7a/previews/6aaefbfb6c10d88e85403ebd/download/image.webp)

‌

#### **How do games work:**


in the private, there's a new section called "modes" pressing it will give you 6 choices, pressing each mode button will make a small message appear of how everything works.

![modes.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6ada7ecfd6be0da92e3d46f5/previews/6ada7ed0d6be0da92e3d4b4c/download/modes.webp)

‌

#### Gang War

Two gangs fight with respawns enabled. Knocking an enemy down gives 1 point, while gripping them gives 2. The first gang to reach the score limit wins, or the gang with the most points when time runs out. Teammates can revive downed players by holding the button. Otherwise, they bleed out after 20 seconds and respawn at base.

#### Turf War

Three zones are placed across the map: A near one base, B in the middle, and C near the other base. Stand in a zone without enemies to capture it, with teammates making the process faster. Held zones give 1 point per second, while capturing a zone, knocking an enemy down, or finishing them off gives 5 points. Capturing a zone costs the leading side 20 points. Once the score limit is reached, the losing side enters the breaking phase, where downed players can no longer respawn.

#### Raid

One side attacks the school while the other defends it. Raiders must escort a truck to the front gate. It only moves when a raider is nearby and no defenders are close. The truck is destroyed after taking 60 hits. Once the gate falls, raiders push into the courtyard and fight the remaining defenders, including the Banchou, who has extra health and cannot respawn in the final phase. Raiders share a limited respawn pool. Defenders win if the truck is destroyed, the respawns run out, or time expires.

#### Last Gang Standing

A team-based mode with no respawns. Teammates can revive downed players by holding the button. Getting gripped or bleeding out after 20 seconds eliminates you for the rest of the round. The side with the last player standing wins, or the side with more survivors when time runs out. The side that wins the most rounds takes the match.

#### Taiman

A 1v1 or 2v2 fight that starts where the players are, with a crowd watching nearby. There are no respawns, and the last side standing wins the round. The side that wins the most rounds takes the match. Both sides must have the same number of players to start.

#### Hatatori

Three flags are placed around the map. Hold the button to pick one up, then bring it to your side's shrine to secure it. Enemies can steal secured flags, and getting knocked down makes you drop the flag you're carrying. Dropped flags return to their starting spot after 30 seconds. Hold all three flags for the required time to win, or have the most secured flags when time runs out.

cards.title: 吴
cards.body:
- 背水一战（Last Stand）：生命值较低、不高于25%时，总伤害提高15%。
- 摔倒（Takedown）：重击（M2）头槌抓住对手，使其迷失方向，造成1.5倍伤害。
- 震荡（Concussive）：重击（M2）摔击使受害者2秒内无法招架。
- 格挡穿透 II（Guard Pierce II）：15%的伤害穿透格挡。
- 韧性 I（Resilience I）：攻击相撞时有15%概率进入抓取对抗。

## 推荐配装
Kure推荐中高个角色，约5英尺9英寸／175厘米及以上，以发挥攻击距离，更容易持续施压。更长的距离能帮助你稳定命中重击，并抓住近身交战的破绽。

Kure凭借强力被动，擅长持久战。生命值低于25%时，“背水一战”增加15%伤害；“摔倒”将重击头槌升级为抓取，造成迷失效果与1.5倍伤害。“震荡”在重击摔击成功后封锁对手招架2秒，为继续进攻创造机会。“格挡穿透 II”提供15%格挡穿透伤害，“韧性 I”提供15%的碰撞抓取概率。

中高个最适合发挥压力与攻击距离，偏好机动性的玩家也可以选择矮个。Kure适合喜欢保持进攻、压倒对手的积极型玩家。

## 重击
基础冷却12秒。
cards.original:
```lua
Last Stand: When at low health (25% or less), +15% total damage
Takedown: M2 headbutt grabs opponents and disoreintates the victim dealing 1.5x damage
Concussive: M2 slam removes victim's ability to parry for 2 seconds
Guard Pierce II: 15% block chip damage
Resilience I: 15% chance to clash into a grapple
```

# **Perks:**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a526cd49016b66b2fcd5a25/attachments/6aa5d1afab61b321c01dcedb/previews/6aa5d1afab61b321c01dcf24/download/image.webp)

**Recommended Build:**
For the **Kure**, a **medium to tall height** _(around **5'9" / 175 cm** or taller)_ is recommended to maximize your reach and make it easier to apply constant pressure. The added range helps you land M2s more consistently and capitalize on openings during close range combat.

Kure excels in extended fights with its powerful passives. **Last Stand** grants **+15% damage** when below **25% health**, while **Takedown** upgrades your M2 headbutt into a grab that disorients the opponent and deals **1.5× damage**. **Concussive** prevents opponents from parrying for **2 seconds** after a successful M2 slam, giving you a strong opportunity to continue your offense. **Guard Pierce II** also deals **15% chip damage** through blocks, and **Resilience I** provides a **15% chance** to clash into a grapple.

While **medium and tall builds** are ideal for maximizing pressure and reach, **shorter builds are still a viable option** for players who prefer increased mobility. Kure is best suited for aggressive players who enjoy staying on the offensive and overwhelming their opponents.

cards.title: 私人服务器
cards.body:
可在菜单中生成私人服务器加入码，分享给朋友后，他们可用码与你一起进入私服。

点击“Edit（编辑）”可修改背景颜色、添加规则、更换加入码、限制玩家人数，也可粘贴 Roblox 社区链接。

## 关联 Roblox 社区
创建 Roblox 社区后，可以把社区职位关联到自定义角色，让拥有该职位的玩家自动获得对应角色。

也可将服务器限制为指定社区职位及以上的成员，例如“学生”及以上；职位更低或不在社区中的人无法用加入码进入。

cards.title: 抓取与拼招
cards.body:
两名斗士几乎同时打出同档位攻击，例如轻击对轻击、重击对重击时，可能发生拼招，也称抓取。

双方会短暂锁定在原地互相缠斗。进入缠斗前轻击连段更长的一方获胜，将对方推开，伤害减免50%。

---
cards.original:
When two fighters swing the same attack tier `(M1 vs M1, M2 vs M2)` at nearly the same time, their attacks can **clash (grapple).** Both fighters are locked in place clinching each other for a short period, the fighter with the longest M1 combo leading to the grapple wins, and shoves the other back with negated damage. (`-50%`)

![grapple.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a508efac2c2ce8af3130863/attachments/6a51896b81e8973ab8c1f594/previews/6a51897381e8973ab8c20578/download/grapple.gif)

cards.body:
**书法社**

位于一楼，正对生物教室、左侧楼梯旁。加入后，通过书写随机指定的书法内容赚取积分。完成任务获得积分、提升社团等级后，会解锁更多可书写的汉字。

书法社制服
cards.original:
**Calligraphy Club**

The Calligraphy club is found on the first floor right infront of the biology room and beside the stairs on the left. Upon joining the calligraphy club, your task for getting points is writing calligraphy. The calligraphy that you have to write is random. You unlock more kanji to write as you level your rank up by doing tasks for points.

cards.title: 滑板
cards.body:
滑板目前只能通过800 Robux的游戏通行证获得。

**移动：**W／A／S／D

**加速：**Shift

**跳跃／技巧：**空格键

**提示：**加速后更容易完成跳跃。

---

**如何获得滑板？**

- 玩家可以在庭院外发光的板面架处购买永久滑板。

---

**滑板指令**

打开表情动作轮盘，进入“移动”分类，即“表情动作→移动”，即可使用滑板指令。

进入“移动”分类后，可以使用以下指令：

- 装备，2：将滑板背在背上。
- 骑乘，2，滑板在背上时：立即从背上取下滑板并站上去开始滑行。
- 收起，3：将滑板从地图中移除。
- 放下，4：把滑板放在角色面前的地上。
- 拾取，2，滑板已放置时：如果滑板在可触及范围内，就将其捡起。
- 收起，3：将滑板从地图中移除。如果有人正在骑乘，则不能使用。

注意：“收起”会将滑板从地图中移除。

cards.title: 手机游戏
cards.body:
**游戏**

“游戏”应用让玩家直接用游戏内的手机体验一系列经典小游戏。无论是等朋友、在活动间隙休息，还是单纯想打发时间，都可以在这里找到熟悉的街机风格游戏。

进入方法：

1. 打开手机。
2. 选择“游戏”。
3. 在游戏库中选择一款。
4. 立即开始游玩。

游戏库包括以下经典作品：

- Snake（贪吃蛇）：引导不断变长的蛇在屏幕中移动，同时避免碰撞。
- Flappy Bird：把握点击时机，穿过障碍。
- 2048：合并数字相同的方块，争取尽可能高的分数。
- 以及许多其他经典或复古风格游戏。

所有小游戏都可以直接在手机上进行，无需离开游戏世界，适合休息时消遣。之后可能继续加入更多游戏，扩展可玩的内容。

无论是挑战高分还是随意游玩，这个应用都将经典手机游戏带进了游戏世界。
cards.original:
**Games**

The Games app allows players to enjoy a collection of classic mobile games directly from their phone in game. Whether you're waiting for a friend, relaxing between activities, or simply looking to pass the time, the Games app provides a variety of familiar arcade style experiences.

To access the Games app:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Games**.
3. Choose a game from the available library.
4. Start playing instantly.

The game library includes popular classics such as:

- **Snake** – Guide a growing snake around the screen while avoiding collisions.
- **Flappy Bird** – Navigate through obstacles by timing your taps carefully.
- **2048** – Combine matching numbered tiles to reach the highest score possible.
- And many other classic and retro inspired games.

Each game can be played directly from your phone without leaving the game world, offering a fun distraction whenever you need a break. Additional games may be added over time, expanding the collection of available activities.

Whether you're competing for high scores or simply playing for fun, the Games app brings a piece of classic mobile gaming into the world of the game.

cards.title: 篮球场
cards.body:
篮球场是一处室外运动区域，供玩家打篮球、与他人相聚。进入后可以看到多块有围栏的球场，配有篮筐、场地标线和侧边球架。

场上有3块蓝色站位垫和3块红色站位垫，可以站上去准备比赛。6块垫子全部亮绿时，表示比赛开始。

球场上方有大型顶棚，空间宽敞，保持开放和明亮。周围设有长椅、自动售货机、室外照明和绿化，方便球员在比赛间隙休息。玩家可以打球、练习投篮、组织比赛、与朋友竞技、参加排位篮球，或单纯在此闲逛和社交。
cards.original: **The Basketball Court** is an outdoor sports area, designed for players to enjoy basketball and spend time with others. As you walk in, you’ll find multiple fenced-in courts with basketball hoops, marked playing areas, and basketball racks along the side. There will be 3 blue pads to hop on and 3 red pads to hop on, and to know when you started the game it will have all 6 pads light up green. The court is covered by a large roof structure, providing a spacious environment to play while still keeping the area open and bright. Around the court, you’ll also find benches, vending machines, outdoor lighting, and surrounding greenery, giving players places to relax between games. Players can use the area to play basketball, practice shots, organize matches, compete with friends, and do rank basketball or simply hang out and socialize.

- **Whiteboards**, **chalk**, and **erasers** have been reintroduced.

# Fixes

**UI**

- Fixed the **Stats menu** appearing compressed on mobile devices.
- Fixed the **vending machine UI** not functioning correctly and appearing oversized on mobile.

**Combat**

- Synced **Hakari's hitboxes** with their animations.
- Fixed **Hold M1** not activating if pressed during a dash, stun, block, or similar action.
- Fixed **M1 vs. M1** and **M2 vs. M2** attacks cancelling each other out.

- **Bathroom doors** can now be opened.

cards.title: 战斗风格天赋
cards.body:
- **重手（Heavy Hitter）：**对防御刚刚被彻底打破的对手造成额外伤害。
- **防御穿透（Guard Pierce）：**让一定比例的伤害穿过对手格挡，直接伤害生命值。
- **韧性（Resilience）：**双方轻击在同一时刻碰撞时，有概率自动触发摔跤式抓取。
- **强力（Powerful）：**重击命中会将对手击飞，使其布娃娃倒地，期间无法控制角色。
- **压制力（Crushing Force）：**每次命中对格挡架势条造成额外伤害，让破防更容易。
- **反击（Counterstrike）：**成功完美格挡后，紧接着的下一次攻击获得暂时增伤。
- **摔倒制伏（Takedown）：**将重击变为抓取或砸地攻击，具有很高的伤害倍率。
- **霸体重击（Hyperarmor M2s）：**挥动重击时免于眩晕或中断，即使敌人先命中，也无法让这一拳停下。
- **切换架势（Switch Stance）：**连续第4次普通轻击减少重击冷却时间。

### 三岛
- **连击牵制（Consistency）：**对同一目标连续命中4次普通轻击且没有落空，会限制对方腿部，使移动速度减半。
  - 数值：持续4秒。
- **灵巧步法（Shifty）：**用冲刺成功躲过一次普通轻击，立即重置冲刺冷却，可以马上再次闪避。

### 阿里
- **身轻如蝶（Float Like a Butterfly）：**重击滑步在移动期间完全无敌，可直接穿过敌方攻击而不受伤。
- **刺痛如蜂（Sting Like a Bee）：**每次成功躲过攻击后，角色立即自动向前突进，直接反击对方。

### 基础
- **快速恢复（Swift Recovery）：**提高角色格挡架势条的自然恢复速度。
  - 数值：I阶，恢复速度提高15%。

### 拳击
- **不可触碰（Untouchable）：**重击快速打出两拳，期间有完全无敌的时刻，可以安全承受敌方第一击，再格挡第二击。

### 卡波耶拉
- **摇摆步（Ginga）：**缩短再次使用闪避冲刺前的等待时间。
  - 数值：冷却时间减少25%。

### 近身格斗
- **杀意（Killing Intent）：**标记最近的敌人，强制角色向前冲刺，打出5次无法阻止的攻击。只有在最初0.5秒内受到攻击才能被打断。
- **占据上风（Upper Hand）：**赢得抓取后获得5秒增益，每次命中逐步提高伤害。
  - 数值：每击增伤5%，最多叠加至25%。
- **首领围攻（Boss Raid）：**每名不同的敌方玩家命中自己，都会给予持续的总伤害提升。
  - 数值：每名不同玩家增伤2%，每条生命最多叠至10%。

### 秤
- **势头冲击（Momentum Rush）：**连续命中3次普通轻击且没有被打断，开启爆发窗口，使重击造成高倍率多段伤害。
  - 数值：持续7秒，伤害3倍。

### 空手道
- **镇定心神（Steady Nerves）：**成功完美格挡后，暂时提高架势恢复速度。
  - 数值：恢复速度提高15%，持续3秒。
- **平衡打击（Balanced Strike）：**重击命中后立即返还一部分用于该动作的架势能量。
  - 数值：返还25%能量。

### 踢拳
- **低位防守（Low Guard）：**踢击两段全部命中后，短时间大幅增加对手的闪避冷却。
  - 数值：冷却时间增加40%，持续5秒。

### 吴
- **背水一战（Last Stand）：**生命降到指定阈值以下时，角色进入狂怒，提高所有伤害。
  - 数值：生命低于25%时触发，总伤害提高15%。

### 极真空手道
- **黑曜石骨骼（Obsidian Skeleton）：**强化身体，持续减少任何敌方攻击造成的所有伤害。
  - 数值：受到伤害减少10%。

### 重拳手
- **不稳定（Unstable）：**让角色成为高风险高输出的玻璃大炮，增加自身伤害，也提高受到的伤害。
  - 数值：造成伤害提高40%，受到伤害提高15%。

### 突击者
- **打乱节奏（Broken Rhythm）：**连段中每拳都比前一拳更快，使攻速难以预测，也更难格挡。
  - 数值：挥击间隔从0.35秒缩短至0.12秒。
- **佯攻（Feint）：**重击变为欺骗动作，先假踢诱骗对手，再稍后打出真实命中，同时仍可安全格挡。
  - 数值：0.15秒出现假动作，0.40秒实际命中。

### 咏春
- **黐手（Sticky Hands）：**普通重击改为防守架势，接住并抵消来袭攻击，自动以连段反击。
- **快手（Swift Hands）：**持续提高普通轻击速度，代价是每拳原始伤害略降。
  - 数值：速度提高8%，每击伤害减少0.2。
- **终结一击（Final Blow）：**在普通连段中加入强力收尾，让最后一拳伤害提高。
  - 数值：伤害1.5倍。
- **稳固（Fortified）：**提高格挡防御，使承受攻击时损失的架势更少。
  - 数值：I阶，格挡时架势损失减少10%。

- **Hyperarmor M2s**: Protects you from being stunned or interrupted while swinging a heavy attack, meaning the enemy cannot stop your punch even if they hit you first.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae89a3c8a2cb203a60d6075/previews/6ae89a3c8a2cb203a60d60de/download/image.webp)

- **Switch Stance**: Your 4th consecutive basic light attack reduces the waiting timer of your heavy attack.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae899b7ccd34ef572f5b681/previews/6ae899b7ccd34ef572f5b730/download/image.webp)

## **UNIQUE STYLE PERKS**

### **Mishima**

- **Consistency**: Landing 4 basic light attacks on the same target without missing cripples their legs, cutting their movement speed in half.

> _Stats:_ `4 seconds`

- **Shifty**: Successfully dodging a basic light attack with your dash instantly resets your dash timer so you can dodge again right away.

### **Ali**

- **Float Like a Butterfly**: Your critical dodge shuffle makes you completely invincible during the movement, letting you slide clean through enemy attacks without taking damage.
- **Sting Like a Bee**: Whenever you successfully dodge an attack, your character automatically and instantly lunges forward with a counter-attack straight at the enemy.

### **Basic**

- **Swift Recovery**: Increases the speed at which your character naturally recovers their blocking shield meter.

> _Stats:_ Tier I (`+15% recovery speed`)

### **Boxing**

- **Untouchable**: Your heavy attack fires a fast two-punch combo with moments of complete invincibility, letting you safely absorb the first enemy hit and block the second one.

### **Capoeira**

- **Ginga**: Shortens the waiting timer before you can use your dodge dash again.

> _Stats:_ `-25% waiting time`

### **CQC**

- **Killing Intent**: Marks the closest enemy and forces your character to dash forward with five unstoppable strikes. (Can only be stopped if you are hit in the first 0.5 seconds).
- **Upper Hand**: Winning a wrestling grab grants a 5-second buff where every hit you land increases your damage step-by-step.

> _Stats:_ `+5% damage per hit` (Maximum stack up to `+25%`)

- **Boss Raid**: Gives a permanent total damage boost for every unique enemy player that hits you.

> _Stats:_ `+2% damage per unique player` (Maximum stack up to `+10%` per life)

### **Hakari**

- **Momentum Rush**: Landing 3 basic light attacks in a row without getting interrupted unlocks a fury window where your heavy attack deals massive multi-hit damage.

> _Stats:_ `7 seconds duration` | `3x damage output`

### **Karate**

- **Steady Nerves**: Executing a perfectly timed block gives you a temporary boost to your shield recovery speed.

> _Stats:_ `+15% recovery speed` for `3 seconds`

- **Balanced Strike**: Landing a heavy attack instantly gives you back a chunk of the shield energy you spent to use the move.

> _Stats:_ `25% energy back`

### **Kickboxing**

- **Low Guard**: Landing both hits of your kick attack increases the enemy's dodge dash cooldown timer massively for a brief time.

> _Stats:_ `+40% waiting time` for `5 seconds`

### **Kure**

- **Last Stand**: When your health drops below a specific threshold, your character enters a rage that increases all your damage output.

> _Stats:_ Activates below `25% HP` | `+15% total damage`

### **Kyokushin**

- **Obsidian Skeleton**: Hardens your body to permanently reduce all incoming damage that you take from any enemy attack.

> _Stats:_ `-10% damage taken`

### **Slugger**

- **Unstable**: Turns your character into a glass cannon, increasing the damage you deal but making you take more damage when enemies hit you.

> _Stats:_ `+40% damage dealt` | `+15% damage taken`

### **Striker**

- **Broken Rhythm**: Every punch in your combo chain swings faster than the last one, making your attack speed completely unpredictable and hard to block.

> _Stats:_ From `0.35s` speed down to `0.12s` speed

- **Feint**: Turns your critical move into a trick attack that fakes a kick to bait the enemy, then lands the real hit a split second later while letting you block safely.

> _Stats:_ Fake setup at `0.15s` | Real hit at `0.40s`

### **Wing Chun**

- **Sticky Hands**: Replaces your regular heavy attack with a defensive guard that catches incoming enemy strikes, cancels them out, and automatically counters with a combo.
- **Swift Hands**: Permanently increases the swing speed of your basic light attacks at the cost of losing a tiny bit of raw damage per punch.

> _Stats:_ `+8% faster speed` | `-0.2 damage per hit`

- **Final Blow**: Adds a powerful finisher effect to your basic attack chain, causing the very last punch of your combo to deal increased damage.

> _Stats:_ `1.5x more damage`

- **Fortified**: Increases your blocking defenses, causing you to lose less shield meter when you block enemy hits.

> _Stats:_ Tier I (`-10% shield loss while blocking`)

A character's hair color is determined by their ethnicity, which links them to a specific table of natural RGB color values, when a character is generated, there is a 95% chance they will receive a natural hair color fitting their demographic—such as Japanese primarily pulling black hair, and European drawing from a wider range like brown, blonde, or auburn. The remaining 5% of the time, a "hair dye" event triggers, generating a random RGB color from the wheel.

**This hair dye pool can include colors like:**

- Dark Blue
- Dark Red

cards.title: Socialink交换联系人
cards.body:
**Social Link（交换联系方式）**

Social Link让玩家快速交换联系信息，类似现代智能手机的联系人共享功能。

两名角色靠近时，可以在各自手机上打开这项功能并让手机靠近。建立连接后，双方即可立即交换联系信息，无需手动输入姓名或其他资料。

使用方法：

1. 打开手机。
2. 选择Social Link。
3. 请另一名玩家也打开Social Link。
4. 将两部手机靠近。
5. 确认连接请求。

交换成功后，双方会自动加入彼此的联系人列表。之后可以发送消息、保持联系，并使用未来需要已保存联系人的手机功能。

Social Link是结识新朋友、建立游戏内社交网络的主要方式，让你方便快捷地联系在世界中遇到的人。
cards.original:
**Social Link**

Social Link is a phone feature that allows players to quickly exchange contact information with one another, similar to the contact sharing features found on modern smartphones.

When two characters are near each other, they can use Social Link by opening the feature on their phones and holding their devices close together. Once the connection is established, both players can instantly exchange their contact information without manually entering names or details.

To use Social Link:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Social Link**.
3. Have the other player open Social Link as well.
4. Hold the phones close together.
5. Confirm the connection request.

After a successful exchange, both characters will be added to each other's Contacts list automatically. From there, they can send messages, stay connected, and access any future phone features that require a saved contact.

Social Link is the primary way to meet new people and build your network in game, making it quick and convenient to connect with new friends you encounter throughout the world.

cards.title: Line消息
cards.body:
这是手机上主要的通信工具，也是应用列表中的第一个应用。打开后会显示已保存的联系人，可以随时向他们发送私信。消息支持跨服务器发送，即使朋友在不同服务器也能联系。

消息时间戳采用发送时的游戏内时间。间隔1天或更久的消息，会在对话开头标明日期。


打开Line并进入消息页面后，右上角有屏蔽图标。点击后图标变红，对方将无法联系你，直到你解除屏蔽；解除之前，你也无法联系对方。
cards.original:
# Line App

The primary way of communication over the phone, and the first app in the roster. It opens up to a screen of your saved contacts, allowing you to direct message them at any time. The messages can send **cross-server**, so feel free to message your friends even if they're in a different server. Messages are time-stamped according to the time ingame when sent, and messages 1 day or more apart will be designated with their date at the start of a conversation.

### Blocking contacts:

Clicking line then opening up messages, on the top right there will be a block icon. Once that is clicked it will turn red and that player would be unable to contact you until you unblock them. You will also be unable to contact them until you unblock them

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a7ce45a34d0d8d8ca06f909/attachments/6a80c79f9a7484582eb6536f/previews/6a80c7a09a7484582eb65386/download/image.webp)

cards.title: 食堂
cards.body:
食堂位于室外篮球场对面，是供学生就座和社交的宽敞空间。进入后是一间开阔餐厅，铺有光洁木地板，摆放长条野餐桌、小圆桌，座位充足。

食堂前方设有供餐台，菜单牌展示不同餐点，呈现真实学校食堂的氛围。大窗户可以看到室外，温暖的木地板和简洁装潢让室内舒适放松。玩家可以在这里会见朋友、交流、扮演学生，或在各项活动之间休息。
cards.original:
**The Cafeteria** is a spacious its across from the outdoor basketball court where students sit down, and socialize. As you walk through the entrance, you’re greeted by a large open dining hall with polished wooden floors, long picnic-style tables, smaller round tables, and plenty of seating throughout the room. At the front of the cafeteria, there is a serving counter with menu boards displaying different meals, giving the area the feel of an actual school dining hall. Large windows provide views of the outside, while the warm wooden flooring and simple interior create a comfortable atmosphere. Players can use the cafeteria to meet with friends, socialize, roleplay as students, and take a break between activities.

cards.title: 漫画店
cards.body:
漫画店位于Nishikata高中外、Dante's Yakiniku烤肉店附近。进店后可以在门边拿起红色购物篮，必须手持购物篮才能挑选漫画。

店内有许多书架，可浏览可购买的漫画。手中有购物篮时，可以选择一册放入篮子，但篮中同时只能放1册。选好后，与前台收银员互动即可付款，交易会立即完成。

把漫画拿在手中，可以打开阅读并随意翻页。读完后，与大多数可互动物品一样，可以将其放下或丢下。

如果把漫画放在篮中却未付款就试图离店，警报会响起，偷拿的商品也会被收回。

**店内可购买以下漫画，每册¥550：**
cards.original:
The Manga Shop is located just outside of Nishikata High, nearby Dante's Yakiniku. Within the shop, you may pick up a Red Basket by the door. It is required to be holding one before you are able to pick out any manga volumes. Many shelves can be found within the shop, where you can browse through available manga; if you have a basket in hand, you may pick one to place in the basket (you can only have one in the basket at once). Once you have a manga volume in your basket, you may interact with the cashier at the front desk to pay for it. The transaction will complete immediately. With the manga in hand, you are able to open it to view its contents and flip through the pages as desired. When you are done with it, it can be placed down / dropped just like most other interactable items. If you attempt to leave the Manga Shop with a manga volume in the basket without paying, an alarm will sound, and your stolen goods will be returned.

cards.title: 运动特质
cards.body:
# 运动特质
每项运动——篮球、排球和足球——都有两个启用中的特质槽，用来调整打法。

- **主槽：**发挥100%效果。
- **副槽：**发挥75%效果。
- **交换：**可随时交换两个槽位的特质。
- **重抽：**每次花费250日元或1张票券。

> 重抽绝不会获得另一槽当前启用的特质。

### 传说
- **神射手（Sharpshooter）：**跳投绿色判定窗扩大10%。
- **快速出手（Quick Release）：**跳投动作及其计量条速度提高10%。

### 史诗
- **隔人暴扣（Posterizer）：**跑动扣篮的起跳点可距离篮筐远5格。
- **手感火热（Heat Check）：**每次连续命中使绿色判定窗扩大3.3%，最多累计3次；投丢会重置。
- **严密防守（Lockdown）：**防守干扰效果提高15%。
- **妙传手（Dimer）：**传球飞行速度提高55%，队友可在远5.5格的位置接到球。

### 优良
- **射手手感（Shooter's Touch）：**黄色和橙色出手的命中概率提高5个百分点。
- **冷血心态（Ice Veins）：**本队落后至少5分时，绿色判定窗扩大7%。
- **神偷（Pickpocket）：**抢断成功概率提高5个百分点。
- **高难投篮（Tough Shot）：**防守者对投篮的干扰效果降低5%。
- **接球投篮（Catch and Shoot）：**接到传球后2秒内跳投，绿色判定窗扩大5%。
- **脚踝终结者（Ankle Breaker）：**运球动作晃倒对手的概率提高4.4个百分点。
- **快速运球（Speed Dribbler）：**持球跑动速度提高5%。
- **滞空（Hang Time）：**空中停留时间延长20%，跳跃高度不变。
- **篮筐守护者（Rim Protector）：**封盖成功概率提高5个百分点。
- **突破手（Slasher）：**上篮、近距离投篮、抛投和勾手的判定窗扩大8.8%。

### 普通
- **空接之城（Lob City）：**队友接到你的高吊球后，2秒内可在远1.65格的位置起跳扣篮。
- **弹簧腿（Springs）：**扣篮高度提高10%，封盖距离提高10%。
- **站稳脚步（Planted）：**被运球动作晃倒的概率降低4.4个百分点。
- **铁肺（Iron Lungs）：**耐力恢复速度提高11%。
- **快脚（Fast Feet）：**冲刺速度提高5%。
- **连续起跳（Pogo）：**落地后再次起跳的等待时间减少25%。
- **控球稳健（Tight Handles）：**对方抢断你的概率降低3.3个百分点。
- **快手（Quick Hands）：**再次伸手抢断的等待时间减少15%。
- **铜墙铁壁（Brick Wall）：**掩护撞倒对手的概率提高3.3个百分点。
- **耐力充沛（Endurance）：**冲刺耐力消耗减少11%。

---

### 传说
- **完美托球（Perfect Toss）：**队友扣击你传出的球时，该球扣球判定扩大4.4%。
- **弧线发球（Curve Serve）：**发球时按住左或右，可使球向该方向弯曲，最多15格。

### 史诗
- **强力发球（Big Serve）：**跳发球飞行速度提高10%。
- **破接球（Recieve Breaker）：**扣球破坏接球的概率提高275%。
- **重炮（Cannon）：**扣球飞行速度提高3.85%。
- **借手大师（Tool Master）：**借拦网打出的球，离手速度提高110%。
- **上旋球（Topspin）：**跳发球下坠加强40%，可以更用力击球同时保持界内。
- **节奏二传（Tempo Set）：**力量4和5的二传飞行速度提高5.5%。
- **阅读拦网（Read Blocker）：**敌方扣球手距离22格内时，可看到其选择的力量。
- **滑行拦网（Glide Blocker）：**空中拦网时横向移动速度提高4.4%。
- **中流砥柱（Anchor）：**接发球时，附近队友的接球判定扩大4.4%，不能叠加。

### 优良
- **高墙（Big Wall）：**拦网判定扩大4.4%。
- **远距离鱼跃（Long Dive）：**鱼跃距离提高7.7%。
- **高球（High Ball）：**力量1至3的二传高度提高25%。
- **滞空（Hang Time）：**空中停留时间延长20%，跳跃高度不变。
- **飘球大师（Float Master）：**飘球摆动增强110%。
- **宽广触及（Broad Reach）：**扣球判定扩大5%。
- **软拦网（Soft Block）：**打到自己手上的借手球，有38.5%概率变成较软的回球，便于后排救球。

### 普通
- **守护者（Guardian）：**鱼跃判定扩大5.5%。
- **弹簧腿（Springs）：**跳跃高度提高10%。
- **柔和双手（Soft Hands）：**二传判定扩大5.5%。
- **快脚（Fast Feet）：**冲刺速度提高10%。
- **铁肺（Iron Lungs）：**耐力恢复速度提高11%。
- **稳定平台（Stable Platform）：**接球被破坏的概率降低22%。
- **快速起身（Quick Recovery）：**鱼跃后起身速度提高11%。
- **长臂（Big Arms）：**接球判定宽度提高6.6%。
- **耐力充沛（Endurance）：**冲刺、跳跃和鱼跃的耐力消耗减少11%。

---

### 传说
- **弧线大师（Bender）：**弧线球弯曲程度提高25%。
- **进入状态（In the zone）：**心流计量填充速度提高15%。

### 史诗
- **紧密控球（Close Control）：**持球对速度的减慢效果降低10%。
- **花式高手（Trickster）：**挑球和假动作的冷却减少15%。
- **组织核心（Playmaker）：**队友接到你的传球后，3秒内踢球力量提高5%。
- **快速蓄力（Quick Charge）：**踢球蓄力速度提高15%。
- **重炮脚（Power Boot）：**踢球力量提高5%。

### 优良
- **大手套（Big Gloves）：**守门员的扑救和接球判定扩大5.5%。
- **铲球大师（Slide Master）：**铲球冷却减少15%。
- **一脚出球（One Timer）：**再次踢球的等待时间减少25%。
- **滞空（Hang Time）：**空中停留时间延长25%，跳跃高度不变。
- **猫科反射（Cat Reflexes）：**守门员扑救距离提高5.5%。

### 普通
- **推土机（Bulldozer）：**抢截把带球者击退的距离提高11%。
- **耐力充沛（Endurance）：**冲刺耐力消耗减少11%。
- **快脚（Fast Feet）：**冲刺速度提高5%。
- **弹簧腿（Springs）：**跳跃高度提高33%。
- **拳击解围（Punch Clear）：**扑挡后球远离球门的距离提高15%。
- **长腿（Long Legs）：**抢截距离提高5.5%。
- **铁肺（Iron Lungs）：**耐力恢复速度提高11%。

---

### 传说
- **精准妙传（Dime Dropper）：**队友可在远6%的距离接到你的传球。
- **争球（Jump Ball）：**双方同时伸手争球时，你的手按离球近0.3格计算。

### 史诗
- **炮臂（Cannon Arm）：**传球飞行速度提高4%。
- **磁吸（Magnet）：**接球距离提高5%。
- **难以捉摸（Elusive）：**对方必须靠近你额外5%的距离，才能触碰擒抱。
- **猎球手（Ball Hawk）：**面对对方传球时，你的接球距离提高8%。

### 优良
- **滞空（Hang Time）：**空中停留时间延长20%。
- **高点接球（High Point）：**可接到高0.3格的球。
- **突破（Breakaway）：**持球跑动速度提高5%。
- **伸臂阻挡（Stiff Arm）：**接球后无法被对方触碰擒抱的时间额外延长100毫秒。
- **游泳式突破（Swim Move）：**阻挡造成的减速效果降低15%。
- **环抱擒抱（Wrap Up）：**触碰擒抱持球者的距离提高6%。
- **飞身扑球（Layout）：**扑跃距离提高8%。

### 普通
- **快脚（Fast Feet）：**冲刺速度提高5%。
- **迅速再起（Bounce Back）：**扑跃冷却减少15%。
- **弹簧腿（Springs）：**跳跃高度提高10%。
- **铁肺（Iron Lung）：**耐力恢复速度提高11%。
- **耐力充沛（Endurance）：**冲刺耐力消耗减少11%。
- **黏手（Sticky Hands）：**接球窗口延长50毫秒。
- **压制阻挡（Pancake）：**被你阻挡的玩家减速时间延长15%。
- **开路机（Road Grader）：**阻挡距离提高8%。

---

## 得分特效
成功得分时触发的自定义动画，例如达阵、足球进球或篮球绿色出手。每种运动的特效独立抽取。

---

## 球体尾迹
通用外观项目，改变所有运动中你接触、踢出或投出的球的尾迹颜色。每次抽取给予完全随机的十六进制色码，各颜色等概率。

# Sport Traits

Each sport (Basketball, Volleyball, Soccer) features two active trait slots to modify your playstyle.

- **Primary Slot:** Operates at 100% full strength.
- **Sub Slot:** Operates at 75% strength.
- **Swapping:** Switch traits between the two slots at any time.
- **Rerolls:** Costs ¥250 or 1 Ticket.

> A reroll will never land on the trait active in your other slot.

**眼镜**

眼镜是可以通过游戏配饰抽取系统获得的面部配饰，用于自定义角色外观，共有两种样式。

cards.original:
**Glasses**

Glasses are face accessories that you can roll for through the game's accessory system. they let you customize your avatar's appearance and come in 2 distinct styles. 

• **Thick Black Glasses**- a more larger, bolder look that stands out on your face.

• **Thin Black Glasses**-a sleeker, more subtle style for a cleaner look. 

Aside from looking clean and nice, wearing glasses introduces a unique mechanic during combat. 

**What Occurs During Combat With Glasses**
If you take a heavy enough punch to the face, your glasses can get knocked completely off and drop to the ground. 

**What happens your glasses fly off:**

 • They are instantly unequipped 

 • Your screen becomes blurred, impairing your vision.

 • This blur effect stays on your screen until you get your glasses back.

**How to restore your normal vision**

• Locate where your glasses fell

• pick them up and equip them 

Once re-equipped, the blur effect clears up immediately.

cards.body:
室内体育馆是一座大型多用途体育设施，供团队比赛和学校活动使用。进门后是一块宽阔的室内场地，配有高大的玻璃屋顶、明亮顶灯、木地板和四周的电子记分牌。

馆内分为不同运动区域。一侧是5对5室内篮球场，有多个篮筐、场地标线、记分牌和供队伍比赛的空间；另一侧是排球场，中间架着高网，配有必要的场地标线和双方队伍的活动空间。

球场周围还有高架走道和观赛区域。开阔布局与专业风格设备，使其适合进行5对5篮球、排球、训练、锦标赛、学校活动及一般社交活动。

**The Indoor Gymnasium** is a large multi-purpose sports facility, built for organized team games and school activities. From the entrance, you walk into a large indoor court with a high glass ceiling, bright overhead lighting, wooden flooring, and electronic scoreboards positioned around the gym. The gym is divided into different sporting areas. One side features a 5v5 indoor basketball court, complete with multiple hoops, marked court lines, scoreboards, and space for teams to compete. On the other side is a volleyball court, separated by a tall net and equipped with the necessary court markings and space for two teams to play. The facility also includes raised walkways and viewing areas around the courts, With its large open layout and professional-style equipment, the gym is suitable for 5v5 basketball games, volleyball matches, practices, tournaments, school events, and general social activities.

cards.title: 霸体与无敌帧
cards.body:
## 霸体
攻击吸收一次命中而不畏缩。你仍承受完整伤害，但挥击不会被中断，会完成整个动作。

- 霸体不会阻止伤害。你承受命中，但继续挥击。
- 当前只有部分重击带霸体，从起手持续到攻击命中。
- 霸体只存在于特定风格。


---

## 无敌帧
无敌帧是角色完全无法被命中的短暂窗口。攻击会穿过角色，既不造成伤害、削血或受击硬直，也就是打空。

- 无敌帧内任何攻击都无法命中；与仍受完整伤害的霸体不同，这时伤害为0。
- 闪避是主要来源，作用于动画起手和移动阶段；收招时重新变得可被攻击。
- 无敌帧能避开打击，但无法免除拼招。
- 无敌结束后的收招阶段被命中，会承受完整惩罚；闪避落空可能比格挡更糟。
- 对抗超过1名对手时，额外获得一次带无敌帧的闪避。

### 包含无敌帧的风格天赋
- **不可触碰：**重击打出两拳连击，整个动画带无敌帧。每拳单独判定，可以吃下第一拳，再招架第二拳。见[拳击](https://trello.com/c/9zucAqBC)。
- **身轻如蝶：**重击滑步在整个前摇期间提供无敌帧，可直接穿过对手打来的攻击。见[阿里](https://trello.com/c/Roh6sIpv/168-ali)。
cards.original:
**Hyper-Armor** is when your attack absorbs a hit without flinching. You still take full damage, but your swing cannot be interrupted and plays out to completion.

- **Hyper-Armor does not stop damage.** You eat the hit, but you keep swinging.
- `M2s` are the only armored attacks currently, active from startup until the hit lands.
- **Hyper-Armor** is limited to certain styles.

**The combat style perks that include hyper-armor:**

- ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5105dbc5e9daa0207fc730/attachments/6ae89811dbcd250f355b59d1/previews/6ae89811dbcd250f355b59e8/download/image.webp)

---

**IFrames** are a brief window where your character is completely unhittable. Attacks pass through you dealing no damage, no chip, and no hitstun the hit simply whiffs.

- **Nothing connects during i-frames.** Unlike hyper armor, you take zero damage, not full damage.
- `Dodges` are the main i-frame moves, active only during the animation's startup and travel you are vulnerable again on recovery.
- I-frames avoid strikes, but **do not** save you from `clashing`.
- Getting hit on recovery (after the window ends) is a full punish, a whiffed dodge is worse than blocking.
- You are an additional **iframe dodge** when fighting more than 1 opponent.

**Combat style perks which include Iframes:**

- **Untouchable**
  M2ing throws a two-punch combo with **IFrames** for the whole animation. Each punch is its own attack. You can eat the first and parry the second. ([Boxing](https://trello.com/c/9zucAqBC "‌"))
- Float Like a Butterfly
  The crit shuffle grants **IFrames** for its entire windup, Shuffle straight through anything thrown at you. ([Ali](https://trello.com/c/Roh6sIpv/168-ali "‌"))

拳击推荐约5英尺1英寸／155厘米及以下的矮个角色，以获得游戏中最快的轻击。配合“格挡穿透（Guard Pierce）”天赋，这套组合十分强力。重击是独特的两段连击，全程具有无敌帧，攻防两端都很有用。尽量多招架，以利用原卡所称的“完美反射（Perfect Reflex）”天赋刷新重击。

基础冷却7秒。

cards.body:
**在Gakumart工作**

Gakumart位于Nishikata高中外。

要申请班次，打开手机上的Indeed兼职应用，选择可申请的招聘信息并提交申请。记得留意时间，以便知道何时需要前往Gakumart。

到店后，走到柜台后方，按E换上Gakumart工作服。整个班次期间留在店内即可赚取日元。下班时会自动换回原来的服装。

此外，走近店铺入口处的收银台，可以购买食物。
cards.original:
**Working at Gakumart**

Gakumart is located just outside Nishikata High School.

To apply for a shift, open the **Indeed app** on your phone, select one of the available job postings, and submit your application. Be sure to keep an eye on the time so you know when to head over to Gakumart.

Once you arrive, step **behind the counter** and press **E** to change into your Gakumart uniform. Remain inside the store during your shift to earn yen. When your shift ends, you'll automatically switch back into your original outfit.

- 扩展城镇开发期间使用临时占位地图，显著提高性能。

### 战斗
- 拳击重击（M2）完全重做为两段攻击。

### 游玩
- 修复吉他、贝斯卸下后无法显示完整模型的问题。

## 移除
- 旧城镇。

# Additions

- Added **Roleplay (RP) Servers** with:
  - **Server list** support
  - **PvP toggle**
  - **Vote kick** system
- Reworked animations for:
  - **Basic**
  - **Boxing**
  - **Hakari**

- Added a new instrument song: **Seasons**.
- Added the **Dojo Clubroom** on the third floor.

# Changes

**Map**

- Introduced a **placeholder map** while the expanded town is being developed, providing a significant **performance improvement**.

**Combat**

- Completely reworked **Boxing M2** into a **two-hit attack**.

# Fixes

**Gameplay**

- Fixed **guitars** and **basses** not displaying their full models after being unequipped.

# Removals

- Removed the old **town**.

perks.title: 强力击倒
perks.body: 重击（M2）命中时，使目标进入布娃娃倒地状态。

perks.title: 摧架之力 II
perks.body: 每次命中造成的架势伤害提高15%。

perks.title: 破防强击 III（满级）
perks.body: 轻击（M1）与重击（M2）造成破防时，该次命中的伤害提高15%。

perks.title: 格挡穿透 V（满级）
perks.body: 攻击被格挡时，仍有30%的伤害穿透格挡。

perks.title: 韧性 V（满级）
perks.body: 双方轻击（M1）相撞时，有55%概率进入抓取对抗。

cards.title: 突击者
cards.body:
## 推荐配装
突击者适合任何身高。高个角色随着持续轻击，可以变得像5英尺角色一样快，同时保留攻击距离；矮个则能获得极高速度，轻击几乎不会落空。

## 重击
冷却7秒。

cards.title: 眼罩
cards.body: 眼罩是Gakuran中的头部配饰，有多种款式。戴上眼罩后，第一人称视野会被部分遮挡。
cards.original:
The eyepatch is a head accessory within Gakuran featuring multiple variants. When wearing an eyepatch, vision is partially blocked in first person:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a67e120157f4fd462b02e40/attachments/6a67e15d7743a21607243204/previews/6a67e15e7743a2160724321f/download/image.webp)

cards.title: 足球场
cards.body:
足球场位于女仆咖啡馆和卡拉OK酒吧附近，是一块大型足球场地，周围有看台和明亮的泛光灯。

进入后可以看到标准大小的草地球场，配有清晰标线、中圈、球门和两侧观众席。宽敞的空间可以用于踢球、训练、组织比赛、举办锦标赛，也可以坐在看台上观赛。

周围的树木、体育场灯光和观众席营造出正式球场的感觉，同时也供玩家相聚、享受活动。
cards.original:
**The Soccer Pitch** is a big soccer field right near the maid cafe and the karaoke bar, surrounded by stadium seating and bright floodlights. As you walk onto the pitch, you’ll see a full-sized grass field with clearly marked lines, a center circle, goals, and seating areas along the sides. The stadium provides plenty of open space for players to play soccer, practice, organize matches, host tournaments, or watch games from the stands. With the surrounding trees, stadium lights, and spectator seating, the pitch has the feel of a proper sports stadium while still being a place for players to gather and enjoy activities.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac1673f53b965dde8b3dc37/attachments/6ac1677076ba7e986ee672d0/previews/6ac1677176ba7e986ee673bb/download/image.webp)

cards.title: 日元
cards.body:
玩家生成时会获得随机数量的日元。

目前可通过手机 Yenapp 接收其他玩家转账，或通过手机 Indeed 申请并完成工作班次取得日元。

日元可用于在 Gakumart 或 Dante 烤肉店购买食物、从自动贩卖机买饮品，以及点播卡拉 OK 歌曲。
cards.original:
Upon player spawn in you are given a random amount of Yen.

Currently obtainable via other players in the YenApp or working a Job shift via the Indeed app on the phone.

Yen is usable to purchase food from Gakumart or Dante’s Yikiniku Restaurant, purchase drinks from vending machines, and play karaoke songs.

cards.title: 休闲活动
cards.body:
**国际象棋**

国际象棋是供两人对弈的经典棋类游戏，位于桌游室。

- 对弈需要2名玩家。
- 国际象棋室有不同水平的NPC，可与其对弈。

注意：另一张座位没有玩家时，棋子仍然可以移动，因此不需要第二个人来启动棋局。

---

**四子棋**

位于国际象棋社活动室的经典双人游戏。双方轮流将彩色棋子投入竖立的棋盘，最先使自己的4枚棋子在横向、纵向或斜向连成一线的人获胜，适合在其他活动之间与朋友来一局。

---

**卡拉OK**

充满音乐、笑声和欢乐气氛的卡拉OK酒吧。可以选择喜欢的歌曲，与朋友一起上台演唱，也可以为别人加油。这里有彩色灯光、热闹的音乐，门外的自动售货机还出售饮料。无论是在Dante's Yakiniku烤肉店吃完饭，还是放学后，都可以来这里休息。要播放歌曲，与电视或桌上的平板电脑互动即可，每首歌收费¥100。

---

**掰手腕**

位于屋顶或咖啡馆的双人小游戏，双方通过快速反应事件比拼，掌握输入时机压倒对手。

**分数如何作用？**

判定分为：漏按、尚可、良好、完美。

- 双方分数越接近，分数较低的一方被压回的幅度越小。
- 双方分数差距越大，分数较低的一方被压回的幅度越大。

---


**PAC-MAN（吃豆人）**

控制一个张着大嘴的亮黄色圆形角色穿行于封闭迷宫。目标是在躲避4只彩色幽灵的同时吃完所有小豆。吃下闪烁的能量豆后，可以暂时反过来吃掉幽灵。吃水果可获得额外分数。

**ARCADE INVADERS（街机入侵者）**

经典固定射击游戏。控制屏幕底部的激光炮，在一排排外星人降至屏幕底部前将其击败。

**AIR HOCKEY（气垫球）**

用鼠标控制击球器，将球打入对方球门得1分，先得3分者获胜。

**ASTRO CROSSER（太空穿越者）**

目标是射击并摧毁漂移的大块岩石和偶尔出现的飞碟，同时控制飞船惯性，避免碰撞。

---

**抛硬币手势**

快速抛出一枚硬币，结果为正面或反面。

---

**掷骰子手势**

快速掷出一枚骰子，结果为1至6中的一个数字。

---

**石头剪刀布**

双人表情动作，可以玩经典的石头剪刀布。你和对手各自在石头、布、剪刀3个选项中选择。
cards.original:
**Chess:**

Chess is a classical game of skill played between two players tfound in the Board Game room.

- 2 players are required to play chess
- There are NPC’s found in the chess room with varying skill to play against

Note that: Chess pieces can still be moved without another player in the seat, meaning you don’t need another person to activate the game.

---

**Connect Four**

A classic two-player game located in the Chess Clubroom. Players take turns dropping colored discs into a vertical grid, and the first to line up four of their discs in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally — wins. A quick, easy way to challenge friends between activities.

---

**Karaoke**

Step into a lively karaoke bar where music, laughter, and good times come together. Guest can choose their favorite songs, sing on stage with friends or they can cheer you on! With colorful lights, energetic music, refreshing drinks from the vending machine outside. It's the perfect place to relax after having a dinner at _Dante's Yakiniku Restaurant_ or after the school day. _**To play a song**_, interact with either the Television or I-pad on the table (songs cost 100¥ to play).

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6a80d300dc41240ba6bdfdd9/previews/6a80d302dc41240ba6be01d9/download/image.webp)

---

**Arm Wrestling** A quick fun game of arm wrestling located on-top the roof or in the cafe, consisting of quick time events between two players, timing your inputs to best the other player. **How do scores work?** Different Scores: _Miss/Ok/Good/Perfect_

- The **CLOSER** you and your opponents scores are, the **LESS** the one with less is pushed back.
- The **FARTHER** you and your opponents scores are, the **MORE** the one with less is pushed back

![armwrestling.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6a79d824fd17219bccd0108a/previews/6a79d82ffd17219bccd022a4/download/armwrestling.gif)

---

## Arcade Room:

**PAC-MAN**
The player guides a bright yellow circular character with a wide mouth through a closed maze. The goal is to eat all small dots while avoiding four colorful ghosts. Eating flashing "**Power Pellets**" lets Pac-Man temporarily eat the ghosts. Eating fruits awards bonus points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a77a07422a0c317ea55fc71/attachments/6a77a21c8040294aeefc76b6/previews/6a77a21e8040294aeefc76d4/download/image.webp)

**ARCADE INVADERS**
A classic fixed shooter where you control a laser cannon at the bottom of the screen. Your goal is to defeat rows of descending aliens by shooting them before they reach the bottom of the screen.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a77a07422a0c317ea55fc71/attachments/6a77a242a4d9406001e2ed62/previews/6a77a243a4d9406001e2ed90/download/image.webp)

**AIR HOCKEY**
Your goal is to guide to score into the opponents goal and come out victorious. First to three wins The player controls the air hockey striker with their mouse; guide the puck into the other teams goal to win a point.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a77a07422a0c317ea55fc71/attachments/6a77a2b6cc23cec9131f4bb1/previews/6a77a2b7cc23cec9131f4bef/download/image.webp)

**ASTRO CROSSER**

The core objective is to shoot and destroy drifting large rocks and occasional flying saucers while managing ship momentum and avoiding crashes.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a77a07422a0c317ea55fc71/attachments/6a77a307f09ad4cae88bd42e/previews/6a77a308f09ad4cae88bd503/download/image.webp)

---

**Coin Flip Gesture**

A quick flip of the coin which determines either heads or tails.

![dldld.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6ac179cfab13fc381b0a28b0/previews/6ac179d7ab13fc381b0a3a94/download/dldld.gif)

---

**Dice Roll Gesture**

A quick dice roll that lands on a number one through six.

![dice\_roll.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6ac17a4c1dbc61f5c0be5303/previews/6ac17a531dbc61f5c0be5813/download/dice_roll.gif)

---

**Rock Paper Scissors**

A duo emote that plays the classic game of Rock Paper Scissors. You and your opponent can choose between the 3 options of Rock, Paper, & Scissors.

![ock\_paper.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6ac17acca2e9fed61213d1e1/previews/6ac17ad5a2e9fed61213e416/download/ock_paper.gif)

cards.title: 安全区
cards.body:
安全区是地图上禁止战斗的指定区域，进入后自动关闭战斗。带战斗标记的人尝试进入时，会被不可见墙壁挡住。

## 已知安全区
- 教室
- 音乐室
- Gakumart 柜台
- 医务室
- Dante 烤肉店
- 卡拉 OK 酒吧
- 体育馆
- 漫画店
- 街机房
cards.original:
Green-zones are a map function that designates a certain area in the map to be no-combat. Fighting is automatically turned off in green-zones. People with a combat tag will be blocked by an invisible wall when attempting to enter a green-zone.

- Gakumart Counter

cards.title: 垃圾桶
cards.body:
学校各处都有垃圾桶。只有手里拿着物品时才能与垃圾桶互动，可以丢弃以下物品：

- 自动售货机购买的空罐或满罐饮料。

如果尝试丢弃不能扔的物品，会出现以下提示之一：

> “我才不会扔掉这个。”
>
> “这个我要留着。”
>
> “我不会丢掉这个。”
>
> “这不是垃圾。”
>
> “我不会把它扔出去。”
>
> “我还需要它。”
cards.original:
Trashcans can be found located all over the school. Trashcans are only interactable if you are holding an item; they can be used to dispose of:

- Empty/Full cans from a vending machine.

‌

If you try to dispose of something non-disposable, you will be greeted with a message stating:

> “No way i’m tossing this.”
>
> “I’m keeping this.”
>
> “Not getting rid of this.”
>
> “This isn’t trash.”
>
> “I’m not throwing this out.”
>
> “I still need this.”

cards.title: YenApp转账
cards.body:
**Yen（日元支付）**

Yen是游戏的数字支付平台，让玩家通过手机即时收付日元。类似现代移动支付服务，玩家无需当面交换现金就能轻松转账。

设置应用时，需要选择一个唯一的收款标签，相当于个人支付用户名。其他玩家可以搜索这个标签，找到你并转账。

使用方法：

1. 打开手机。
2. 选择Yen支付应用。
3. 搜索对方的收款标签，或选择已保存的联系人。
4. 输入要发送的金额。
5. 确认付款。

功能包括：

- 收款标签：用于识别账户的唯一用户名。
- 付款：直接向其他玩家转账日元。
- 收款：其他玩家可以通过你的收款标签向你转账。
- 交易记录：查看以往的付款、转账和收款。
- 标签搜索：用收款标签快速找到其他玩家并转账。

应用会记录支付活动，方便查看过去的交易，以及资金的收支去向。可用于给朋友付款、分摊开销、购买物品、还债、经营生意，或接收其他玩家发放的工资。

Yen应用让玩家无需见面，也能快捷地管理财务和转移游戏内资金。
cards.original:
**Yen**

The Yen app is the game's digital payment platform, allowing players to send and receive yen instantly through their phones. Similar to modern mobile payment services, Yen makes it easy to transfer money between players without needing to exchange cash in person.

When setting up the app, players choose a unique **Yen Tag**, which acts as their personal payment username. Other players can search for this tag to find and send money to them.

To use Yen:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Yen**.
3. Search for a player's Yen Tag or select a saved contact.
4. Enter the amount you wish to send.
5. Confirm the payment.

Features include:

- **Yen Tag** – A unique username used to identify your account.
- **Send Payments** – Transfer yen directly to other players.
- **Receive Payments** – Other players can send yen to your Yen Tag.
- **Transaction History** – View previous payments, transfers, and receipts.
- **Tag Search** – Search for other players using their Yen Tag to quickly send money.

The app keeps a record of your payment activity, allowing you to review past transactions and track where your money has been sent or received. This makes it useful for paying friends, splitting expenses, buying items, repaying debts, conducting business, or receiving wages from other players.

The Yen app provides a fast and convenient way to manage your finances and move money throughout the game world without needing to meet face to face.

The contacts app will open up to a screen of your saved contacts, along with the ability to press on them to open up 4 options. Those options being:

**Call - Calls your contact.**

**Message - Open up the message app and the chat with your contact.**

**Rename - Allows you to change the name of your contact.**

**Delete - Removes the contact from your phone.**

cards.title: v2.929（#14）更新
cards.body:
## 新增
- 新增2种战斗风格：空手道、摔跤。
- 新闪避冲刺动画。
- 新双人动作Dap Up。
- 私人服务器新增命令：面板访问（Panel Access）、隐形（Invisible）、自由镜头距离调整（Freecam Distance Adjuster）。
- 私人服务器新增命令类别：区域（Areas）、安全区开关（Toggle Green Zones）。

### 战斗
- 拳击重击（M2）现在是命中后反击技，必须先成功命中一击才能发动。
- 摔跤重击现在具有霸体。
- 空手道移动速度提高25%。
- 摔跤移动速度提高12.5%。
- 空手道重击现在会使对手布娃娃倒地。
- 抓取胜者现在由双方连击数高低决定。

### 游玩
- 某些门必须用第一人称打开，现在会提示玩家。

## 修复
- 修复私人服务器不显示在服务器列表的问题。
- 修复布娃娃倒地后可能无法站起的问题。

## 移除
- 旧冲刺动画。
cards.original:
# Additions

- Added 2 new fighting styles:
  - **Karate**
  - **Wrestling**
- Added new evasive **dash animations**.
- Added the **Dap Up** duo emote.
- Added new private server commands:
  - **Panel Access**
  - **Invisible**
  - **Freecam Distance Adjuster**
- Added a new private server command category:
  - **Areas**
  - **Toggle Green Zones**

# Changes

**Combat**

- **Boxing M2** is now a hit counter and can only be activated after successfully landing a hit.
- **Wrestling M2** now has **Hyper Armor**.
- **Karate** movement speed increased by **25%**.
- **Wrestling** movement speed increased by **12.5%**.
- **Karate M2** now **ragdolls** opponents.
- **Grapple** winners are now determined by whoever has the higher **combo count**.

**Gameplay**

- Players are now notified that certain doors must be opened in **first-person**.

# Fixes

- Fixed **private servers** not appearing in the server list.
- Fixed an issue where players could become unable to stand up after being **ragdolled**.

# Removals

- Removed the old **dash animations**.
