cards.title: 杂项互动
cards.body:
**自动售货机**

走到自动售货机前，按互动键（E／手柄X键／□键／触屏点击），即可打开购买饮料的界面。

---

**垃圾桶**

学校各处都有垃圾桶。只有手里拿着物品时才能互动，可以丢弃自动售货机购买的空罐或满罐饮料。

如果尝试丢弃不能扔的物品，会出现以下提示之一：

> “我才不会扔掉这个。”
>
> “这个我要留着。”
>
> “我不会丢掉这个。”
>
> “这不是垃圾。”
>
> “我不会把它扔出去。”
>
> “我还需要它。”

---

**放置／丢弃**

拿着物品时按Backspace，可以选择放置或丢弃。
cards.original:
**Vending Machines:**

To use vending machines, you must first walk up to it and press the interact button (E/X Button/Square/Tap) which will greet you with a UI to purchase drinks

---

**Trashcans:**

Trashcans can be found located all over the school. Trashcans are only interactable if you are holding an item; they can be used to dispose of:

- Empty/Full cans from a vending machine.

If you try to dispose of something non-disposable, you will be greeted with a message stating:

> “No way i’m tossing this.”
>
> “I’m keeping this.”
>
> “Not getting rid of this.”
>
> “This isn’t trash.”
>
> “I’m not throwing this out.”
>
> “I still need this.”

---

**Placing / Dropping:**

You are able to choose between placing and dropping items by pressing backspace while holding something.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79e207ed97fbc48719900b/attachments/6a79edce19921da27d6bf2db/previews/6a79edce19921da27d6bf307/download/image.webp)

## 推荐配装
Giovanna很适合矮个，重击是这套风格的重要手段。4英尺11英寸的角色能充分利用冷却优势，偏进攻的玩家会因此得到不错的获胜机会。高个也可以采用防守打法，如何选择由你决定。

cards.title: 街机室
cards.body:
**PAC-MAN（吃豆人）**

控制一个张着大嘴的亮黄色圆形角色穿行于封闭迷宫。目标是在躲避4只彩色幽灵的同时吃完所有小豆。吃下闪烁的能量豆后，可以暂时反过来吃掉幽灵。吃水果可获得额外分数。

**ARCADE INVADERS（街机入侵者）**

经典固定射击游戏。控制屏幕底部的激光炮，在一排排外星人降至屏幕底部前将其击败。

**AIR HOCKEY（气垫球）**

用鼠标控制击球器，将球打入对方球门得1分，先得3分者获胜。

**ASTRO CROSSER（太空穿越者）**

目标是射击并摧毁漂移的大块岩石和偶尔出现的飞碟，同时控制飞船惯性，避免碰撞。
cards.original:
**PAC-MAN**
The player guides a bright yellow circular character with a wide mouth through a closed maze. The goal is to eat all small dots while avoiding four colorful ghosts. Eating flashing "**Power Pellets**" lets Pac-Man temporarily eat the ghosts. Eating fruits awards bonus points.

A classic fixed shooter where you control a laser cannon at the bottom of the screen. Your goal is to defeat rows of descending aliens by shooting them before they reach the bottom of the screen.

Your goal is to guide to score into the opponents goal and come out victorious. First to three wins The player controls the air hockey striker with their mouse; guide the puck into the other teams goal to win a point.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a77a07422a0c317ea55fc71/attachments/6a77a2b6cc23cec9131f4bb1/previews/6a77a2b7cc23cec9131f4bef/download/image.webp)

**ASTRO CROSSER**

The core objective is to shoot and destroy drifting large rocks and occasional flying saucers while managing ship momentum and avoiding crashes.

cards.title: NPC互动
cards.body:
每个NPC都有不同的性格，说话方式也不同。NPC能够读取自身的年级、年龄、身高和族裔等属性，这些信息会影响回答。他们也能读取你的属性，并在交谈时提及。

---


可以用/s等指令喊话或低语，NPC有时也会以低语或喊话回应，但并非每次如此。有些NPC不喜欢别人喊话，或认为喊叫很奇怪。

---


NPC能够记住你。告诉NPC自己的名字后，对方会记住；离开后回来问“你认识我吗”，对方会提到你的名字，并说你刚才来过。

---


NPC互动也会受时间影响。早上即将上课时，他们会提醒你该去上课了。NPC可以提到时间和你应该去上的课；询问该去上什么课时，有些NPC还会说明课程的确切持续时间。

---


NPC知道自己身在何处。向他们询问时，会根据所在位置告诉你地点，以及你应该去上什么课。
cards.original:
## NPCs:

Each NPC has a different personality which means that each of them can speak differently. They're able to read their stats such as grade, age, height and ethnicity which all alter how they will/can answer. NPCs are also able to read your own stats and mention them in a conversation.

---

## Commands:

You can use commands such as /s to shout or whisper and they'll whisper/shout back at you (not always). Some NPCs do not like shouting or will find it weird to shout.

---

## Memory:

NPCs can remember you. If you tell an NPC their name, they'll remember it and when you go away and come back to ask them "do you know me" they'll mention your name and say how you were here a second ago.

---

## Time:

NPC interactions also depend on time. When it's morning and a class is starting, they'll tell you how it's time to go to class
they're able to mention the time and which class you need be in, if you ask them which class to go some will say the exact time of how long it'll last

---

## Locations:

NPCs know their location, depending on where they stand, they'll mention it if you ask them and also what class you must be

cards.title: 泰拳
cards.body:
## 推荐配装
泰拳推荐偏矮至中等身高，约5英尺3英寸／160厘米及以下，以充分发挥最后两项天赋。矮个能更快进攻，从而利用游戏中最高的碰撞抓取概率，更频繁地触发碰撞；配合最高的格挡穿透，可在命中并伤害格挡中的对手时，让自己更难受到惩罚。

出于这些原因，原卡推荐非常积极的进攻打法。“摧架之力（Crushing Force）”还可更容易磨掉对手的架势，因此泰拳对付被动防守的敌人尤其强力。

## 重击
基础冷却7秒。

cards.title: 拨号
cards.body:
**拨号**

拨号应用类似普通电话键盘，可以向联系人列表中的人拨打电话。

使用方法：

1. 打开手机。
2. 选择“拨号”。
3. 输入手机号码。
4. 按呼叫按钮开始拨打。

拨出后，对方的手机会收到来电通知，可以选择接听或忽略。接通后，无论双方身处游戏世界的何处，都可以通过手机交流。

拨号应用提供直接联系其他玩家的方式，适合协调活动、讨论计划，或单纯聊天。
cards.original:
**Dial**

The Dial app functions like a standard phone keypad, allowing players to place phone calls to people in their Contacts list.

To use Dial:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Dial**.
3. Enter a phone number.
4. Press the call button to start the call.

When a call is placed, the recipient will receive an incoming call notification on their phone and can choose to answer or ignore the call. If the call is answered, both players can communicate through the phone regardless of their location in the game world.

The Dial app provides a direct way to contact other players making it useful for coordinating activities, discussing plans, or simply having a conversation.

cards.title: 通话记录
cards.body:
打开后显示近期通话列表，包括对方姓名、拨打时的时间和日期，以及由你还是对方拨出的标记。

- 来电：由对方拨打。
- 去电：由你拨打。

点击一条通话记录，还会出现3个选项：

- 回拨：给对方打电话。
- 消息：给对方发送消息。
- 保存联系人：将对方保存到联系人列表，并设置名称。
cards.original:
# Calls App

The calls app will open up to a screen of a list of the recent calls you've had. They will have the other persons name, the time and date when the call was placed, and whether or not it was you or the other person who made the call.

**Incoming - Other person made call.**

**Outgoing - You made the call.**

You will also have the option to click one of the calls, with three options.

**Call Back - Call the other person.**

**Message - Send a message to that person.**

**Save Contact - Allows you to save and name that person in your contacts list.**

cards.title: v6.924（#13）更新
cards.body:
## 新增
- 私人服务器，服主可从菜单打开管理面板。
- 菜单新增服务器列表查看器。
- 新增YenApp，可向其他玩家转账日元、请求日元，并查看全部交易记录。
- 重新加入并改善天气系统。
- 第一人称佩戴眼罩时，会遮挡屏幕对应一侧视野。
- 打开乐器歌曲轮盘时，显示当前正在演奏的歌曲。
- 战斗后向对手鞠躬，可清除战斗标记；须满足与“MB All”相同的条件。
- 手机新增两首歌曲：Mystery Girl、Your Skull is Red。

### 游玩
- 掉落物品10分钟后消失。
- 主机选歌按键从R1改为RT（R2）。

## 修复
- 修复血液特效永不消失的问题。
- 手机端粉笔与板擦新增丢弃按钮。
- 修复无法从储物柜装备工作制服的问题。
- 修复班次结束后未自动下班的问题。
- 丢弃的乐器会返回乐器架。
- 修复重生后无法开门的问题。
- 修复门不同步的问题。
- 修复重生后不显示名牌的问题。
- 修复全部对手被击败后仍不清除战斗状态的问题。
- 修复命中动画与特效不同步。
- 修复触屏电脑相关问题。
- 改善低画质设置下的UI质量。
cards.original:
## Additions

- Added **Private Servers**, with owners having access to a management panel through the menu.
- Added a **Server List Viewer** to the menu.
- Added **YenApp**, allowing players to:
  - Send Yen to other players.
  - Request Yen from other players.
  - View all transaction history.
- Reintroduced and improved the weather system.
- Eyepatches now block vision on the corresponding side of the screen while in first-person.
- Opening the song wheel on instruments now shows which songs are currently playing.
- Bowing to your opponent after a fight now clears your combat tag, provided the same requirements as "MB All" are met.
- Added two new phone songs:
  - Mystery Girl
  - Your Skull is Red

## Changes

### Gameplay

- Dropped items now despawn after **10 minutes**.
- On console, the song selection button has been changed from **R1** to **RT (R2)**.

## Fixes

- Fixed blood effects never despawning.
- Added mobile drop buttons for chalk and erasers.
- Fixed players being unable to equip work uniforms from lockers.
- Fixed job shifts not automatically clocking players out when their shift ended.
- Dropped instruments now return to their stands.
- Fixed players being unable to open doors after respawning.
- Fixed door desynchronization.
- Fixed nametags not appearing after respawning.
- Fixed combat status not clearing after all opponents had been defeated.
- Fixed hit animation and visual effect desynchronization.
- Fixed issues affecting touchscreen computers.
- Improved UI quality on low graphics settings.

cards.title: 最近通话
cards.body:
**最近记录**

“最近记录”应用保存近期的手机活动，便于快速联系刚刚交流过的人。

列表会自动记录：

- 来电
- 去电
- 通话持续时间

使用方法：

1. 打开手机。
2. 选择“最近记录”。
3. 浏览近期活动。
4. 选择一条记录，查看可用操作。

可以在此菜单中执行：

- 回拨：立即向选定的号码或联系人打电话。
- 消息：打开对话并发送文字消息。
- 保存联系人：如果号码尚未保存，将其加入联系人列表。

这项应用使通信更方便快捷，让玩家不必手动搜索联系人，就能重新联系最近交流过的人。
cards.original:
**Recent**

The Recent app keeps a history of your most recent phone activity, allowing you to quickly access people you've recently communicated with.

The Recent list automatically records:

- Incoming calls
- Outgoing calls
- How long calls lasted

To use Recent:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Recent**.
3. Browse your recent activity.
4. Select an entry to view available options.

From the Recent menu, players can:

- **Call Back** – Instantly place a call to the selected number or contact.
- **Message** – Open a conversation and send a text message.
- **Save Contact** – Add the number to your Contacts list if it is not already saved.

The Recent app is designed to make communication faster and more convenient, allowing players to reconnect with people they've recently interacted with without needing to manually search for them in Contacts.

cards.title: 手机游戏
cards.body:
打开后会显示包含8款游戏的界面，点击某款即可游玩。游戏如下：

- Snake（贪吃蛇）：控制蛇吃掉小点，让身体变长。
- Flappy：控制角色上下飞行，穿过水管并避免撞上。
- Pong（乒乓球）：让球左右反弹，尽量避免球落到己方边界。玩家控制蓝色一侧。
- Tetris（俄罗斯方块）：移动不同形状的方块，填满一整行将其消除。
- Breakout（打砖块）：让球上下反弹，击破上方的砖墙。
- Connect Four（四子棋）：向棋盘放入棋子，设法让4枚棋子连成一线获胜。玩家使用红色棋子。
- Jumper（跳跃者）：控制跳跃的小点不断跃上平台，尽量不要掉下去。
- React（反应测试）：屏幕变绿时出现计时信号，测试玩家反应速度，并保存纪录。
- 2048：移动并合并方块，尽量合并更多方块来取得高分。
- Space（太空）：移动飞船，射击不断下降的外星人。
cards.original:
# Games App

The games app will open up to a screen of eight games, which when pressed will allow you to play that game. The games are as follows:

‌

- **Snake - Command a snake to get dots to grow yourself.**
- **Flappy - Flap up and down through pipes and avoid hitting them.**
- **Pong - Bounce a ball left and right and try not to let it hit your side. Players control the blue side.**
- **Tetris - Move around shapes to attempt to fill in a line and clear it.**
- **Breakout - Bounce a ball up and down to break walls above.**
- **Connect Four - Put in chips in a board to attempt to make 4 slots connect, resulting in victory. Players control the red chips.**
- **Jumper - Players control a jumping dot to bounce up platforms and try not to fall down.**
- **React - Players test their reaction speed with a timed signal, the screen flashing green. Their record is recorded.**
- **2048 - Players move squares around to combine them, trying to get the highest score by combining the most squares.**
- **Space - Players move a spaceship to shoot aliens coming down.**

cards.title: 手机信息
cards.body:
**信息**

“信息”应用提供手机账户和个人统计的概览，便于快速查看角色与手机使用情况的重要信息。

页面显示：

- 手机号码：角色唯一的手机号码。
- 当前日元余额：角色目前可使用的日元金额。
- 联系人总数：手机中当前保存的联系人数量。
- 拨出电话总数：角色累计拨打的电话次数。
- 通话总时长：该角色整个存续期间累计的电话通话时间。
- 已发送消息总数：通过消息系统累计发送的文字消息数量。

这项应用便于追踪财务、查看通信统计、了解社交网络，并快速确认手机信息。

随着角色结识新人、添加联系人、拨打电话、发送消息、打工和赚钱，信息页面会自动更新，显示最新账户信息及累计活动数据。
cards.original:
**Information**

The Information app provides an overview of your phone account and personal statistics. It serves as a quick reference page where players can view important details about their character and phone usage.

The Information screen displays:

- **Phone Number** – Your character's unique phone number.
- **Current Yen Balance** – The amount of yen currently available to your character.
- **Total Contacts** – The total number of contacts currently saved on your phone.
- **Total Calls Made** – A running count of all phone calls placed by your character.
- **Total Call Time** – The cumulative amount of time spent on phone calls throughout your character's lifetime.
- **Total Messages Sent** – A running count of all text messages sent through the messaging system.

The Information app is useful for keeping track of your finances, viewing your communication statistics, monitoring your social network, and checking your phone information at a glance.

As your character continues to meet new people, add contacts, make calls, send messages, work jobs, and earn money, the Information page will automatically update to reflect your latest account information and lifetime activity statistics.

cards.body:
这是一个信息应用，打开后会显示多项手机相关数据。

包括可分享给他人的手机号码、日元余额、联系人数量、已发送消息数量、通话次数和通话总时长。页面还显示手机型号，但型号始终为FOMA 902i。
cards.original:
# My Phone App

The phone app is an information app, opening up to a screen with several stats relating to your phone.

It has your phone number which you can share to others, how much yen you have, how many contacts you have, how many messages you've sent, how many calls you've had, and your total call time. Your phone model is also included, but it is always FOMA 902i.

cards.title: Club Akuma地下俱乐部
cards.body:
Club Akuma是一家藏在Gakumart后方的地下俱乐部，相较常见场所，氛围更暗、更具另类风格。

进入后首先经过狭窄的地下走廊，墙上布满涂鸦，昏暗的红、紫、绿灯光引导你走向深处。主区域有开阔大厅、小舞台、乐器、架子鼓、麦克风，以及散布房间各处的座位区。

涂鸦墙面、棋盘格地板、彩色灯光和地下布局，让这里粗犷却热闹。玩家可以与朋友闲逛、社交、角色扮演、演奏音乐、举办聚会，或探索地下房间与走廊。这处俱乐部较为隐蔽，适合避开Gakuran繁忙地区相聚。
cards.original:
**Club Akuma** is an underground club hidden Behind Gakumart, offering a darker and more alternative atmosphere than the usual locations. As you enter, you first walk through narrow underground hallways covered in graffiti, with dim red, purple, and green lighting guiding you deeper into the club. Once you reach the main area, you’ll find a large open floor, a small stage, musical instruments, drums, microphones, and seating areas spread throughout the room. The graffiti-covered walls, checkered flooring, colored lights, and underground design give the entire location a gritty but lively feel. Players can use the area to hang out with friends, socialize, roleplay, perform music, host gatherings, or simply explore the underground rooms and hallways. The club provides a more secluded place for players to gather away from the busier parts of Gakuran.

cards.title: Mixi社交
cards.body:
**Mixi（社交平台）**

Mixi是游戏内的社交媒体平台，玩家可以与他人分享想法、经历和近况。类似现代社交网络应用，玩家可以在这里发帖、与内容互动，并与社区保持联系。

使用方法：

1. 打开手机。
2. 选择Mixi。
3. 发布帖子或浏览动态。
4. 为帖子点赞或回复。

玩家可以分享日常想法、生活近况、角色扮演片段、成就、公告，也可以与其他玩家交流。

功能包括：

- 发布帖子：分享想法、近况和状态消息。
- 点赞：表达对他人内容的喜爱。
- 回复帖子：直接在帖子下方参与讨论和交流。
- 浏览动态：查看其他玩家的帖子，了解世界中正在发生的事。

Mixi作为数字社交中心，让玩家表达自己、建立关系、参与社区讨论，并关注游戏世界中其他角色的活动。
cards.original:
**Mixi**

Mixi is the game's social media platform, allowing players to share their thoughts, experiences, and updates with others. Similar to modern social networking apps, Mixi provides a space where players can create posts, interact with content, and stay connected with the community.

To use Mixi:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Mixi**.
3. Create a post or browse the feed.
4. Interact with posts by liking or replying to them.

Players can use Mixi to share anything from daily thoughts and life updates to roleplay moments, achievements, announcements, and conversations with other players.

Features include:

- **Create Posts** – Share thoughts, updates, and status messages.
- **Like Posts** – Show appreciation for content posted by others.
- **Reply to Posts** – Join discussions and conversations directly beneath a post.
- **Browse the Feed** – View posts from other players and stay up to date with what's happening in the world.

Mixi serves as a digital social hub where players can express themselves, build relationships, participate in community discussions, and follow the activities of other characters throughout the game world.

cards.title: Socialink交换联系人
cards.body:
这项应用主要用于获取当面遇见的玩家的联系信息。打开后会出现深色界面，顶部有雷达图标，正在搜索同样使用Socialink的人。

附近另一个人打开Socialink后，对方的号码会出现在你的屏幕上，你的号码也会出现在对方屏幕上。点击号码即可将其加入联系人。
cards.original:
# Socialink App

The Socialink app is primarily used for getting the contacts of others you meet in person. Opening the app will lead to a dark screen and a radar symbol at the top, searching for others using Socialink.

When another person opens the Socialink app near you, their number will pop up on your screen (and yours for their screen). You have the option to click this number and add them as a contact.

cards.title: 相机
cards.body:
**相机**

可以使用游戏内的手机拍照。

使用方法：

1. 打开手机。
2. 选择“相机”。
3. 在3种自定义滤镜之间切换，选择想要的效果。
4. 切换前置或后置摄像头。
5. 拍照。

- 后置摄像头：拍摄场景、环境和其他玩家。
- 前置摄像头：为自己的角色自拍。

可以在世界中的任何地方即时拍照。

---

**保存照片至Roblox拍摄记录**

拍照后可以将照片保存至Roblox：

1. 打开照片预览。
2. 选择“保存至拍摄记录”。

图片会存入Roblox拍摄记录，离开游戏后也能通过Roblox账号查看。
cards.original:
**Camera**

The Camera app allows players to take photos using their in game phone.

To use it:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Camera**.
3. Switch between 3 different custom filters for different vibes.
4. Switch between **front** and **back** camera.
5. Take a photo.

- **Back Camera** – Captures the world, environments, and other players.
- **Front Camera** – Takes selfies of your character.

Photos can be taken instantly anywhere in the world.

---

**Saving Photos (Roblox Captures)**

After taking a photo, players can save it to Roblox:

1. Open the photo preview.
2. Select **Save to Captures**.

The image is stored in your **Roblox Captures** and can be accessed outside the game through your Roblox account.

Opening the Mixi App will lead to a screen where you choose your profile picture, having a symbol option and 2 color options. There are 21 symbols to choose, and you are able to change the color of the symbol and the color of the background. Dark and light orange are the default colors.

After changing your profile picture, you have the option to post on the Mixi app about anything. It is a social media app, and it is global across servers. You have the option to make a new post, or open up an existing post. You can like the post and/or comment on the post.

cards.body: 天气应用可以查看当前游戏内的天气状况，尤其适合角色扮演时规划活动，或根据变化的天气调整安排，无需等到实际遇上天气才知道。玩家随时都能快捷地查看天气预报。
cards.original: **Weather App** is a simple application that allows players to view the current in game weather conditions. This is especially useful for roleplay, letting players plan activities or adapt to changing weather without having to wait and see it in game. It provides a quick and convenient way to check the forecast at any time.

cards.title: Japanify音乐
cards.body: 打开后会出现多个选项：喜欢的歌曲、歌单、全部歌曲、歌手、最近播放和搜索。佩戴耳机时，音乐会自动通过耳机播放；没有戴耳机时，则使用扬声器外放。
cards.original:
# Japanify App

The Japanify app is a music app, opening up to a list of several options. Liked songs, playlists, all songs, artists, recently played, and search. Songs will automatically be played to headphones if you are wearing them, and instead be played on speaker if you are not.

cards.title: 相机
cards.body: 可以自拍，也可以拍摄面前的场景，并有多种滤镜可用。相机还与一项特定的校园拍照工作有关。
cards.original:
# Camera App

The camera app allows people to take pictures either as a selfie or infront of them. There are multiple filters, and the camera app also has a specific job of school picture-taking related to it.

cards.title: Indeed兼职
cards.body:
Indeed是找工作的主要应用，完成工作可以获得日元。所有工作都是兼职，不会持续多天。目前的工作有：

- Gakumart：在便利店工作，保护店铺并为顾客服务。
- 校报：担任校报摄影师，拍摄学生或不同地点。
cards.original:
# Indeed App

The Indeed App is the main place for jobs, which you will earn **Yen** through doing so. Jobs are only part-time, and they do not last through multiple days. The current jobs are:

 **Gakumart - Work at the Gakumart, protecting the store and servicing customers.**

**School Newspaper - Work as a picture taker for the school newspaper, taking pictures of either students or different locations.**

cards.title: YenApp转账
cards.body:
YenApp是供所有人使用的主要银行应用，可以存放日元并转账。首次使用时需要创建收款标签，其他人可以用它向你转账或索款，之后便能进入银行账户。

点击“活动记录”可查看近期所有资金相关活动，包括付款、购买和转账。也可以输入其他人的收款标签，向对方转账或发送索款请求。
cards.original:
# Yenapp

Yenapp is the main banking app for everyone, storing Yen and allowing the transfer of it. You will be asked to create a Yen Tag which people can use for transferring or requesting money, to which you will gain access to your bank. The activity button will lead you to a screen of all recent money related activities, such as payments, purchases, and transfers. You can also put in another person Yen Tag to either send them money or send a request for money.

cards.title: 天气
cards.body: 显示模拟当前天气的画面，并用文字列出温度和天气读数。
cards.original:
# Weather App

The weather app displays a simulated screen of how the weather is, and text telling you the temperature and readings of the weather.

cards.title: Deco手机装饰
cards.body:
开启按主题划分的贴纸包来扩充收藏，不会抽到重复贴纸。点击Deco贴纸册中的任意贴纸包，可以查看其中全部贴纸。每次购买花费¥400，可获得3张新贴纸。

- 开发者Q版贴纸包：4张贴纸
- 开发者Q版贴纸包2：6张贴纸
- 印章贴纸包：8张贴纸
- 涩谷辣妹贴纸包：8张贴纸
- 漫画贴纸包：8张贴纸
- 平成复古贴纸包：8张贴纸

商店正下方还有挂件扭蛋，可以抽取各类挂件，并将它们放在手机周围任意位置。

---


花费日元可自定义手机的基础外观。选择一种颜色，再在贴纸下方叠加图案样式。

**手机壳颜色**

- 免费：钴蓝、石墨黑
- ¥1,500：珍珠白、樱花粉
- ¥2,000：薄荷绿、宝石红、青柠绿、橘色
- ¥2,500：薰衣草紫

**图案**

- 免费：无图案
- ¥5,000：豹纹、斑马纹

---


打开摆放画布，将已解锁贴纸直接排列在手机壳上。

- 电脑端：点击、拖动，或按1至9键，将贴纸贴在上半部或下半部。
- 移动端／手机：用手指拖动贴纸，转动界面旋钮来旋转贴纸。
cards.original:
## SHOP

Open theme-based sticker packs with zero duplicates to build your collection. Tap any pack in your Deco Seal Book to view all available stickers. Each order costs ¥400 and gives you 3 new stickers.

- `Developers Chibi Pack` - 4 Stickers
- `Developers Chibi Pack 2`- 6 Stickers
- `Stamp Pack` - 8 Stickers
- `Gyaru Pack` - 8 Stickers
- `Manga Pack` - 8 Stickers
- `Heisei Retro Pack` - 8 Stickers

There’s also a gacha right bellow the store which allows you to roll for any charm and place it wherever you want around your phone.

## CASE COLORS & PATTERNS

Customize the base look of your phone using yen. Select a color and layer a style pattern underneath your stickers.

**Case Colors:**

- `Free` - Cobalt, Graphite
- `¥1,500` - Pearl White, Sakura Pink
- `¥2,000` - Mint, Ruby Red, Lime, Tangerine
- `¥2,500` - Lavender
- `¥3,000` - Gold

**Patterns:**

- `Free` - No pattern
- `¥5,000` - Leopard, Zebra

---

## HOW TO PLACE STICKERS

Open your placement canvas to arrange your unlocked stickers directly onto the phone case.

- **Desktop:** Tap, drag, or press keys `1-9` to stick a piece on the **TOP** or **BOTTOM** sections.
- **Mobile / Phone:** Drag with your finger to move the sticker, and twist the UI knob to turn/rotate it.

cards.title: DEMAE外送
cards.body:
可以通过手机向地图上的各家店铺下单，选择外送或自取。

---


点击DEMAE应用右下角按钮，即可成为配送员。取餐并将订单送达顾客，可以获得评价和日元。领取第一笔订单时，会得到一个红色外送背包。

cards.original:
# DEMAE App

The DEMAE app allows you to mobile order from various shops located around the map via Delivery and Pickup.

‌

---

# WORKING:

You can become a delivery courier for DEMAE via clicking the button in the bottom right of the DEMAE app. Couriers earn ratings and Yen via picking up orders and delivering them to customers. Courier's get a red delivery backpack upon picking up their first order.

Upon an order getting delivered, the customer can rate the shop and food out of 5 stars, and give the courier a "GOOD" or "BAD" rating. Store ratings appear on the main page of DEMAE

cards.title: 出租车
cards.body:
出租车应用是游戏内翻盖手机上的快速旅行功能。玩家可以叫出租车，前往城市和校园中的主要地点，缩短长途移动时间，并避免不想遭遇的伏击。

**主要功能与机制：手机入口**

在翻盖手机菜单中选择出租车图标即可进入。可以从指定下车地点列表中选择目的地，例如校门、市中心、体育馆、附近商店和帮派地盘。

**费用：**200日元。

靠近出租车后，会显示“坐进前排／坐进后排以开始”的选项，对话气泡内还会列出200日元的免责费用。

**冷却与限制**

正在战斗或处于硬直状态时无法使用。

抵达目的地后，会显示包含行程详情的确认消息。

此外，手机上还有出租车应用。花费¥100即可从地图上的任何位置呼叫一辆可用出租车，也能查看乘车记录。

叫车演示
cards.original:
The Taxi App is a fast travel feature accessible directly through the player's in-game flip phone. It allows players to quickly navigate the map by calling a cab to transport them to key locations across the city and school grounds, eliminating long travel times and avoiding unwanted ambushes.

Key Features & Mechanics Phone Integration:

Accessible via the flip phone menu under the Taxi icon. Fast Travel Locations: Select from a list of designated drop-off points (e.g., School Gates, City Center, Gym, Local Shops, Gang Turf).

Cost / Fee: 200 YEN

Get near the taxi and it will display a "Get In Front Seat - Get In Back Seat to start" option along with the 200 Yen Waiver Fee included in the text bubble.

Cooldown / Restrictions:

Cannot be used while in active combat or staggered.

Upon reaching your destination, a confirmation message showing the details of your trip will be shown.

Additionally, there is a "TAXI" app on the phone. Using it will allow you to call an available taxi from anywhere on the map at the cost of ¥100, as well as viewing your taxi ride history.

cards.original:
### SPORTS APP

Select a sport from the menu to see open courts, queues, and player counts on your server.

- **Queue up:** Click on a sport and press join to enter the matchmaking line.
- **Leave line:** You can exit the queue at any time after joining if you change your mind.
